sngag /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/nya༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bo dhi sa (natwa tsar+ya nir de sha danā ma ma hā yā na sru ④dra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo(de / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis 'thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can 57na tshal chen po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na dge slong stong tham pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pan/ byed pa byas pa/khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems 961—263

thams cad kyi dbang gi tsho1)dam pa'i pha rol tu sonas pa/ spyod lam zhi ba dang /dul ba dang / rnam par grol ba dang / ma brtags pa dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gang zag gcig ni ma gtogs ②te/de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis nyams su len par bka' stsal te/ tshe 'di nyid la lung bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' stong tham pa (4༄thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa/ thams cad kyang gzungs thob pa/ thams cad kyang mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad kyang ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa'i sa thob pa/ mkhas pa/ drang po/ dad pa dang ldan pa/ rtog pa mang ba/dang ba gtso bor byed pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa/ khro gnyer med pa/ g.yo med pa/bsgrub 5pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rjes su rtogs pa/chos bstan pas yongs su mi skyo ba/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yang dag par skyes pa yongs su smin par byed pa/ ldem po dag la phyin ci ma log pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa/ yul thams cad phyin ci ma log pa'i sa dang ldan pa/ dus shes pa/tshod shes pa/ skabs shes pa/ ran pa shes pa/ rgod pa med pa/ khengs pa med pa/ spyod lam tha mal pa phun sum tshogs pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mkhas pa/ 'byung ba dang 'jig pa yongs su spangs pa/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa/ 'khor ba la56)yun ring du spyod pa la zhugs pa/mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa/ spros pa'i rnam pa thams cad kyi mtshan ma legs par bzung ba/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la mkhas pa / 'du shes thams cad dang bral ba/ nyan thos kyi theg pa rnam par gzhagamartso)pa la mkhas pa/ chos bstan pa yang dag par dbye bar ni༄'jug par byed pa/61—264

rang nyutshosangs rgyas kyi theg pa ston pa/ nye bar zhi ba'i bsngags pa brjod pa/byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par slong ba/ spyod pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhe 'gras pa med par chos guston pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / 'jam dpal gzho na nur gyur pa dang /spobs pa brtsegs pa rigadang / lag na rin chen ldan dang / spos 'od dang /mtha' yas snang ba'i blo gros dang / ngan song spong dang / don grub sems pa dang / yon tan rgyal po snang 4dang / mya ngan gyi mun pa thams cad sel ba'i blo gros dang / mi mnyam pa thams cad ston pa dang / de'i rang bzhin du mi gnas pa dang / blo mtha' yas dang / brtson 'grus dang / rtsal brtan 5por sems pa dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / bkod pa'i rgyal po dang /rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po dang / 'khrul pa med pa'i mthu rtsal dang / khyad par blo gros dang / kun nas mdzes dang / sgrib 7med ston dang / rnam par rtse dang / gser mchog 'od dpal dang / chos thams cad la rtag tu lta ba'i blo ldan dang / spos dri myur sbyin me tog kun tu rgyas dang / gtso bo brtsegs 7dang / mya ngan med pa'i dpal dang / lhun po'i lto 8dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang / blo mtha' yas sgrub pa dang / dam pa'i chos thams cad mi brjed par gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge ltar sgra mngon par sgrogs pa dang / de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag mang po gzhan dag dang yang thabs cig 9tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus kyi tshe sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed 61—265

bsnams nas dge slong nyis stong gis bskor cing mdun du bdar te yangs pa'i grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la gshegs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyuzhabs sgo'i them pa la bzhag ma thag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams grong khyer du gshegs pa na dngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba gang dag yin pa de dag byung ste/ long ba rnams ni mthong bar54)gyur/'on pa rnams ni thos par gyur/ smyon pa rnams75ni dran pa rnyed par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog gi char yang bab bo/ /snang ba chen po yang byung ngo / /srang yang dri ma med par gyur to/ /lha'i sil snyan yid 67du 'ong ba dag kyang ma brdungs par grag 7go/ /mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba la thug pa 58snanas 'og min gyi gnas man chad kyi sems can thams cad kyang gcig tu nges par bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i tshe yangs pa'i grong khyer chen po na lits+tsha bī (9)seng ge'i bu rin chen byin zhes bya ba skyes nas lo gsum lon pa ma ma'i pang pa tshan 'dug pa khang bzangs kyis 11brgyan pa'i khang bzangs kyi 12steng na 'dug ste/ khye'u rin chen byin gyis rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma dag mthong ngo / /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis rang gi ma ma 1 la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ma ma gang 1 gi mthu stobs kyis/ /shin tu ya mtshan byung ba snang / /nyi ma bye ba rnams kyi 'od/ /zil gnon snang 'di su zhig yin/ /stong gsum sa gzhi 12khyab gyur nas/ ngan 'gro skems tshapar byed pa yi/ / /rdzu 'phrul snang 18ba gang yin 'di/ /ma ma bdag la myur du smros/ /dus min me tog char pa yis/ /sangs rgyas zhing mtshams med par mdzes/ /phyogs rnams bya yi nyurtetshogs rnams kyis/ /skad snyan pas ni khyab par gyur/ /srang yang me tog rnams kyis khebs/ /me tog 61—266

gdugs kyang rnam par bres/ /skyes pa bud med dga' rnams kyis/ /kun nas rab haXtu mdzes par 'dug /long ba rnams kyis namig kyang thob/ /skye bo 'on rnams sgra yang thos/ /byad ngan byad gzugs phun sum tshogs/ /mdog ngan kha dog phun sum tshogs/ /g.yengs pa rnams kyang dran pa rnyed/ /lce med tshig ni rnam par dag /sems can byams pa'i sems med pa/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur/ /ma ma sems can khyad par can/ /rdzu 'phrul grub pa mthu ldan pa/ /'jig rten dag na rgyu ba 'di/ /su yin bdag la myur du smros/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyi ma mas khye'u rin chen byin la tshigs su bcad de smras pa④/ rnam par (snyedag pa spyod mchog ldan/ /rgyal ba dri med blo mi dman/ /bsam yas ma lus yongs su dag /dbang ldan yon tan rin chen 'phags/ /'jig rten mgon po 'khya pyo ris mig /de bzhin gshegs pa rtsa lag 'di/ /blo ldan bsod snyoms don du gshegs/ /'jig rten chos la rten pa med/ /'di la sdug dang mi sdug sogs/ /'jig rten pa yi rtog mi mnga'/ /pad ma chu las skyes pa ltar/ /mnga' bdag mi gos spyod par mdzad97/ /blo gros ldan pa the tsom du stegacod/ /phan mdzad thugs rjer ldan pa ste(9ci/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'dir gshegs so/ /bstod kyang dgyes par mi 'gyur la/ /smad 7kyang 'khrug par mi 'gyur te/ /khong khro rjes su chags pa spangs/ /chags med rgyu ba rlung dang 'dra/ /'di ni chos rgyal dam pa ste / /ye shes zab mo phun sum tshogs/ /don dam don la mkhas pa po/ /'gro ba'i slob dpon gshegs pa yin/ /de ni dbu ma ston 11pa ste/ /yod med 'dzin las rnam par grol/ /chos lam ldan zhing zhi ba ste/ /brten 12pa thams 61—267

cad yongs su spangs/ /ye shes phung po bdag med bdag /bsod nams tshogs rnams bstsags 1pa yi/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten 'dren pa po(5/ /mtha' yas gzugs can deng gshegs so/ /dbu skra g.yas su 'khyil par gnas//'jam zhing mdog snum lcang lo can/ /gnag 45cing 'dzings rinapa med rnams kyis / /de yi dbu ni rnam par mdzes/ /gtsug tor g.yas su 'khyil pa ste/ /dbu skra 'khyil zhing 6legs par gnas/ /ri rab rtse mo 'dra bar ni/ /de yi dbyibs ni mdzes pa yin/ /de yi smin mtshams mdzod spu mdzes/ /'jam zhing g.yas su 'khyil 7ba ste/ /'od ni shel dang 8zla ba yi/ /'od zer dra ba mang bas lhag /de yi zhal nas spyan mdzes pa/ /me tog uta pal sngon po 'dra/ /ba yi rdzi ma yongs su dag / mi dmar 59ma 'dzings zhi bar gzigs/ /dpal ldan seng ge'i 'gram pa 'dra/ /de ni rtag tu zhal yang 'dzum/ /sgros ni bem pa bzhin du dmar/ /zhal mdzes lus can kun 'dren pa/ /mthu stobs chen po phun sum tshogs/ /bsod nams brgya yi stobs mnga' ba/ /tshems kyi phreng ba spa 1 ba'i 'od/ / snyoms shing thags 11bzang yongs su dag /de yi tshems ni shin tu dkar/ /ljags ni shin tu ring zhing srab/ /bdag nyid kyi ni zhal gyi ngos12 / /de yis kun tu khyab par gnas/ /dpal ldan dbu ni gdugs dang 'dra / /de bzhin de ni shangs kyang mtho/ /mdog ni btso 1lhama'i gser dang 'dra / /de yi zhal gyi 'phral 1 ba mdzes/ /de yi zhal gyi smin tshugs ni/ /kha dog mthon mthing 15shin tu sdug /zhi ba'i spyan ni mdzes pa ste/ /snyan gyi drung du thug par gnas/ /snyan shal ring la rab tu 'phyang / /zhal mdzes ston gyi zla bas lhag /zhal ras pad ma rnam dag 'dra/ /zhal mdangs dkar la dang zhing 61—268

gsal / /brtan po tshangs pa'i sgra skad ldan/ /de gsung ka la ping ku'i 1'dra/ /de yi gsung bzang yid du 'ong / /'jam zhing sems can tshim par byed/ /rma bya ngang pa mi 'am ci/ /ne tso ri skegs khu byug dang / /'brug nasgra khrung khrung ku na la/ /shang shang te'u dang gling bu dang / /rdza rnga'i sgra dang gzhan dag kyang / /sgra skad snyan pa ci yang rung / /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /gsung gi bcu drug char mi phod/ /skul ri mdzad de bzhin mnyen pa ste/ /de ni snyan cing 'jam pa dang / /yid 'ong dga' byed gsal ba ste/ /skyon cadang bral zhing 'jigs pa med/ /re ba rnams la char rgyun ltar/ /sems rgyun tshim par byed la zhi/ /ma nyams ma 'khrul rab tu zhi/ /de bzhin dag cing brda phrad sla/ /skal dang ldan zhing snyan par ldan/ /don dang yon tan thams cad tshogs5/ /gsung gi rgyan rnams phun sum tshogs/ / de yi gsung 6ni dge skyed 7pa/ /sems can mos tshonasapa tha dad dang 9ri/ /de bzhin nges tshig tha dad rnams/ /de yi gsung la nges par dad/ /yid kyang rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /des ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams/ /gnas pa'i sems can gsung gis khyab/ /mgon po de yi gsung tshig ni/ /sems can rnams la don yod 'jug /thub pa skyes mchog de yi ni/ /mgur yang dung 'dra dpung mgo zlum/ /de yi thal gong rgyas pa ste/ /de ni bdun po mtho ba mnga'/ /de yi phyag kyang rab tu ring //pags 3 )pa gser mdog 'dra ba ste/ /gser gyi sdong po bzhin du mtho/ /n+ya gro da ltar 11chu zheng gab/ /thugs ka dpal gyi be'us brgyan/ /'khor lo'i mtshan can pad ma'i phyag /shing bal 'dab ltar reg na 'jam/ /de yi phyag gi sor mo ring / /spu rnams re rer skyes shing 12yar phyogs stug 1 la 'jam /61—269

brang gi phel 1ka che la rab rgyas lte ba zab/ /phyal dbyibs gzhu 'dra glang (0chen bzhin du sbubs su nub/ /rje ngar ri e ne ya 'dra mdangs dkar 'dam bu'i sbubs / /long bu mi mngon de yi rting pa legs par grub/ /de bzhin drang srong sor mo ring zhing sen mo dmar/ /bde bar gshegs kyi zhabs kyi long bu mi mngon te/ /'khor lo lcags kyu pa bkra shis ldan dang dung gis spras/ /mgon po de yi zhabs gnyis mnyam zhing legs gnas dang / /shing bal bzhin du reg na 'jam zhing bzang ba dang / /me tog uta pal dmar po legs par skyes pa yi/ /kha dog 'dra bas sa gzhi dag la gshegs par mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra sgrogs bde sbyin pa/ /'gro ba rnams kyi gtso bo de ni 'dir gshegs te / /yong 6gis 'jigs pa med par seng ge'i sgra skad kyis/ /gnyis su med cing spros pa med pa'i chos kyang ston/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis bdag gi ma ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ma ma bdag skar khung 'dir zhog shig chadang /de bzhin gshegs pa 8blta'o/ /de nas ma ma des khye'u rin chen byin skar khung du bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u rin chen byin gyi sems kyi yongs su rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas sung de kho nar gshegs so/ /khye'u rin chen byin gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa 'di lta bu mthong nas byang chub kyi sems skyed par mi byed pa de dag ni rnyed pa nyes 9par rnyed pa'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khye'u rin chen byin gyi sgo drung du gshegs so/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can khyad par can 'di lta bu ni bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum du 61—270

yang rnyed par dka' bas91/ khang bzangs 2'di las bdag gis mchong bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe khye'u rin chen byin gyis ril gyis gser las byas pa'i pad ma 'dab (gem 'bum dang ldan pa brtsen 5pa lag mthil du khyer ro/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis khang bzangs 6de las bdag nyid kyis mchongs so / /de sangs rgyas kyi mthus nam mkha' tshidabar snang la 'dug go/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis ril gyis gser las byas pa'i pad ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa de bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /de khye'u rin chen byin gyi lag nas btang nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nadabu'i drang thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' bar snang la pad ma'i gdugs su byas te rin po che'i dra ba yang 'bres so/ /de nas de'i tshe khye'u rin chen byin gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas pad ma 'di phul ba/ /bdag ni ci yang mi 'tshal te1 tsho/ /don rnams thams cad bcad 37slad du/ /bdag ni byang chub mchog 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar byang chub ma skyes la/ /thob pa ma mchis bshig ma mchis/ /blang du 12ma mchis dor 3)ma mchis/ /de ltar bdag gis me tog dbul/ /gyis pa rnams kyis don gang brtags8/ /brtags pa de ni don ma mchis/ /rtog pa thams cad bcad 15slad du/ /gang zag mchog la bdag mchod bgyid/ /de phyir me tog phul ba 'di / /bdag la rnam smin 'bras ma gyur/ /dngos po thams cad bcad 7slad du / /pad ma 'di ni bdag gis phul/ /bdag gi 1 sangs rgyas zhing du ni/ /rgyal mchog theg pas 'gro ma gtogs/ /nyan thos kyi ni ming yang rung / /rang rgyal ming yang 'byung ma gyur/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khye'u rin chen byin la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod ni ston pa 'di 'dra la/ /61—271

dad pas mchod pa byed mod kyi/ /blo gros phyin ci log gyur na1)/ /sangs rgyas su ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la tshigs su bcad tsho de smras pa/ 'di dag thams cad ma skyes te/ /'dus byas dag ni gsob 4nodang gsog /de 'dra ba yi chos rnams la/ /dngos por 'gyur ba ga la yod/ /khyod ni chos gos ngur smrig bgos/ /dgra bcom nyid du 'dzin par byed/ /rnam shes 'di dag 5raspyod yul yang / /stong pa kho na ma yin nam/ /dmigs pa la ni gnas bcas pas/ /sangs rgyas bye ba ma mnyes byas/ /bye ba de yang zhi bar mthong / /su yang ma 96)mnyes byas pa med/ /mod gal bu la da dung yang / /dmigs pa 'jug pa yod dam ci/ /khyod kyi (7risems ni gang zhig gis/ /yon yang yongs su sbyong bar byed/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khye'u rin chen byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khye'u ci de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas sam/ chos kyang ma bstan tam/ khye'u rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu mkhas pas ni byang chub spros par mi bya'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa yang narlom sems su mi bya'o/ /chos mi skye'o snyam du brtag 59par mi bya'o/ /chos thams cad 'dus 7byas so snyam du brtag 3)par mi bya'o/ /chos thams cad 'dus ma byas so snyam du brtag 12par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te chos thams cad skye ba dang / mi skye ba dang / dngos po dang /dngos po med pa zhes bya ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / gtong ba zhes bya ba dang 1 /phrad pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba dang / 'gro ba dang / 'ong ba dang / gnas mi pa dang / 'pho ba dang / 'dod chags kyi chos dang / zhe sdang gi chos dang /61—272

gti mug gi chos dang / chos dang / chos ma yin pa zhes brtag par mi bya'o/ /ma rig pa la sogs pa nas so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams dang / nyan thos kyi chos rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos rnams dang / rnam par byang ba'i chos rnams dang / gzugs can dang / gzugs can ma yin pa dang / 'du shes dang ske/ 'du shes med pa dang / mtshan nyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang /spyod pa yongs su dag pa dang / mnyam pa nyid nyadang / mi mnyam pa nyid dang /lus dang / sems dang / chos thams cad tshul bzhin dang / tshul bzhin ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i bar du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes brtag tshan par mi bya'o/ /mod gal gyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'am/ smras pa/de ni ma yin no/ /smras pa/ ci de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin nyid la ma gtogs pa dang / byang chub de bzhin nyid la tsho ma gtogs pa dang / so so'i skye bo de bzhin nyid la ma gtogs par 'dod dam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/de ni ma yin no/ /khye'us smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu 4khyod spros pa med pa la spros paramo5༄byed dam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ kho bo ni 'jig rten gyi kun rdzob kyi sgo nas ston to/ /khye'us smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu 'jig rten ni brdzun 6pa / slu ba sgyu ma'i rnam pa/ byis pa 'drid par byed pa'o/ /mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ gal te 'jig rten 'di brdzun 7pa slu ba'i chos can yin pa 3dang bstan pa 'di yang brdzun 94pa/ slu ba'i chos can yin na khyod ci'i phyir ston par byed/ smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu chos thams cad ni 1 bstan du med pa ste/61—273

de dag ni bstan par bya ba ma yin/ thob par bya ba ma yin/ mngon sum du bya ba ma yin/ spang bar bya ba ma yin/ yongs su shes par bya ba ma yin/bsgom par bya ba ma yin no/ /mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ 'o na khyod kyis gang gi don du de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ khye'us smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ sbyin pa po'am/ sbyin par dmigs sam/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod 1gal gyi bu cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /khye'u rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ mod gal gyi bu bdag gis de las bsams snonas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yongs su spangs te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la sems skyed par byed pa gang dag yin pa de dag ni ngasirnyed pa nyes par rnyed pa'o zhes de skad kyi tshig (5smras so/ /mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ khyod ni na (rmetshod shin tu gzhon/ /shes rab kyis 7ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /khyod kyis ji srid tsam zhig nas/ /chos 'di dag la bslabs par gyur ci/ /khye'u rin chen byin 59)gyis smras pa/ bslab pa thams cad rnam 'jig pa/ /bslab pa gang yin de bslab min/ /gang la bslab 1 pa med pa de/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi 11bslab pa yin/ /don gang khyod kyis bdag dris pa/ /sems can 'du shes gnas pa ste/ /'dir ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /gang la'ang sna skye ba mi rnyed do/ /byis pa rnams ni byang chub dang / /'khor ba nyid du rtog par byed/ /'dir ni da dung btsun pa khyod/ /byis pa'i chos la 'brang ngam ci/ /ring po'am yang na thung ngu zhes/ /mkhas pa dag ni rtog mi byed/ /chos kun snying po med par ni/ /de bzhin de dag khong du chud/ /byis pa'am byis pa'i chos rnams sam/ /sangs rgyas chos sam rgyal ba'ang rung / /blo ldan tha dad mi 'byed kyisanyun/ /stong pa nyid la de ltar ltos/ /61—274

drang srong chen pos byang chub thob/ /de ni mi rigs brtags pa yin/ /chos 'di la ni skye med na/ /mya ngan 'das pa ji ltar thob1ri/ /chos rnams mtha' yas rab tu gsungs/ /sems can grol ba'ang dngos po med/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba la/ /tha dad dbyer med gzung bar gyis/ /'di la rnam pa thams cad du/ /bsnan dang dbyi ba ci yang med/ /tha dad med pa'i chos rnams snol/ /mkhas pa rnams ni rmongs mi 'gyur/ /gyis pa rnams kyis thob cing rnyed/ /byis pas 5kyimya ngan 'das pa thob/ /'khor ba la ni de kun chags/ /rlom (gesems bdud kyi 'ching ba yin/ /gang gis blo la ngas thob snyam/ /des ni ci yang thob pa med/ /de yi yang srid 'gro ba yi/ /ma rig pa yang 5'jug 6par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por 'dug nas ni/ /mthong ba med cing spangs pa'ang chamed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub 'di/ /tha snyad yin te don du min / /byang chub dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /tha snyad rin dag gis brjod mi nus/ /gang dag de ltar yang dag mthong / /de dag chos nyid rnam par shes/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khye'u rin chen byin 59gyis yun ji srid cig nas chos 'di la spyad lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gi tshe de 1 tshobazhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyis nga mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ba lung bstan pa de'i tshe/ 'di mar me mdzad kyi gsung rab la stong pa nyid la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to/ /gang gi tshe ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dang po sems bskyed pa de'i tshe 'dis 11bzod pa thob nas bskal pa sum 'bum lon no/ /shā ri'i bus 61—275

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khye'u rin chen byin bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa'i rgyu ni gang lags/rkyen ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis khye'u rin chen byin 1'di nyid la dris shig dang 'di nyid kyis gekhyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus khye'u rin chen byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci'i phyir khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas/ rin chen byin du nogyis smras pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma ④dmigs pas na de'i phyir bdag mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang mi rgya'o/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ 'o na ci de bzhin gshegs pa 'di mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa las na dmigs pa la buspyod dam/ rin chen byin du6)gyis smras pa/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dzin na (7༄ni/ de'i dmigs par 'gyur ba zhig na/ chos gsung ba ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang mi mdzad la spong bar yang mi mdzad do/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ khyodas3)chos bzhi 7sgrub pa dang yongs su smin pa mnyam pas bzod pa gang la gnas/ khye'u rin chen byin nya 5gyis smras pa/ bdag gis ni chos gcig kyang yongs su grub par yang dag par ma 11mthong na bzhi lta ci smos/ 'di la yang dag par grub pa gang zhig yod de/ chos rnam par rig pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dmigs pa'o/ /byang chub ces bya ba 'di ni dmigs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni 'dzin pa'o/ /grol ba zhes bya ba 'di ni spros pa'o/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/rigs kyi bu khyod 'di lta bu'i chos rnams la spyod la rdzus te skye bas sangs rgyas 61—276

rnams mngon sum du gyur par skye zhing rtag tu rab tu 'byung ba 'di ni ngo mtshar to / /de nas de'i tshe khye'u rin chen byin 1gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /skye dang de bzhin skye med gnyis ni spros pa ste/ /kun tu rtogs dunapa'i sa dang bdud kyi spyod yul yin/ /lus la sogs pa'i chos 'dzin rlom sems 'dod pa yi/ /lha dang lha min 'gro ba rnams ni 'dir brlag go/ /rgyal bas bdud rtsi 'dus zhum byas pa brnyes snyam du/ /de ltar gang dag bsam pa rab tu 'jug byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas la ni sku ngas 4gsol bar byed/ /brnyes kyang 'di la 'dren pa rnams kyis brnyes pa med/ /'dir ni skye bo 5rimang po dag /rab tu byung nas rang byung rlom/ /sems kyi dmigs pas 6rnam 'khrul nas/ /bstan pa la ni sun 'byin rnams/ /bdud rtsi bdag gis thob bo zhes/ /thob pa'i nga rgyal can dag smra/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yi/ /bstan pa la ni spros med pa / /sems kyis rnam pa thams cad du/ /sems kyis 77ngo bo nyid mi rtogs/ /de bzhin rnam 'dren gsungs pa yi/ /lta ba de ni rang bzhin med na/ /spyan dag rgyal bas gsungs pa yi/ /lta ba la ni lta ba med/ /de phyir shes rab 9ldan pa ni/ /bdag nyid grol snyam 'dzin pa medami / /mtshan mar 'dzin pa sgom pa rnams / /bdag tu dmigs pas rmongs par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa ma yin kha cig ni / /yang dag ma yin stong pa spong / /dngos po rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /rang gi blos ni brtags nas kyang / /mi mkhas de dag dngos po rnams/ /gzhig phyir mya ngan 'das pa smra/rta/ /lus la yang ni rten bcas nas/ /tshul khrims 'du shes rnam par 'jig /sems kyi dmigs pa dag la yang / /bsam gtan 'du shes rnam par 'jig /de bzhin shes rab 12dmigs nas kyang / /sa bon 'du 61—277

shes rnam par rmongs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten mkhas rnams kyis/ /de dag chos kyi 1kun por brjod/ /'di 'dra ba yisho0chos rnams la/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal nyon mongs med/ /'o na rab tu byung ba'i don/ /khyod kyis bdag la ji skad brjod/ /chos rnams thams cad tha dad med/ /'di dag brag cam 'dra ba yin/ /mkhas pa de dag nam du yang / /'phags pa'i spyod yul rtog mi byed / /gzhan min mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid/ /gzhan dag tu ni yong mi 'gyur / /chos rnams 'gyur ba med pa la/ /rab byung brtags pas ci zhig bya/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas khye'u rin chen byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khye'u byang chub ces bya ba de gang gi tshig bla dgas54)yin/ rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub ni tshig gi bla dgas med pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ khyod ci las bsams (5)te de skad smra/ rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos nyid ni bsam du med pa yin nayi/ de bdag gis 'di ltar bsams te 57bstan par bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/'di la nalas dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ji ltar gdams ngag bstan par bya/ ji ltar rjes su bstan par bya/ rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ 'di skad ces smra bar bya ste/ 'dod chags ma spangs shig ri95zhe sdang ma gzhil cig /gti mug ma bsal cig /rang bogi lus las 11gyen du ma bskyod cig /mi dge ba spyod 12cig /lta ba tshar ma gcod 12cig /kun tu sbyor ba rnams ma ston cig /phung po rnams yongs su zung mishig /khams rnams ril por gyis shig /skye mched rnams la spyod cig /byis pa'i sa las 'da' bar ma byed cig /mi dge ba la rtogs shig /dge ba spongs shig /sangs rgyas yid la ma byed cig /61—278

chos ma sems shig /dge 'dun la ni mchod pa ma byed cig /bslab pa dag yang dag par (1)ma len cig /srid pa nye bar zhi ba don du ma gnyer cig /chu bo las ma rgal saracig /ces gdams ngag 'di lta busamagulas dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la gdams par bya'otsho ri/ /rjes su bstan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos rnams kyi chos gnas pa 'di ni gnas pa kho na yin pa'i phyir ro / /byis pa de dag ni skye ba'i chos su lung ston par byed do/ /'gag pa'i chos su lung ston par byed do/ /chos kyi dbyings 'di ni rnam par mi rtog 5pas rab tu phye ba yin te/ chos 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin de ltar rjes 6su rtogs pa gang yin pa de 0)ni byang chub bo zhes de ltar gdams na/ gal te mi skrag mi dngang zhing dngang bar mi 'gyur na/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa ste/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'i skalamuḥb can yin no snyam du shes par bya ste / gdams ngag 'dis yang dang yang du yang dag par dga' ba bskyed par bya'o / /de'i tshe dmigs pa can gyi dge slong brgyad kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma bsten par spangs nas 59'khor de nas song ste/ kha nas khrag dron mo byung nas shi'o/ /shi nas sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod du skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pas 1 gnod pa chen po ji tsam du gyur pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod de skad ma zer cig /gal te dge slong 'di dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma thos su zin na/ bskal pa sa ya'i bar du nams kyang 1 bzang 'gror skye bar yang mi 'gyur na sangs rgyas dang phrad cing mnyes par byed 61—279

pa lta ci smos/ da 1 ni de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di som nyi ( dang bcas pas thos nas da gzod ( kho nar sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod nas shi 'phos te dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skye'o/ /de dag bskal pa drug cu ( rtsa brgyad kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa khrag khrig phrag bcu mnyes par byed par 'gyur 55te / thams cad du rdzus te skye zhing 'khor los sgyur 56ba'i rgyal po sha stag tu 'gyur la/ bskal pa gcig la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 7risangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba dag tu na'agyur ro/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis bdag cag ṇi lung bstan pa lha'i rna ba'i khams kyis tsho thos nas/ de dag lha'i bu brgyad khri dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags 11nas lha'i me tog gis yangs pa'i grong khyer thams cad du gtor to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 12'di la yang nyunyerjes su yi rang ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rjes su yi rang 14lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub kyi tshul 'phel bar mdzad du gsol zhes kyang gsol to/ /de dag rjes su yi rang ba'i mod la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer chen po'i srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to15/ /srog chags khri nyis stong ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam sapar dag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub 1 sems dpa' gang gis bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du thabs la mkhas pa med par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad 18pa bas/ gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di som nyi 19dang 61wa 280

bcas pas thos na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du skyed na41tshogang gis som nyi med par thos pa lta ci smos/ gang gis 5yi ger 'dri ba dang /lung nod pa dang / 'chang ba dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa lta ci smos/ 'jam dpal de lta bas na dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'dod pas kyang chos 'di la bslab ri ripar bya'o/ /rang byang chub thob par 'dod pas kyang chos 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas kyang chos 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis rang gi lam ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ma ma kho bo la kha zas byin cig dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 5zhal zas dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byin 6gyi ma mas khar 7ba'i snod zas ro brgya dang ldan pas bkang ste/ khye'u rin chen ri byin la byin no/ /de nas khye'u rin chen byinapo)gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad nyu 7mi zad pa'i bden pa gang lags pa'i bden pa des na dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad tshim par ma gyur gyi bar du khar 11ba'i snod 'di yongs su 'grib par ma gyur cig /de nas khye'u rin chen byin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed 12bkang nas dge slong gi dge 'dun la smras pal/ btsun pa rnams bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du gang gis bdag la 'bras bu chen por 'gyur ba'i bsod snyoms 'di bzhes te/ gang lus kyis yon sbyong bar mi byed pa dang / sems kyis sbyong bar mi byed pa dang / gang la phul na bsod nams su mi 'gyur ba dang / rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ba dang /gang lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las dang mi ldan pa dang /61—281

gang 'dus byas la mi gnas pa dang / gang 71༷'dus ma byas la mi gnas pa dang /gang so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams kyis ma gos pa dang / nyan thos kyi chos rnams la mi rten 2pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la nges par zhumi 'byung (na)ba dang /nges par 5'byung bar mi dzino'adod pa desam ribazhes shig /de nas dge slong gi dge 'dun de dag gi nang nas sus kyang snod de (nyam blangs (9)so/ /khye'u rin chen byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa dag bdag kyang sbyin par 'dod pa lags/khyed kyang gsol bar bzhed pa lags te/ bdag btsun pa rnams las ci yangatsha kyere ba ma mchis kyi 11bzhes shig /'jam dpal gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag 'bum gyi sangs rgyas kyi 12zhing gi yon tan bkod pa de bas kyang ches bye ba phrag 'bum las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa/ bdag gi /lhasangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang yin pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i 8tshig des na khar tshaba'i snod 'di las khyed thams cad kyi lhung bzed rnams gang bar gyur cig /khar tshaba'i snod 'di yang yongs su zad par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas dge slong gi 1 dge 'dun thams cad kyi lhung bzad de dag gang bar gyur to/ /de nas khye'u rin chen 12byin gyis 19yangs pa'i grong khyer gyi skye bo'i ri tshotshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa des tshim par byas so/ /bsod snyoms de yang zad par ma gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u rin chen byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rin chen byin lnga po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i yon yongs su sbyong ba ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus mi dmigs pa dang / sems mi dmigs pa dang / sbyin pa la mngon par zhen pa med pa 61—282

dang / rnam par smin pa mi 'dod pa dang / len pa po rnams la rnam par smin pa med pa'o/ /rin chen byin bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpas rtag tu mngon du byi7bya ba ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / snying rje chen po dang /bdag gi las kyi rnam par smin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal khye'u rin chen byin 'di bskal pa sum cu nan bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das stobs dang grags pa don yod pa zhes bya bar 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro//de'i 'khor lke ridu 'dus pa yang mtha' yas par 'gyur te/ thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag go/ /de dag kyang 'od mtha' yas pa dang / tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ri ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung 5bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya bar zung shig6 /chos nyid kyi skye bo zhes bya bar yang zung shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 8tu bsod snyoms bzhes nas 9rigashegs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal 1 61—283

gnyis mi mnga' ba/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la mchog tu gzhol bar mdzad pa/sangs rgyas kyi gnas pas gnas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ sgrib pa med pa'i rtogs (1)pa brnyes pa/ phyir mi zlog rko pa'i chos dang ldan pa/ spyod yul gyis mi 'phrogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa rgyun mi gcod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa (5༄rnam par 'jog pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi dam pa'i la pha rol tu byon pa pa/ dus gsum la mnyam pa nyid tshar phyin pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du zhugs pa'i sku dang ldan pa / chos thams cad la the tsom 6med pa'i mkhyen pa mnga' ba/ spyod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i blo mnga' ba/ chos mkhyen pa la nem nur mi mnga' ba/rnam par ma brtags pa'i sku mnga' ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 97riye shes yang dag par blangs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas pa gnyis su med pa dam pa'i pha rol tu byon 8pa/ de bzhin gshegs pamanyu)ma 'dres pa rnam par thar par tshamadzad pa'i ye shes kyi mthar phyin pa/ mtha' dang dbung 1)med pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa/ chos kyi dbyings dam pa can/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par bskal pa bgrangs pa thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tu ba rgyun mi gcod pa'i sku mnga' ba pad ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ dge slong 'bum phrag drug cu rim gnyis dang thabs cig cipa 15la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / 'od srung chen po dang / ma 'gags pa dang / rab 'byor dang / kā kyā'i tshabu dang / ka pi na chen po dang / nag pa 1 dang / dga' bo dang / chu klung 'od sung dang / ga yā 18 61wa 290

'od srung dang / ltengam1)rgyas 'od srung dang / byams ma'i bu gang po dang / ba lang bdag dang / lam phran bstan chadang / gyad bu nor dang / seng ldeng ri nags pa dang / skul byed dang / gsus po che chen po dang / sgra gcan zin dang ske/ kun dga' bo dang / de dag la sogs pa dge slong 'bum phrag drug cu ( rirtsa gnyis po de dag thams cad kyang chos gcig la yang dag par 55tshogazhol ba/'phags pa'i spyod yul la gnas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshul la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang gzhi med pa nam mkha'i spyod yul ba sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang mi rten par gnas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa kun nas ldang ba thams cad dang bral ba sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang spyod yul la zhugasalgepa'i shes pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings ji snang ba'i tshul la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos kyi tshul gcig la yang dag par gzhol ba sha stag go / /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon du phyogs pa sha stag go//thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam rgyun ma bcad pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yid phyir ma log pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang shes rab dang ye shes mngon par grub pa'i yid dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang lhag mthong dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thabs kyi yul dang / spyod yul la57nges par byung ba sha stag go/ /dge slong ma skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo 61—291

dang / dge slong ma grags 'dzin la sogs pa dge slong ma 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis dang yang thabs cig 1)ste/ thams cad kyang dkar po'i chos shin tu yongs su bsdus pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la nye bar gyur pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi snang ba'i tshul la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos thams cad dngos po med par rab tu rtogs pa sha stag go/ /chos thams cad la mtshan nyid med par zhugs pa/ chos thams cad yang dag pa'i mthar rig pa/ chos thams cad ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / gnyen po med par mos pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la rab tu gnas pa sha stag go / /thams cad kyang 'dul ba'i sems can ji lta ba de bzhin du rnam par mi rtog nasacing lhun gyis grub par gzugs dang / lus dang / kha dog dang /spyod lam shin tu ston pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang yang thabs (gecigane pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / kun nas 'dren 55nodang / kun tu sprul dzinodang / kun tu shes rab dang / kun tu mig dang / kun tu 'od dang / kun tu snang ba dang /kun tu 'od zer dang / kun tu rtog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu blo dang / shugs chen dang / shugs chen 'dzin dang /rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po'i rgyal po dang /brtson 'grus chen pos rnam par gnon dang / rtsal chen dpa' ba dang / cher 61—292

bsgyings7)dang / bsgyings pa chen po'i stobs dang / tshogs kyi dbang po chen po dang / spos kyi bal glang glang po che chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba chen po dang / zla ba bzang dang / yon tan zla ba dang / rin chen zla ba dang / kun tu snang ba'i zla ba dang / chos dri ma med pa'i zla ba dang / rnam par snang byed zla ba dang / rnam par bsgrags pa'i zla ba dang —/ 'od zer rab tu gtong ba'i zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla gang〈midang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / tshangs pa'i dbang pos bsgrags pa'i dbyangs dang / sa'i sgra dbyangs dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi sgra dbyangs dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i dbyangs dang / chos kyi rnga chen sgra dbyangs dang / kun tu go bar byed pa'i dbyangs dang / mi rtog rnam par mi rtog dbyangs dang / sa stengasasgra dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbyangs kyi yan lag thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i dbyangs dang / kun nas snying po dang ske/ kun tu dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / yon tan snying po dang / rnam par snang mdzad snying po dang / rin chen snying po dang / zla ba'i snying po dang /nyi ma'i snying po dang / snang byed snying po dang / pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / blo gros bzang po dang / blo gros chen po dang /khyad par blo gros dang / rnam grags blo gros dang / rgyal chen blo gros dang /bla ma'i blo gros dang / 'phel ba'i blo gros dang / mtha' yas 4blo gros dang /yangs pa'i blo gros dang / sangs rgyas blo gros dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya rimatsho dang / brtan pa'i 61—293

blo gros dang / rdo rje blo gros dang / sangs rgyas mngon sum blo gros dang / ri rab mar me dang / mar me chen po dang / chos kyi sgron ma'i mar me dang /phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i mar me dang / kun tu mar me dang (1 / mun pa thams cad sel ba'i mar me dang / 'gro ba thams cad la snang ba'i mar me dang /gcig tu snang ba'i mar me dang / zla ba'i mar me dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma'i mar me dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nuratshunagyur pa dang / lag na rin chen gzhon nur gyur pa dang / lag na phyag rgya rin chen gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rin chen 'od zer gzhon nur gyur pa dang /nam mkha' mdzod gzhon nur gyur pa dang / sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gzhon nur gyur pa dang / dra ba can gyi 'od gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rnam par sel ba gzhon nur gyur pa dang / bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba gzhon nur gyur pa dang / dpal gyi snying po gzhon nur gyur pa dang / seng ge gzhon nur gyur pa dang / zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa dang / zla ba'i 'od zer gzhon nur gyur pa dang / mchog gi blo gros gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rgyan bkod pa gzhon nur gyur pa dang / lag na pad ma dang / lag na rdo rje dang / nyi 'od dang / nor bu dang / glog dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon 4pa'i 'od dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yul thams cad las nges par 'byung ba'i blo gros dang /rdul 5 med rnam par gnon dang / rnam dag rnam 965par gnon dang / phung po 61—294

rnam par gnon dang / skye mched rnam par gnon dang / khams rnam par gnon dang / stong pa nyid rnam par gnon dang / mtshan ma med pa rnam par gnon dang / smon pa med pa rnam par gnon dang / skye ba med pa rnam par gnon dang / 'gag pa med pa rnam par gnon dang / 'gro ba med pa rnam par gnon dang / 'ong ba med pa rnam par gnon dang / 'chi 'pho med pa rnam par gnon dang / mi skye ba rnam par gnon dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal7rnam par gnon dang / 'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon dang /mtha' yas rnam par gnon dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam par gnon dang / chos thams cad5gyirnam par gnon dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad rnam par gnon dang /mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa rnam par gnon dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa rnam par gnon dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' rnam par gnon dang / de bzhin gshegs pas rnam par gnon dang / mnyam pa nyid rnam par gnon dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos dbyings rnam par gnon dang / bdud yul mi gos dang / bdud las rgyal dang —/ bdud las rgyal chen po dang / gtsug na rin po che dang / 'od zer stong gi 'od 'phro dang / mngon par 'byung〈gudaka' dang / rab tu thub dka' dang / rtogs dka' dang / bsnyen par dka' ba'i blo dang / ngan 'gro skemadza4dang ske/ bzang skyong dang / dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang / ded dpon bzang po dang / mis byin dang / chu lha'i lha dang / zla ba'i lha dang / dri ma med kyis byin dang / dri ma med par grags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 61—295

sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed 0)thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'jig rten gyi (na khams gzhan dang gzhan dag nas 'dus ri pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba la dpyod ri pa dang / thabs dang / tshul dang / 'dul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos la 'god pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam (5thams cad la dpyod pa'i tshul shes pa rab 'byam la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa'i spyod yul shes pa la dpyod cing so sor rtog pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang spros pa thams cad shin tu chad cing spyod pa len pa rnam par chad de sems can gyi khams thams cad sdud pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang mtha' dang dbung 56med pa'i chos kyi tshul la 'jug pa la shin tu mkhas57༄pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa chud mi za ba mi dmigs par dpyod cing so sor rtog pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / dbang po dang / rtsom pa dang / sbyor ba la shin tu dpyod cing so sor rtog pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i don dang tshig dang / yi ge gzung ba dang blang ba shes pa yang dag par 'dzin cing rtog pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'jig rten pa dang /61—296

'jig rten las 'das pa dang / mtha' dang dbungatsha11med pa'i chos kyi tshul la 'jug⑧pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang ske/ dus dang rim pa'i tshul la so sor rtog pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gcig gis de ma thag tu thob par gnas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig⑧la 'chi 'pho dang / 'byung ba dang / skye ba dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dka' bar spyod pasasbyor ba dang / byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo skorarkub dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi phyir sems bskyed cing byang chub rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang ma bral ba sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can gcigatso)gi sems kyi57)dmigs pa la 'jug pas sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems kyi dmigs pa la mkhas pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang rang byung gi ye shes kyi sa las ma58)bskyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis thob par sbyong bane1)las phyir mi ldog pa sha stag gol/ /thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par 'du byed pa'i stobs rgyun mi gcod cing mngon par 'du7mi byed pa shes pa'i tshul la zhugs pa sha stag go / /thams cad kyang sems can gcig gi bya ba la bskal pa mtha' yas par spyod pa kun57tu 'dzin par byin gyis rlob pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams 61—297

cad kyang phyad 1par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 2 bar byin gyis rlob tshogacing gdul bya'i khams 'gro ba thams cad 'dzud pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par dag pa'i gnas la 'jug pa dang / sbyong ba'i54)stobs kyi khyad par dang smon lam phun sum tshogs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi khyad par gyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad kyi thad du 'gro zhing skul ba la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul kun tu 'dzin pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs rgyun mi gcod par byed pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas 'byung ba kun tu ston par byed pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi 'jig rten gyi 5khams yongs su sbyong bar byed pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod par byed pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings sgrib pa med pa la zhugs pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang nam mkha'i khams ltar tshad med pa'i chos dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings nel 'jug pa mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang las kyis kun nas bslang ba ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par smin pa la mos pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang rgyus kun nas 7bslang ba ji lta ba bzhin du 'bras bu la mos pa sha stag 61—298

go / /thams cad kyang rgya'i 'bur kun tu 'byung ba lta bur chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang mig yor dang ske/ gzugs brnyan ltar ston pa'i chos mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs kyi rnam par rig pa brag ca tsho17dang mtshungs pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rtsen pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku mtha' yas pa'i mdog yongs su 'grub pa sgrub gupa'i gzugs 5la gnas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang skra tsam gyi khyon gcigashoshel 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang phyogs bcu dag tu skra tsam gyi khyon gcig la 'chi 'pho /ra dang / 'byung ba dang /skye ba dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyad 6par sbyor ba 7dang /byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / mngon par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor rinab dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang skyil mo krung dzi'egacig gis phyogs bcu dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi nam mkha' rgyas par 7'gengs par shes pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang zhing thams cad kyi rgyan zhing gcig tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang zhing gcig gi rgyan bkod pa zhing thams cad du kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang phyogs bcu dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gang dag 61—299

yin pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi 'khor du ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go(17/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi 'khor gang yin pa de phyogs bcu dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor du kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos thams cad namatha' dang dbung ci )med par ston pa la mkhas pa gisgyusha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi lus rang gi lus su kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku sangs rgyas gcig gi skur zhugs par kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas gcig gi sku sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skur zhugs par kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rang gi lus su chud par kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can gcig gi lus la dus gsum gyi sems can rnams kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang 'das pa'i dus la ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus la55)'das pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa nesha stag go/ /thams cad kyang lus gcig gis ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 7ral lus dpag tu med grangs med pa las ldang ba la mkhas pa sha stag go58)/ /lus dpag tu med cing grangs med pa dag gis ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs la/ lus gcig las ldang bar kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can 9thams cad kyi 1 lus snyed kyi mngon par byang chub pa kun tu ston pa la 61—300

mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi lus la sems can gcig gi7lus kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go / /sems can gcig gi lus la sems can thams cad kyi lus kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi5gyilus las ④sangs rgyas kyi sku kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku las sems can gyi lus kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems can gyi lus chos kyi skur kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang zhing thams cad kyi rgyan bkod pa de dag zhing gcig tu kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag goX/ /zhing gcig gi rgyan bkod pa de dag zhing thams cad du kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang chos kyi sku sems can gyi lus su kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang spu'i khung bu gcig tu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'jug par byed pa kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i smon lam gyi stobs kyi gnas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad na gdul bya'i sems can yongs su smin pa ji lta ba de bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu7kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang bskal pa bgrangs pa 7thams cad du 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rgyun mi gcod pa'i lus kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang sems bskyed pa gcig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig 61—301

rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams re re na sgo nga las skyes pa dang / mngal nas 41skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang /rdzus nate skyes pa dang / gzugs can dang / gzugs can ma yin pa dang dzo —sku/'du shes can dang / 'du shes can ma yin pa dang / rkang gnyis pa dang /rkang bzhi pa dang / rkang mang cadang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa sems can gdul bya yongs su smin pa thams cad ji lta ba de bzhin du lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par spyod ci'i pa dang /spyod lam dang bya ba la 'jug pa'i gnas kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med/grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ ri tshad med / brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag 'jug par byed kyang sems can la gnod pa med pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang bskal pa dpag tu med grangs med/ bsam gyis 6mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag yud tsam gcig 75tu byin gyis rlob pa nakun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag go9/ /yud tsam gcig 1 snabaskal pa dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/gzhal du med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag tu byin gyis nyu1rlob pa la mkhas pa sha stag go/ /thams cad kyang spyod lam ji lta rbus sems can rnams yongs su smin par 'gyur ba de lta 12de ltar lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi 61—302

rtog par gzugs kyi lus kyi kha dog dang / spyod lam kun tu ston pa la mkhas pa sha stag ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / gzhan dag thams cad kyang yon tan bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med grangs med pa dag dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa nas 'dus pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dpag tu med/ grangs med/bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ tshad med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa sha stag dang yang thabs cig 1go/ /'jig rten gyi ②khams 'di nas kyang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgya re re yang (snyegayog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /brgya byin bye ba phrag brgya dang / lha'i rgyalas3)po rab 'thab bral bye ba phrag brgya dang / lha'i rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan bye ba phrag brgya dang / lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul bye ba 5phrag brgya dang / lha'i rgyal po gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa 'bye ba me phrag brgya la lha'i rgyal po re re yang g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i naphyir dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /ded dpon la sogs pa bdud kyi ris kyi lha bye ba phrag mang po dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang /61—303

mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /srin po'i rgyal po 'bum phrag bcwa0snabargyad dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po 'bum phrag brgyad cu dang / rigs(5)sngags 'chang gi rgyal po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa lnga dang / drang srong 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu thams cad kyang mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa sha stag dang / rlung gi rgyal po chen po rnam par 'thor rlung dang / rnam par 'thor rlung chen po g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag dang / tshangs pa bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs pa chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang /ri sku 'od chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med 'od bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'od gsal bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med dge bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge rgyas bye ba phrag brgya dang /sprin med bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'bras bu che 44dbye ba phrag brgya dang / bsod nams skyes bye ba phrag brgya dang / gya rnam snang bye ba phrag brgya dang / shin tu mthong bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi che ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi gdung ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'og min gyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dag la tshangs pa chen po re re yang g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das la5debalta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang /mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya (ne ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i 61—304

phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /klu'i dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang ske/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang / dri za'i dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi'am ci'i dbang po bye ba phrag brgya dang /lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po bye ba phrag brgya re re yang g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang /mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /mi dang0)ma yin pa dpag tu med grangs med pa dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal gyi lha gang dag yin pa dag dang / lhun po dang / lhun po chen po dang / btang bzung dang / btang bzung ②chen po dang / gangs ri dang / khor ②yug dang ske/ khor༄yug chen po la sogs pa ri rnams kyi lha gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad gnas dang bcas te⑤/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang /phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang ske/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /rgya 61—305

mtsho dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang / chu klung dang / chu bran dang / mtsho bran7)dang / mtshe'u dang / chu mig dang / 'bab chu rnams kyi lha gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad kyang gnas dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal ri chodang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang / 'or garnams kyi lha gang dag yin pa de dag kyang rang gis 4riganas dang lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 57'phye chen po'i gnas rnams kyi lha gang dag yin pa de dag kyang rang rang gi gnas su zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 6bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 7mthus sems can 'ga' la yang gnod pa med cing sgrib pa med do/ /zla ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgya mtsho bye ba phrag brgya re re yang g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 98)bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /klu'i rgyal po chen po 59ma dros pa yang 61—306

'khor dang bcas7)te bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba kyi der lhags so/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i sems can thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dang / phyag bya ba'i phyir dang / mchod pa'i phyir dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la mos pa/ theg pa chen po la gzhol ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes 'dod pa sha stag go/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi kyikha dog dang / gzugs dang / gzi brjid dang / 'od kyis (4)'khor thams cad sbyorazil gyis mnan te/lam ⑥me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na nyi mas 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med pa phyung ste srin bu me khyer thams cad zil gyis mnan nas lam 6)me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyang brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong 8ba thams cad zil gyis mnan te lam tho)me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa tu )lnga la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin gyi 511dra ba las grol ba ni skar ma'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis mnan nas lam 32me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o / /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyang brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong hurteb thams cad spa bkong ste 1rizil gyis mnan nas lam 15me/lhan ne/ lhang nge ste7/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar dpal gyis rab tu 'bar te/sku mi g.yo/ mi 'gyur/ mi 'gul bar lam 12me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /de 61—307

nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni sku mi g.yo/ mi 'gyur/ mi 'gul bar bzhugs 1)so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib (0pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa 'di la 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni rab tu 'byung bar mngon du phyogs shing khyim nas mngon par 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni rab tu byung zhing dka' ba spyod pa la gnas par shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi snying por gshegs par shes ①so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi snying po la 5sgrubazhugs par shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni bdud 'khor grangs med dpag tu med pas bskor ba bcom par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dpag tu med55)grangs med pa dag gis ded dpon chen po rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes spro bar byed par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas brgya byin rnams gsol ba 'debs par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni tshangs pa rnams la (nyugasol ba 'debs par shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni 'jig rten skyong 9)ba rnams bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sbyin pa'i gtam58༄ston par shes so/ /'khor 61—308

'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni 0)bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la tshul khrims kyi gtam ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni bzod pa'i gtam/ kha cig gis ni brtson 'grus kyi gtam/ kha cig gis ni bsam gtan gyi gtam/kha cig gis ni shes rab kyi gtam bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so / /kha cig gis ni thabs la mkhas pa'i gtam/ kha cig gis ni rdzu 'phrul gyi gtam / kha cig gis ni smon lam gyi gtam/ kha cig gis ni ye shes kyi gtam bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gtam/ kha cigasagis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gtam/ kha cig gis ni theg pa chen po'i gtam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni sems can dmyal bar skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das7bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dud 'gror skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni yi dgas su skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes soX / /kha cig gis ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i nang du skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so / /kha cig gis57ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su skye ba dang / kha cig gis ni 'thab bral gyi gnas su skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dga' ldan gyi gnas su skye ba dang / kha cig gis ni 'phrul dga'i gnas su skye ba dang / kha cig gis ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su skye ba dang / kha cig gis ni bdud kyi gnas su skye ba 61—309

dang / kha cig gis ni tshangs hu)pa'i gnas su skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /de bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs 'khor dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang /'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang /sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che dang / mi che ba dang /mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang gudang / shin tu mthong dang / 'og min dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched du skye ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /'jam dpal 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni mir skye ba'i chos rnams/kha cig gis ni 'khor los sgyur sa ba'i rgyal por 'gyur rinasaba'i chos rnams/ kha cig gis ni gling gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi pa'i 'khor los sgyur 55)ba dang / stong gnyis dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi 'khor los sgyur 6ba'i rgyal por 7'gyur ba'i chos rnams bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ston par shes so/ /'jam dpal 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dom do 3)tsam du 'phags par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni rgyang grags tsam du 'phags/ kha cig gis 95ni rgyang grags gnyis tsam du 'phags / kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad tsam du 'phags par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad gnyis tsam du 'phags par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad 61—310

bcu tsam du 'phags paralto)shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad stong du shes so/ /kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad stong phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang —/ bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dpag tshad 'bum dang / kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu par shes so / /kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong par shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tshad 'bum phrag bgrangs pa 9kyilas 'das par shes so/ /'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas〈mikha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku paragaser gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /kha cig gis5snyeni nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya'i567kha dog tu / kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che chen po an+da rnyil gyi kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che mthon ka chen po'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che skar 'od kyi kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che pad ma rā ga'i7kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che brgya byin thogs pa'i kha dog tu / kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che rdo rje snang ba'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che lha thams cad snang ba'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che nyi zla snang ba'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che chu 'dang gi kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che (8)shel gyi kha dog tu shes sa)/ /kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po 11che 'od thams cad bsdus pa'i kha 61—311

dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po cheshiri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gyi kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che7seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i kha dog tu/ kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i gnas rnam par dag pa rin po che bkod pa kun nas 'od zer snang ba'i kha dog tu shes so/ /'jam dpal 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa ②yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i kha dog tu shes so/ /'jam dpal kha dog dang / spyod lam dang / dbyibs gang dang gang kho nas sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog dang / spyod lam dang / dbyibs de dang de kho nar sems can rnams kyis mthong ngo /'jam dpal chos bstan (0pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i chos de dang de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa ston par sems can rnams kyis tshogashes so/ /'jam dpal spyod pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la ⑥'dzud cing 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i spyod pa de dang de la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par sems can rnams kyis shes so/ /'jam dpal gal te shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med / grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal duro/med/tshad med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phyesachen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyis yongs su gang bar gyur la/ shar phyogs su ji lta ba de bzhin du lho dang / de bzhin du nub 61—312

dang —/ de bzhin du byang dang / de bzhin du shar lho dang / de bzhin du lho nub dang / de bzhin du nub byang dang / de bzhin du byang shar dang / de bzhin du steng dang / de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis0)mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med / tshad med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag5)lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dag gis dper na 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ til gyi zhing bzhin du yongs su gang bar gyur pa'i sems can de dag 'jam dpal gal te de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas 'dul ba yin na/ sems can de dang〈khude dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan snga na 'domasregang tsam na 'khod par shes so/ /'jam dpal kha dog dang / spyod lam dang / gnas gang dang gang gis sems can de dag 'dul bar 'gyur bsnyide dang de kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par sems can de dag gis mthong ngo / /'jam dpal chos bstan pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams yongs su smin par 'gyur ba de dang de nyid kyi chos ston par thos so/ /'jam dpal spyod pa gang gis sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i spyod pa de dang de la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa thams cad lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur royi/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste/dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo'i dkyil 'khor nam phyed kyi dus na 'dzam bu'i gling gi 61—313

sems can thams cad kyis so so'i mdun na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dug par shes kyang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni sems can de dag gis bdag ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par 1mo'agyur bar bdag sems can de dag gi (gemadun na 'dug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'jam dpal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pas lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog (gyipar de lta bu'i bya ba 'di 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'khor dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ tshad med/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i dbus na bzhugs na de dag thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par mthong mod kyi/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par goshes par 'gyur bar nga 95)sems can de dag gi 56 mdun du (7sku'adug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang sems can rnams ji lta bus 'dul ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal dper na sems can rnams kyi las kyi (8)tha ma dang / 'bring dang / rab kyi rnam par smin pa'i dbang gis sems can rnams kyi 'du byed tha ma dang / 'bring dang /rab rnams 'byung bar (9 'du byed rnams ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/'on kyang 'du byed de dag lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par tha ma dang /'bring dang / rab rnams kyi bya ba dag la 'jug gonya bye/ /'jam 37dpal de 61—314

bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sems can rnams kyi ①las kyi rnam par smin pa tha ma dang / 'bring dang ske/ rab kyi dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pa tha ma dang / 'bring dang /rab tu sems can rnams kyis mthong yang 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mdzad pa de lta bu de7lhun gyis grub par 'byung ngo50/ /'jam dpal dper na nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya7rigs ma ni ras tha dad56)pa nyid kyi dbang gis (7)kha dog tha dad pa nyid du 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal gal te nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya ras ser po'i steng du bzhag na ni nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya kha dog ser por 'gyur/gal te ras dmar po'i steng du bzhag na ni nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya kha dog dmar por 'gyur/ gal te ras sngon po'i steng du bzhag na ni nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya kha dog sngon por 'gyur te/ de ltar ras kha dog ci dang ci 'dra ba'i steng du bzhag pa de dang de nyid kyi kha dog kho nar 'gyur yang 'jam dpal nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par de'i bya ba de lta bu de 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang sems can tha dad pa nyid kyi dbang gis kha dog tha dad pa nyid du 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal gal te sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bas gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis ni〈0de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya'i 61—315

kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams mu tig gi kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mu tig gi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che an0)da rnyil gyi kha dog lta bus gdul ②bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che an da durnyil gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /'jam dpal gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che mthon ④ka chen po'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ri ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che mthon56)ka chen po'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che 'od thams cad bsdus pa'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che 'od thams cad bsdus pa'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che dbang gi ⑦rgyal po'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che rgyas)mtsho'i gnas rnam par dag pa rin po che bkod pa kun nas 'od zer snang ba'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni hu)de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i gnas rnam par dag pa rin po che bkod pa kun nas 'od zer snang ba'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can7rnams nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gyi kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni de dag gis kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin 61—316

po che seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni/de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /'jam dpal gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron ma'i kha dog lta bus 1stegadul bar ②bya ba yin na ni/de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron ma'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /gal te sems can rnams nor bu rin po che chu 'dang gi kha dog lta bus gdul bar bya ba yin na ni/ ③de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nor bu rin po che chu 'dang gi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /de bzhin du sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i kha dog tu mthong bas gdul bar bya btswayin na ni/ de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i kha dog tu mthong ngo / /de bzhin du sbyar te sems can rnams sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgasasnyedang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i bar gyi kha dog gis gdul bar bya ba yin na ni/ de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro7dang /yi dgas dang / gshin rje'ikhu'ajig rten du skyes pa'i bar gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo ske/ /gzugs med par skyes pa'i bar gyi gzugs dang / lus dang / kha dog dang / spyod lam gang dang gang gis sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i gzugs dang / lus dang / kha dog dang / spyod lam de dang de lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /de bzhin du sgo nga las skyes pa dang / mngal nasalge skyes pashedang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang / rdzus te skyes pa dang /61—317

gzugs can dang / gzugs can ma yin pa dang / 'du shes can dang /'du shes can ma yin pa dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can rnams kyi gzugs dang / lus dang / kha dog dang / spyod lam gang dang gang gis 'dul 3)bar 'gyur ba'i gzugs dang / lus dang / kha dog dang /spyod lam de dang der de bzhin gshegs pa mthong yang de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can 'di dag gis gser gyi5gekha dog tu gyimathong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya'i kha dog tu mthong bar ni ma gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis ni ④nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya'i kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che an da du rnyil gyi kha dog tu mthong bar ni ma gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis ni (6)nor bu rin po che an da 57)rnyil gyi kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la nor bu rin po che mthonatshunasaka chen po'i kha dog tu mthong bar stini ma gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis 7ni nor bu rin po che mthon ka chen po'i kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che 'od thams cad bsdus pa'i kha dog tu mthong bar ni ma gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis ni nor bu rin po che 'od thams cad bsdus pa'i kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi 11rgyal po'i kha dog tu mthong bar ni 1snyem gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis ni 1 nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i gnas 〉rnam par dag pa rin po che bkod pa kun nas 'od zer snang ba'i kha dog tu mthong bar ni ma gyur cig /sems can 'di dag gis ni nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i gnas rnam par dag pa rin po che bkod pa kun nas 'od zer snang ba'i kha dog tu mthong bar gyur la/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal 61—318
