zhing sems can 'dul ba rgyun mi gcod la gtong ba med kyang gnod pa med cing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du'ang gnod pa med de/ rab tu phra ba'i rdul de rgyas par byas pa'ang med/ 'jig rten gyi khams chung ngur byas pa'ang med pa chos kyi dbyings rab tu rtogs shing mkhyen nas gnas pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i chos kyi bla re chen po'o / /mun pa med pa'i dbyings su de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te mun pa dang bcas pa snang bar gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rab rib med pa/ rnam par rab rib med pa'i gnas la sems can pha rol 'dzud pa dang / de na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i rjes su song ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i chos kyi bla re chen po bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi zil gyis gnon pa'i chos kyi bla re chen po bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba shin tu bsgrubs te/thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs sngon nas mtho bas 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rigs thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa la mi gnas shing phyi ma'i mtha' ma'ishesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che 61—436

ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos thams cad la gnas pa bcom zhing dus gsum la mi gnas par spyod pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sna tshogs kyi blang ba med pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyan gcig pa'i ngo bo ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams zad mi shes pas sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' mnyam pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa'i bsod nams zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sems can 'dul ba'i don gyi〈skyedabang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzugs dang kha dog mtha' med par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na chags pa med par bzhugs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig⑧pa med pa bzhi brnyes te/bag tsha ba med par gnas nas khyu mchog seng ge'i sgra sgrog ste/ stag chen po ltar rgol ba rnam par gnonakhucing / me mar lta bu'i kun tu rtog pas chos ston te/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasasakyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal pa nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das mod kyil/ 'on kyang ming mang po rnam par rigasalgepas sems can rnams kyi sbyin 61—437

gnas sbyong0)ste/ ji ltar zhugasalgepa bzhin no/ /de srid du yun ring po nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyang rung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sbyin gnas bskrun pa ni yongs su zad par mi 'gyur te③/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na0ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad las ring ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nasreganas pa'i sems can gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rjes su dran na sku ston par mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba ste/ thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi khyasngon gyi smon lam shin tu rnam par dag pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi tshangs par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nirnams kyi ⑨ma chags pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag cing shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sems can thams cad phung po las byung bar mdzad pa shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sngomasangs rgyas kyi zhing shin tu rnam par dag pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi (gegayog 'khor shin tu rnam par dag pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi tu)chos kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa dang /61—438

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyiphugazugs kyi sku'i mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po rnam par dag cing shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi〈chos kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①bsgribasalgepa med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phung po shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyilasangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa dang / rnam par gnon par mdzad pa dam pa'i mchog brnyes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sukhudus thams cad du 'jig rten gyi yul khams thams cad na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyikhumadzad pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rab tu rnyed pa'i sems can rnams la dus thams cad du sangs rgyas ston pa dang /dus thams cad du sems can shes kyi sems can la chos ston pa dang / dus thams cad du sangs rgyas la sems rab tu dang ba'i sems can la tshad med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / dus thams cad du chos mi 'gyur ba'i lam du 'das pa'i sems can la ye shes rtogs par mdzad pa dang / dus thams cad du 'gro ba thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgyun mi gcod pa dang / dus thams cad du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa mi chags par bzhudasapa dang / dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la thugs rje chen po rgyun mi gcod pa dang / dus thams cad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rnam par sprul pa la bzhugs pa dang / dus thams cad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas sna tshogs su sprul par bzhugs pa dang /61—439

dus thams cad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi mthus chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni dus thams cad du 'jig rten gyi yul khams thams cad na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho'i tshul mi zad pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis7de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa tshad med pa brnyes pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi yul gyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi char 'bebs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang /kha dog gi⑧yi shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pas sngon gyi mtha'5minas smon lam spyod pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyi ma'i mthar 'gro ba thams cad la sangs rgyasasakyi mdzad pa rgyun mi gcod pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can ma lus pa'i ris thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsod nams zil gyis mi gnon pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom 61—440

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa bcu'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin cing mngon par byung ba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos thams cad mi mkhyen pa mi mnga' ba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams thams cad la thugs rje che ba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams tshad med pa'i stobs bcu thams cad dang ldan pa'i spyan dang /gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskoratuba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can thams cad 'dul bar zhugs pa'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba thams cad mngon du rdzogs par sangs rgyas par mdzad pa'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pas 'dul ba'i sems can la 'dul ba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gnyis su med par spyod pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid la dbang ba'i spyan dang / gang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ji ltar sems can btul te smin par mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi mtha'i phyir sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ston pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan bcu'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' yas par ston pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 61—441

'das sems can gyi khams la mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi spyod pa sna tshogs mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang0)/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la gdams pa rjes su bstan pa mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi khams rnam par spyod pa'i nan tan mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gdams pa mtha' yas pa bstan pakhul 'god pa'i sgo dang —/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i rim pa'i khyad par bzhin smon lam gyis 'byung ba mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad la sdud pa dang 'gyur ba mtha' yas par ston pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa dang dad pa bzhin ston pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba de dang de dag tu sangs rgyas thams cad gcigashenas gcig tu bskal par 'byung ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthus bsdus nas yongs su snang zhing / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par rig pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos mtha' yas par ston pa bcu'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 61—442

gzugs kyi sku ①bstan pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsungasagis kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gzungashebs kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis mi 'dzin pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyisnyimadzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gis kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byin gyi brlabs kyis ⑤yul gyi dbang gis brtsam ⑥pa'i yul thams cad kyis kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan gyis kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhing rtsom pas kyang sems can rnams la lasangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsungs pasashekyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can gyi chos kyi snying po bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na/ smon lam rgyun mi gcod cing smon lam brtan pa dang /gnyis su med par bshad pa ji ltar smras pa de bzhin byed pa ste/ 'di ni sems 61—443

can gyi chos kyi snying po dang po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rab tu brtson zhing ma zhum par phyi ma'i mtha' bskal par 'gro zhing yon tan gyi rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po gnyis so / /brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'dul bar 'os pa'i sems can gcig gzigs na yang mi bzhugs par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gshegs te/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po gsum mo / /sems can gyi sems mi 'phrogasalgepa la thugs rje chen po mnyam pa dang /sems can sems rab tu dang ba la thugs rje chen po mnyam pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po bzhi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byungaphuba'ang ma yin/ ma byung ba'ang ma yin/gang nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs nas nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems mi 'jig ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyisasnying po lnga'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsdus nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngo bar 'jug cing 'jig rten gyi phyir mi spyod pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po drug go/ /thog mar sems kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rjes su lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las la slob ste/ thams cad mkhyen par bsngo zhing nyan thos dngaphurang sangs rgyas kyi spyod par ma yin pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po bdun no / /mtha' yas par 'od thams cad kun tu snang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi 61—444

chos thams cad snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems rnam par dag pa 'di snang ba thams cad mtshungs pa7thams cad mtshungs par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po brgyad do/ /'jig rten gyi bde ba thams cad spong ba dang / 'jig rten gyi dga' ba la mi 'dod pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyis ma gos pa'i smon lam thams cad mtshungs par 'jig rten gyi bde ba thams cad dang ldan pas sdug bsngal thams cad 'jig cing spros pa thams cad med pa ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po dgu'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul la dad pas dka' ba dang〈gedaka' thub kyi sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs bsrung ba la brtson pas 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam par sdug bsngal thams cad rig50pas rig cing stobs dang sa bcu'i bar gyi mthar byung ba ste/ 'di ni sems can gyi chos kyi snying po bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can gyi chos kyi snying po bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mi chags par spyod pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du gshegs pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad na bzhugs pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad na 'chag bzhengs bzhugs pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad na chos ston pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 61—445

ma lus pa thams cad dang / dga' ldan gnas su gshegs pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba la7)yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du tshad med pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gshegs pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa la rnam par gzigs shing sems kyi skad cig ma gcig la cho 'phrul gsum ston cing sems can 'dul ba yang mi chags par spyod pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gcig gis tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab par gshegs shing sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa chen po spyod pa yang mi chags par spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab par gshegs shing sems can tshad med pa bcu rdul yab ma lus pa thams cad la ston pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi mtha' yas bsdus pa yang mi chags par spyod pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mi chags par spyod pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku'i mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yan lag drug cu (gemachog dam pa dang ldan zhing gsung gi yan lag brgya rtsa lnga yongs su bzung ba brgya stong du mas brgyan pa mtha' dang mu med pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag 61—446

rnam par dag pa brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / don tshig 'bru rab tu dang ba dang / 'jigs pa med pa chen pos7)mi 'jigs shing bag tsha ba med par seng ge'i sgra bsgragasalgepas chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sems can thams cad la thos pa dang / snang ba dang / shes par mdzad pa dngas/sems can rnams kyi bsam pa sna tshogs dang / dbang po sna tshogs kyi rim pa so sor slong zhing 'dul ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung gi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi yid kyi las stobs bcus brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad ting nge 'dzin chen pos rgyas shing sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco ④brgyad kyi rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan te chags pa med pa'i yul gyi spyod yul ba/ chos kyi dbyings la rab tu gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi yan lag brnyes te/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyan⑧dang / sems kyi skad cig ma gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi dus gsum ma lus pa dang / chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa thams cad rab tu mkhyen pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyi rgyanaphudam pa mchog bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis brjod du med pa'i 'od bye ba khrag khrig rab tu btang nas/ 'od zer brjod du med pa gcig nas gcig tu 'od zer gyi dra bar bskor cing zhing0)medam1)bcu rdul7yab ma lus pa thams cad du snang bar byas pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi mun pa'i rigs ston pa/ 'dzum7pa ston pa'i zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs du ma kha dog brgya stong bye ba khrag khrig tshad med grangs med pa byung bas 61—447

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can gyi khams la snang bas shes par byed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang mi bral7)zhing / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gdon mi za ba phyir mi ldog pa brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung zhing bzhugs pa'i sku rnam par dag pas dga' ba med par 'byung ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od kyi rgyan5gemachog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gzhan du lung ston pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgrib pa med par mdzad pa ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rab rib med pas 'jig rten thams cad du 'dzum pa mdzad pa ston pa'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /tshad med pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi sku sgrib ②pa med cing rnam par dag pa/ chos thams cad la ma chags pa mtha' med pa'i chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbungasamed par chud pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang ma 'dres pa/ 'jig rten thams cad de kho na nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba 'jig rten thams cad 'jig rten las 'das par spyod par 'jug pa'i tshig gi lam chad ⑤cing brjod du med par chud pa/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang bral ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od tshad med pa/'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad dbyer med pa'i 'od brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rgyan yikha dog sna tshogs du ma'i rkyen kun nas mi 'phrogs lnga)pa'i 'od/ 'jig rten thams cad la ma chags pa'i 'od/ tshad med 61—448

pa sgribatupa med pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mdzod thams cad khang pa ltar gyur pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od kyi rgyan⑧bla na med pa mchog dam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi kha dog mtha' yas pa/kha dog 'tsher ba/ kha dog rang bzhin gyis 'tsher ba/ kha dog tshad med pa/sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / dad pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par rig parasabyed pa'i kha dog ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mi zlog〈pe pa'i kha dog dang / kha dog thams cad kyi mchog brnyes pas de las gzhan pa'i kha dog dang / khams gsum gyi kha dog thams cad khyab pa zil gyis mnan pa ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi kha dog gi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dge ba shin tu rnam par dag pas 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs dge ba rin po che 'byung ba'i⑧'jig rten thams cad kyis ma smad pa/ kha na ma tho ba med pas chos thams cad kyi de kho na mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam par spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i rgyan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sgribasrepa med cing rigs rnam par dag pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes las byung zhing 'dus pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs dang /gdung rnam par dag pa'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku byams pa chen po'i stobs kyis brgyan stipa shin tu dang zhing rnyog pa med7pa'i kun tu rtog pa'i sku'i 'du byed nyam〈nyerangs pa/ shin tu rnam par phye ba blta bas mi ngoms pasang/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs 'gro ba thams cad kyi sbyin gnas dang / skyabs med kyimo/rtemachog bla na med pa so sor 61—449

'dzin pa rnams la thugs brtse zhing phan par bzhed pa/ sems can thams cad la ye shes chen po'i byin gyis rlob pa bsod nams chen ponye'aphags pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams mtha' yas pa'i zhing sems can thams cad la yon tan dang ye shes kyi phung po thams cad rnam par 'phel bar mdzad pa ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byams pa chen po dang / thugs rje chen po dang / bsod nams kyilamatha'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa bcu'ol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o// //'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis7mi khyab pa bstan pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag po dbang gisnyichos bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi bdag po dbang gis chos thams cad snang bar mdzad pa dang /mtha' med pa'i tshig dang 'bru la spobs pa chags pa med pa dngakyi/ chos ma lus pa thams cad yongs su ston pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos dang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag pos ji ltar sems can gnas pa'i 'dul zhing yongs su smin pa de ltar smon lam dang chos ston te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i chos gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag pos 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos kyang ⑦sems can gcig la yang gnod pa med pa tshad med grangs med pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad gcig nas gcig tu 61—450

'degatupa dang / 'jog pa dang / sadasapa dang / 'phen pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig dang / phyogs gcig nas gcig tu 'jog kyang sems can gyi khams kun nas gti mi nimug cing the tsom ④med de/'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos gsum mo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag po'i sems kyi skad cig ma gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs7te/ rgyan sna tshogasashe'ajig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu byin gyis rlob pa〈kyedang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lhab lhub dang rgyan ston pa dang / grangs med pa'i bskal par 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du nyon mongs pa med pa'i lus su ston cing lhab lhub dang / rgyan thams cad kyi kha dog mi zad par ston pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu kun 'brang bar byin gyis rlob pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos bzhi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag pos sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can gzigs〈nyenas sems can gcig gi phyir brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal par skyil mo krungacami 'jig pa gang zag de la dgongs kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang thugs la skyo ba mi mnga' zhing 'dul ba'i dus su de las mi 'da' ste/ ji ltar gang zag re re la yang de bzhin du rim pas 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mthar tshe la dbang ba byin gyis brlabs te bzhugs kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la kun du bsnyengs pa mi mnga'/ skyo ba mi mnga' ste / de bzhin du sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyisalge61—451

'dul ba'i gang zag gi phyir rim pas rab tu skyong ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos lnga'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag pos sems kyi skad cig ma de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du 'brang zhing gshegs nas / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'gyur ba rgya mtsho med pa bcu rdul yab ma lus pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings gcig nas gcig tu thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa dang / phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rigs kyishedra ba bzlog cing tshad med par gshegs te/ chos kyi dbyings ston pa dang / mi 'phrogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor5gyi ba ste(ge/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos 0drug go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi (55bdag pos sems kyi skad cig ma la sems can gyi khams 'dul ba'i phyir sems kyi skad cig ma la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang 'di ltar mngon du rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'ang med/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad las mngon par sangs rgyas pa'ang med/ mngon du7rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'ang med / slob pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub tu phye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sgrib pa ④med par rtogs shing rigashepa'ang med de/ sems can 'dul ba'i phyir sangs rgyas rnam par sprul pa chen po'i yul rgyun mi gcod cing dpag tu med pa'i ye shes brnyes te 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi7chos bdun no / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag pos gang spyan gyi skye mched kyis 61—452

sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de snyan gyituskye mched kyis kun tu sgrub/ gangasasnyan gyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de shangs kyi skye mched kyis kun tu sgrub/gang shangs kyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de ljags kyi skye mched kyis kun tu sgrub/ gang ljags kyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de sku'i skye mched kyis kun tu sgrub/ gang sku'i skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de thugs kyi skye mched kyis kun tu sgrub/ gang thugs kyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de'i bar gyis 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sna tshogs su rtsom zhing 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par phye ba brnyes te/ de bzhin du rtsom pa re res sgrub cing sprul pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rtsom pa gcig ji lta ba bzhin du rtsomasapa ma lus pa thams cad kyang de bzhin te / 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos brgyad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis〈sku)dbang pos rang gi sku'i ba spu gcig gi bu gar sems can re re'i lus kyang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ltar che ba'i sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad bcug cing nang du 'dus par mdzad de/ de la sems can re res kyang bskal pa grangs med par gnas kyang sems can de dag la gnod pa yang med / kun tu gnod pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu gom pa gcig 3)gis gshegs te 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gis sangs rgyas byung zhing sangs rgyas byung ba dang / de dag gis brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'das te/ de'i dbang gis sems can gyi snying pos brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i chos kyi 'khor 61—453

lo bskoratubar shes so/ /de la ba spu'i bu ga'i sems can brjod du med pa dag gcig nas gcig tu sangs rgyas su gyur te/ gcig nas gcig tu brjod du med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor7zhing / gcig nas gcig tu brjod du med pa'i chos kyi dbyings ston/ gcig nas gcig tu 'das pa brjod du med pa dang /gcig nas gcig tu ma 'ongs pa brjod du med pa dang / gcig nas gcig tu da ltar byung ba brjod du med pa snang bar byed/ mtha' dang dbungasamed pa'i nam mkha'i khams skabs byed pa ston/ sems can thams cad 'ong ba dang /'gro ba dang / thams cad skye ba'i skye mched dang / bsgribs pa med pa dang /'dod chags la yongs su spyod par 'jug pa mkhyen te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyisnyesangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos dgu'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag pos chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad pad mo'i rgyan chen pos brgyan te pad mo'i snying po'i seng ge'i gdan la de bzhin gshegs pa re re bzhugs pa dang / chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang / sku dpag tu med pa dang / byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par rol pa ston te/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa gcig pa de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam par sems can gyi snying po re re sems kyi skad cig ma la byin gyis rlobalgebo/ /sems kyi skad cig ma gcig ji lta ba bzhin du sems kyi skad cig ma thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar pad ma'i le'u dang / rnam par dag cing mngon du rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de ltar chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / med bcu rdul yab brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med 61—454

pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su rtsom pa sna tshogs kyi rim pa dang / med bcu rdul yab brjod du med pa'i zhing rnam par dag pa dang / sna tshogs kyi mtshan nyid dang / mtshan nyid sna tshogs med pa dang / rigs med bcu rdul yab tshad med pa dang / grangs med pa'i dus 'gyur ba dang / mi chags pa ston pa dang / tshad med pa'i bturgyas pa'i dad pa dang / skad cig ma sna tshogs dang / gnas med pa dang / skad cig ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /tshad med par gshegs pa dang / sems kyi skad cig ma dang / sems kyi skad cig ma gcig la thams cad ston te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mchodashedu mdzad pa ni ③mi mnga'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag po'i dbang gi chos bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su rdzogs pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gang gis bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan mtshan ④ro re nas yongs su dag nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ 'di ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang —/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang / spyod pa rnam par dag 61wa 455

pa phun sumatsho)tshogs pa yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tusamangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can 'dul zhing yongs su smin par mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi bdag po 'gro ba thams cad gang gis kyang zil gyis mi gnon pa yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhing yongs su dag par mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzugs kyi sku'i mtshan dang dpe byad gti mug med par ston pa yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs nas7byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas yongs su༄mya ngan lasasnyi'ada' ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi7byin gyisakhubarlabs ma yin pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen nas spros pa med pa dang / dge ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs〈ston cing snang bar mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas 61—456

bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa dang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos thams cad bltar med pa dang / phan tshun shes par mi rung ba dang / ma bcing btudang / ma grolaphub dang / chagazung du med pa dang / reg par mi rung ba dang / ma byung ba'i chos thams cad la mnga' dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes shing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos de dag thams cad yang dag pa nyid dang / de kho nasredang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa'i chos thams cad dang / bdag med pa dang /gzung ba med pa'i chos rnams kyi de kho na'i mtha' la chags pa med pa'i dbang du gyur pa de la dbang gis chen po bslabs te/ bslab pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing chos thams cad la gzigs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa gnyis pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mtshan ma thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral zhing mtshan ma thams cad la mi gnas pa/mtshan ma mngon par mkhyen pas mi chags pa de'i ngo bo nyid dang ngo bo nyid med pa dang / ji ltar ngo bo nyid smra ba'i tshul gyis rjes su song ba/ grangs med pa'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma'i tshogs ⑤kyi sku rnam par dag pa sna tshogs kyi zhing thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang spyod pa'i mtshan ma zad par ston pa/ mun pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po yang dag par rab tu 'chang ba mun pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la sgron ma chen pos snang ba ston te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa gsum pa'o/ /sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang ske/ da ltar byung ba la ma chags pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba dang / chos kyi dbyings la mi gnas pa/ de bzhin 61—457

nyid kyi mtshan nyid ma byung ba dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas byung ba snang bar mdzad pa/ brjod du med par bstan pa / de ltar tshad med pa'i rigs kyi phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi phyir ltashib/sangs rgyas kyi yul kun tu gzigs pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa bzhi pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las mngon par 'du mi byed pa/ blang ba med pa dang / rgya gyimed pa'i mtha' la gnas pa/ dor ba med pa'i chos kyi gnas kyi pha rol tu song ba/ ma nges pa'i rnam pa'i mdzod dang /grangs kyi spyod padzashusalas legs 'o par tshogs mtha' yas pa sgrub pa dang / sna tshogs kyi rim pa 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i grangs su gtogs pa'i rjes su song ba/ sgribasnyopa med pa'i ye shes kyi lta ba tshad med mtha' yas pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs mngon par 'du mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sems can rnams 'dul zhing rnam par rig par byed pa ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa lnga'o(6) / /chos thams cad bltar ri )med pa dang / sna tshogs med par song ba de ni med (85med par song ba/ ma byung bar song ba/ mtshan nyid med par song ba/sna tshogs med par song ba/ rgyan med par song ba/ blang ba med par songasheb/ngo bo nyid med par song zhing chos thams cad mkhyen te/ chos kyi klong las rimatswa par 'byin pa rab tu mkhyen pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos dang mi 'gal bar mdzad pa / yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid med par ltamanyunyeb/ thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa/ ye shes kyis ma lus par gzigs pa/ chos thams cad 61—458

dbang gis snang bar mdzad cing de bzhin nyid tsho1 kyi ngo bo nyid las mi 'pho ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa drug pa'o/ /dus gcig du tu mtshan ma gcig phan tshun rtogs shing mkhyen pa de chos gsha' mar 'jug pa yongs su mi gnas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mnyam pa rnam par dag pa/ chos gsha' ma nyid dang / dus thams cad du mi gnas pa de la nyi ma gcig dang / zla ba phyed dang / lo gcig dang / lo brgya dang /bskal pa sdud pa dang 'gyur ba'i rjes su 'jug pa'ang ma ②yin/ ldog pa'ang ④ma yin/ tshad med pa'i dus dang / nyi ma gcig dang / yud tsam5gegyi dus dang / snga dro dang / nyi ma phyed kyi dus dang / phyem red dang / srod dang /nam gyi gung7dang / tho rangs9)kyi dus dang / nyi ma dang / grangs su gtogs pa'i dus dang / zhag bdun dang / zla ba phyed kyi dus dang / zla ba gcig dang / lo gcig dang / lo brgya'i dus dang / bskal pa gcig gi dus dang / tshad med/ grangs medabu/ bsam gyis mi khyabazhu)/ brjod du med pa'i dus dang / phyi ma'i dus kyi mtha'i bar dus7 )chos ston te'i/ chos kyi 'khor lo la gnas pa'ang med ldog pa'ang med/ rgyun kyang mi gcod/ sbyor ba'ang med/ mtshams su'ang mi 'gyur/ mi 'dor/ mi 'pho/ mi g.yo/ring ba'ang ma yin/ de mtha' la yang gnas pa ma yin te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyitshwa thabs la mkhas pa bdun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang /tshad med pa'i mi 'jigs pa brnyes pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa grangs med pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa tshad med pa dang / so so yang dag par 61—459

rig pa mi zad pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa gnas pa med pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa mtha' yas pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang ske/ so so yang dag par rig pa kun nas gzung ba med pa dang / de kho na nyid so so yang dag par rig pa dang / tshig dang / tshul dang / rtog pa so so'inyeyang dag par rig pa dang / chos thams cad so so yang dag par rig pa dang ske/ ji ltar bsam pa dang / dad pa midang / dbang po dang / ji ltar btags pa'i chos rnams dang / chos kyi gzhung gi mtshams ston pa dang / de dang de dag tu brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i mdo sde bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi thog ma dang / bar ma dang / tha ma'i mdo yang dag par rab tu ston te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa brgyad pa'o/ /ming med pa dang / ming dang / rigs dang /'byung ba yangasachos thams cad kyi ming dang / 'byed pa dang / khams 'bar ba dang / mngon du rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / 'das pa med pa'i ming dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa med pa'i ming dang / da ltar byung ba med pa'i ming dang /sems can med pa'i ming dang / zhing med pa'i ming dang / chos med pa'i ming dang / yon tan med pa'i ming dang / byang chub sems dpa' med pa'i ming dang / sangs rgyas med pa'i ming dang / grangs med pa'i ming dang /grangs med pa ma yin pa'i ming dang / ma byung ba'i ming dang / mi 'gog pa'i ming dang / med pa'i ming dang / med pa ma yin pa'i ming dang / gcig ma yin pa'i ming dang / rnam pa thams cad ma yin pa'i ming rang bzhin gyis brjod du med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni phyogs ma yin/ brda ma yin/ ngag 61wa 460

gi lam gyi sgra dang bral ba/ sgra byung ba thams cad kyis ma bsgrubs pa/ ma bskyed pa dang / sna tshogs su bskyed pa dang / rnam pa gcig ma yin pa dang /rnam pa mang po ma yin pa dang / smra ba thams cad brjod du med pa'i dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes pa/ kun tu mi rtoganyepa'i yul mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang ldan pa/ rtog pa dang / kun tu rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa thams cad 'gags pa/ smra ba thams cad la mi gnas pa gnas pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa dgu'o / /gzugs kyi chos thams cad ma skyes par mkhyen te/ tshor ba ma yin/spros pa ma yin/ grangs ma yin/ 'du shes kyi spyod pa ma yin/ 'du byed ma yin / len pa ma yin/ rnam par shes pa ma yin te/ rang bzhin gyis zhi bar rab tu mkhyen/ skye mched med par 'jug pa dang / chos thams cad kyi dbyings mi dmigs pa dang / chos thams cad mi 'jigs pa dang / chos thams cad ldang ba med de②/ rang bzhin gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/chos thams cad dben pa/ las ma yin pa spyod pa med pa las byung ba/ ma skyes pa/ ma byung ba/ grangs mang bar rtogasalgepa/ yod pa ma yin pa/med pa ma yin pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin / rnam par byang ba ma yin/ ming med pa/ gsha' ma ma yin pa/ mi gnas pa yongs su mi gnas pa yongs su smin pa ma yin pa/ dul ba ma yin pa/sems can med pa/ sems can med pa ma yin pa/ srog med pa/ srog med pa ma yin pa/ rkyen med pa/ rkyen med pa ma yin pa/ rkyen dang 'du ba med pa ma yin par chos thams cad mkhyen te/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings ston pa'i 61—461

dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes nyupa/ tshogs gsum pa rnam par gnas pas nges pa dang / ma nges pa dang / log par nges pa dang / ma nges pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul chen po ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ②kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa bcu'od / /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs la mkhas pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs ④yangs pa / tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa gang gis kyang tshad gzung bar mi nus pa/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'jug par mi nus pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' dang / chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang / 'jig rten gyi (dekhams thams cad du dga' ldan du skye ba ston pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' med pa dang / kha dog tshad med pa dang / gzi brjid tshad med pa dang / snang ba tshad med pa dang / dbyings tshad med pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa tshad med pa dang / sgra sgrogs pa rnam par rig pa tshad med pa dang /ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa la gnas pa dang / shes rab dang / ye shes kyi yul tshad med pa dang / mtha' dang 'jig rten du bcas pa rjes su 'dzin pa dang /bdud du bcas/ tshangs par bcas/ dge sbyong dang / bram zer bcas pa 61—462

dang ske/ skye dgu dang / lha dang / mir bcas pa dang / lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten rjes su 'dzin pa/ mi 'phrogs pa'i byams pa chen po'i spyod yul ba/ snying rje chen po la phyogs pa'i mtha' la hu)phyogs pas sems can rjes su 'dzin pa/gzhan mtho (0ris su skye ba'i sems can rjes su 'dzin pa/ bsod nams kyi stobs kyi dbang po phun sum tshogs pa/ dbang po rnam par dag pa dang /sems cang (mishes yongs su dag pa'i sems can yang rjes su 'dzin pa/ theg pa sna tshogs rnam par dag pa'i sems can yang rjes su 'dzin pa/ theg pa chen po yongs su rdzogs pa'i sems can yang rjes su 'dzin pa/ 'gro ba thams cad las 'byung5geba'i sems can yang rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mdzad pa dang spyod pa rnam par dag pa rdzogs pa'o/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho zhing yum gyi lhums su gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshe dang / bdag gi (5)lus su skye ba dang / sgyu ma lta bur (6 spyod pa dang / sprul pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la thug pa dang / mig yor lta bu'i rnam par rig pa dang / yul nam mkha' ltar tshad med par song ba/ 'dod pa lta bur skye ba la ma ⑦chags pa/ smig rgyu43)dang / mnyam par snang ba dang 1)/nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos la 'brang ba/ gnas med pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa/rang bzhin gyis 'dod chags dang bral zhing rnam par dag pa/ bla re dang rgyan 1 snachen po'i mdzod bdag gi lus skye ba'i mtha' yang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / rin po che chen pos spras pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa rin po ches mchod pa'i gnas chen po la gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / yid la byed pa chen 61wa 463

po'i byin gyi brlabs7kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / rnam par sprul pa chen po'i mdzod ston pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /ye shes chen po'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang ske/ ma las skyes pa de la gnas pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / yul chen po sangs rgyas kyi yul rab tu brnyes pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasalgematha' yas pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / grangs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chen po la rnam par spyod cing mnyam par 'jog pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa〈mimadzad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin de dang de dag las bzhengs pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / thog ma dang / bar ma dang /tha ma dang / spyod pa dang po nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po'i mtha'i bar gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sa 'di nas gnyis kyi bar du thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas phyis 'jig rten gyi grangs la shes par ston pa dang / gzi brjid sna tshogs kyis kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / gzhon nur gyur pas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / byang chub sems dpar gyur pas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /mngon par byung ba dang / rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas kyang 'jig rten ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis kyang 'jig rten ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sna tshogs kyis kyang 'jig rten 61—464

du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten dpag tu med pa dang /'jig rten kun dang / phyogs thams cad du rgya mtsho'iturgyun dang / rigs kyis 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / zhing dang dus ma lus pas 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /las kyi rnam par smin pa ②ma lus pas 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sems can gyi rigs ma lus pas kyang 'jig rten du ③sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / 'chi 'pho zhing skye ba dang / rigs ma lus pas kyang 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sprul pa chen po dang / rigs dang / sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang / chos dran pa'i sgo'i 'khor los kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gnyis pa'o/ /dudage bar spyod pa las rnam par dag pa dang / skye ba thams cad dang / ye shes dang /spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang / skye ba bstan⑧pa'i rjes su song ba dang /sems can 'dul zhing rjes su chud par byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang7yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sems can rnams la dgos pa'i slas ston pa'i rjes su song zhing sangs rgyas thams cad 'dod chags dang bral te gnas la gnas pa dang / gnas pa7med pa dang / sgra dbyangs thams cad dang bral bar so sor rtog pa dang / srid pa thams cad dang / mishedang srid par 'byung ba la rtog pa dang / dngos po thams cad ye shes su 'jug pa dang /tshul khrims thams cad mkhyen pa'i mthar yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /snying rje chen pos slas ltar 'gro ba la rnam par lta ba dang / byams pa chen pos 61—465

sems yul la so sor rtog pa dang / dga' ba chen pos 'jig rten las hu)mngon par dga' ba shes par byed pa dang / btang snyoms chen pos sems la dbang sgyur 25zhing 'jug par byed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan bdag la yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du lus mngon par sgrub pa dang / thams cad du gnas pa med pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / g.yog 'khor thams cad rnam par dag par nan tan byed pa dang / chos ston cing smra ba rjod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po smad pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyes pa rtogs (5)pa ji ltar spyod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ston pa dang / ji ltar gnas pa'i sems can rnams 'dul ba dang / yongs su ma smin pa'i sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang / ji ltar yongs su smin pa 'dul ba dang / thabs la mkhas pa grangs med pa mngon par sgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa las mi ldog par ston pa dang / spyod pa'i sgo sna tshogs kyi chos snang bar byed pa dang /gnas med pa'i rnam pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa rnam par dag pa byed pa dang / snying rje chen po skyes pa'i chos kyi sprin mngon par 'bebs par byed pa dang / sbrang bu 'gro ba ltar byams pa la 'jug cing cho 'phrul gsum yongs su 'bebs 4par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la lta ba rnam par rig cing slas kyi dbus na pa 'dug pa ston pa dang / de las mtha'i mtha' dang /dbung 56med pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa dang / ye shes chen po la gnas pas gnod cing sgrib ridzodapa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon par shes pa mngon par sgrub pa dang / las kyi mtha'i chos gsum la thabs mkhas pa 61wa 466

ste / lus kyi las shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / ngag gisatumi 'phro ba'i ye shes shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / yid kyi las zab mo chags pa med pa'i mthar phyin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i (misems can rnams kyi don mdzad de/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gsum pa'ol/ /mngon par byung ba'i rnam par rgyal ba chen pos slas tshad med pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yid du 'ong ba spangs te/ 'byung ba'i spyod pa ston cing 'jig rten gnas pa'i sems can 'dzud pa dang / 'jig rten mngon par chags par 'gyur bar byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi grangs mi rtog go zhes shes par byed pa dang / 'jig rten sna tshogs la mngon par chags pa zlog par byed pa dang /'jig rten gyi dga' ba'i sred pa gcod pa dang / nyon mongs pa spangs pa 'jig rten sbyong53)du 'jug pa dang / don thams cad rjes su dran par byed pa dang / 'byung ba'i don gyi phyir 'brang bar byed pa dang / khyim ④pa'i mtshan ma yongs su gtong ba55)ston pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos la sbyor zhing gnas par byed pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor snang bar byed pa dang / ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor so sor rnyed par byed cing sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i rab rib la lta ba dang / bdag bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pas 'gro ba thams cad nye bar khrid pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'du zhing sangs rgyas las bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skye dgu thams cad la bsngags pa dang / bdag ye shes kyi donasngonamathong ba'i 3ston pa dang / sems can rnams la rnam par dag pa'i sgo brjod pa dang / sems can rnams la kha na 61—467

ma tho ba med pa'i sgo sgrub tu 'dzud pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad la 'byung ba'i sgo rab tu ston pa dang / mngon par 'byung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal mtshan kun sgreng bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bzhi pa'o/ /mdzad pa dang ye shes du ma dang rab tu ldan pas byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthar phyin nas byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pas chos thams cad thugs su chud de/ bdud kyi stobs rab tu bcom zhing zil gyis mi non pa'i sku'i byin gyi brlabs7)kyi mdzod dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du khyab par byed pa dang / byin gyi〈mibarlabs57mi zad pa'i mthas mtha' rnam par spangs pa dang / tshad med pa'i spyod pa rab tu brnyes pus thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul la rnam par rol pa'i ye shes kyi don gyi rjes su gshegs pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan bsgrubs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du spras pa'i gdan yongs su gsal ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rig par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mchog rab tu brnyes pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang /yang dag pa'i khyad par gyi smon lam la rnam par lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'447thams cad la dgongs pa dang / zab mo'i byang chub sems dpa' la chos zab mo'i 'khor lo bskoramathob dang / tshad med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul rtsom pa dang / brjod du med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung gnas kyi phyir 'brang zhing sna tshogs kyi spyad pa spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi 61—468

dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi7)byin gyis brlabs7kyi yul du byas pa dang / sems can la dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par rig par byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dbyer med pas 'byung ba'i sa dang byang chub sems dpa'i⑧spyod pa mtha' yas pa'i stobs la gnas shing yon tan thams cad kyi khyad par ma lus pa'i mtha' rab tu rnyed de 'dug pa dang ske/ 'jig rten thams cad du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad ma lus pa'i mthar 'gro ba dang / zhing thams cad du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad du 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad du 'gro ba dang /yongs su smin pa thams cad du 'gro ba dang / dus thams cad du 'gro ba dang /'dul ba thams cad du 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rol par 'gro ba dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi dad pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par chud par byed pakyisangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lnga pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor0te/ 'jig rten thams cad mngon par shes par byed pa'i tshul gyis 'khor lo dang / ma lus pa thams cad du ma lus par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing mi 'jigs pa'i ⑦seng ge'i sgra chen po'i tshul gyis 'khor lo dang /chos thams cad kyi ye shes kyisamadzod dang / mun pa med pa'i chos kyi mdzod kyi sgo snang ba'i tshul gyis 'khor lo dang / nam mkha'i〈mongos ltar chags pa med pa'i ye shes tshad med pa'i tshul gyis 'khor lo dang / chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'i ngo bo nyid bsgribs pa med pa la so sor rtog pa'i tshul gyis /rto'akhor 61—469

lo dang / sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa dang /'jig rten thams cad kyi sgron ma'i tshul gyis 3'khor lo dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos snang bar byed pa'itshanadus gsum du 'jig rten thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul gyis ri 'khor lo dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gcig tu snyug pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos dang mi 'gal ba'i tshul gyis 5de'akhor lo dang /de la sogs pa grangs med pa'i rnams (5)bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ri'urite/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod par 'gro ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor 47 ro/ /'di ltar chos kyi 'khor lo skor (8bas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa drug pa'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du 'jug pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/ mi'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang / lha'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang /klu'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang ri9)/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang / dri za'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang / nam mkha' nya lding gi rgyal po'i pho brang dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang / lto 'phye chen po'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang / 'bar ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang / sha za'i rgyal po'i pho brang de dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jug pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/ gang 'di grong khyer gyi sgor nyurtagashegs nas sa g.yo zhing 'od zer gyi snang bas long ba rnams ni so sor mig thob/ 'on pa rnams ni so sor sgra thos/ smyon pa rnams ni so sor dran pa rnyed/ gcer bu rnams kyang 61wa 470

so sor gos rnyed/ sdug bsngal ba rnams ni so sor bde ba thob/ sil snyan dang brdung ba rnams ma brdungs 1par yid du 'ong ba'i sgra skad 'byin pa dang /brdung ri ba ma brdungs pa dang / 'phyang 'phrul rnams 'phyang ba dang /brdungs pa'i sgra dang / bram ze sna tshogs mang po rnams kyi sgra skad yid du 'ong ba dang / lta bas mi ngoms shing mi mthun pa med pa gzugs kyi sku ston pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bstan pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / kun tu gzigs pa dang / rnam par gzigs pa dang / brkyang ba dang bskum pas kyang sems can snol sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / byon pa dang / bzhengs pa dang / 'chag pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / gzims pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /chos 'chad pa dang / cang mi gsung bas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / ston pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sna tshogs kyi sems can gyi bsam pa rgya mtsho ma lus pa dang /'jig rten gyi spyod pa grangs med pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yul dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas dang /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs lta bas mi ngoms pa'i phyir 'brang ba dang /61—471

sangs rgyas rnams 'byung zhing skye ba dang / smra ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / smra ba shin tu dkon pa dang / dkar po'i chos thams cad dang / bsod nams kyi 'byung gnas dang / sangs rgyas mnyes par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog mtha' yas pa la 'jug ①pa dang /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon du rtogasalgepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rtogasalgepa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa zhing thams cad la gzigs shing 'jug pa dang / 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad nye bar spyod pas kyang 'jig rten gyi sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / de dag dang ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba'i las dang / rjes su ston pa dang / tshig tu 'byin pa dang / yang dang yang du yid la byed pa dang / mngon par lta ba dang —/ mngon du dran pa dang / sems dang bas sangs rgyas la sdug par sems pa'i sems can rnams la yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sems can rnams la yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /sangs rgyas lta bar 'dod pa'i sems can rnams la yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i ro dang / sangs rgyas 'byung bas 'jig rten thams cad rnam par dag par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang /kha dog mtha' yas pa la lta ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'dzin pas dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / dad pa sna tshogs dang ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang /61—472

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku kha dog dang / dbyibs sna tshogs tshad med pa la lta ba'i sems can rnams la yang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra thos pa'i sems can rnams la yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi7mdzad pa mdzad de/ de la sogs pa'i mtha' med bsam gyis mi khyab brjod du med pa'i rnam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug cing 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i stobs ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba las mi 'da' ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad lakhu'ajig rten thams cad 'dzud de/ yul las phyir mi ldog cing thugasalgerje chen po gtong ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam la mi skyo ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi stobs kyis 'gro ba thams cad la rtog pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa la gnas shing dge ba rgyas pa tshad med pa brnyes te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bdun pa'o/ /dgon pa na bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams zhi bar bzhugs pa dang / dben pa na bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasalgenams zhi bar bzhugs pa dang / dben pa na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul la bzhugs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin chen po la gnas shing bzhugs pa na gcig pur dgyes pa na bzhugs pa dang / sku bltar mi snang bar bzhugs pa dang / ye shes zab mo la gnas shing bzhugs pa dang /dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi stobs la bzhugs pa dang / sku'i spyod pa bltar med pa la bzhugs pa rgyun mi gcod pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 61—473

'das sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang dang ba 0)ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul zhing gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i ye shes dang / smon lam gyi tshul gyis sangs rgyas lha yongs su 'tshol (7zhing sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang〈khu/ sangs rgyas klu yongs su 'tsholasnyibs kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas nam mkha' lding yongs su tsholasab dang / sangs rgyas mi'am ci yongs su tshol (5)ba dang / sangs rgyas lto 'phye tsochen po yongs su tsholas)ba dang / sangs rgyas 'bar ba yongs su tshol7ba dang / sangs rgyas mi dang mi ma yin pa yongs su tshol〈 sgrib dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang /sangs rgyas yongs su tshol /lkubs kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang /chos ston pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi mthus kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthus kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa'i khyad par dang / smon lam gcig tu bsdus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi spyod pa'agernam par phye ba dang /spyod pa'i rim pa'i mthu dang / 'jig rten gyi yul dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul dang / 'jig rten gyi yul gyi mthu dang /yul ma yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi mthus kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang / mtshan mo dang / nyin par dang / zla ba phyed dang / lo gcig dang / bgrang bar gnas na bzhugs pa nas brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal par gnas na bzhugs pa'i bar gyis kyang sangs rgyas 61—474

bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa brgyad pa'o/ /khang pa lta bur gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rnam par sbyangs par gyur pa dang / sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rnams dad par gyur pa dang ske/ mos par gyur pa la sems 'jug cing sgrub par gyur pa dang / dbang po rnams 'dul bar gyur pa dang / sems can dang skye dgu thams cad la dad paratugyur pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad 'byung bar gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskur bar gyur pa dang / rtog pa la gnas shing ye shes snang bar gyur pa dang / gzhan ri dring la mi 'jog pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mya ngan las 'das pa ston cing sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgyun mi gcod pa dang / 'jig rten mi rtag pa5mi ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi snang bar mdzad pa rgyun mi gcod pa dang / byas pa'i dgos pa'i mtha' bsdus pa dang / ngo bo ma tshang ba med pas chos la 'jug pa snang bar byas〈gepa dang / rtsa ba bcad pa la srid pa'i mig snang bar byed pa dang ske/ sems can rnams la skyo ba ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rjes su song ba'i sems dang 'thun 6par byed pa dang / sems can rnams57tshe'i mtha' ston pa dang / sems can thams cad la 'jig rten gyi mngon par mi dga' ba nye bar ston pa dang / sems can rnams ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bltar mi smad pa'ikhuchos kyi 'khor lo bskor 87zhing rnam par chud par mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten spro ba snang bar mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas sems rtsom pa dang ldan pa dang /61—475

ldan par 'jog pa dang / ①su de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran zhing lta ba rnam par dag pa'i yongs su rtog pa'i sems can rnams la sems can rnams slong bar mdzad pa dang / dbang po skyo ba zlog cing yongs su sbyong bar mdzad pa dang /sangs rgyas la mngon par dga' ba thams cad sgrub par mdzadasnyepa dang / skyo ba rnyed pa'i sems can rnams la byin gyis rlobalgepa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi brtse bar ④dgongs pa'i rkyen brnyes pa dang / lus gyes pa thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus sems can rnams 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten gyi sems can 'khrugs pa dang myos pa rnams sdom pa la 'jog par mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dgu pa'o/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mya ngan las 'das nas 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams thams cad smre sngags 'don pa dang / ngu ba dang / mya ngan slos pa dang / mchi ma byung bar 'gyur te/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya rtsib dang / thugs rje chen po zhes bya ba dang / ded dpon chen po zhes pasnyedang / thugs brtse ba zhes pa7dang /lha dang / 'jig rten du bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mgon du gyur pa dang7/ skyabs su gyur pa/ dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing 'das par gyur ces pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byung bar dga' ba zhes pa dang / rnam pa 'di lta bur smre sngags 'don/mya ngan slos7shing sangs rgyas mthong ba rjes su dran pa'i sems can rnams tshad med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la 'jug pa ste/ de dang de dag tu sems can gyi bsam pa dang / yid la byed par yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas sangs 61—476

rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang dad pa ji lta ba bzhin du sku gdung dang ring bsrel7byin gyis rlob ste/ lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi'i gnas thams cad du ji ltar 'dul ba dang / ji ltar dad pasnyebazhin du sku gdung dang ring bsrelasabyin gyis rlob ste/ rang gi sku bor nas tshad med grangs med④/ bsam gyis mi khyab / brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par sku gdung dang ring bsrelakyibyin gyis rlob cing / gang 'di'i sems can rnams kyi sems dang ba'i dbang dang ske/ sems can rnams kyi dad pas mchod pa'i dbang dang / sems can rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i dbang dang / sems can rnams yongs su smin pa'i dbang dang / sems can rnams yongs su sbyangs pa'i dbang dang ske/ sems can rnams kyi 'dul ba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang dang / sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par rtsom pa'i dbang dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyi rgyan sna tshogs yul dang / ljongs sna tshogs kyi sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel ba'i dbang dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung bgos shing 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod rten du byas shing yul dang phyogs der lha'i gnas sam/ klu'i gnas sam/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas dang —/ mi'i gnas dang / 'bar ba'i gnas su sku gdung dang ring bsrelashemachod par 'gyur/ sku gdung dang / ring bsrel〈shedang / dbu skra dang /61—477

sen mo'i mchod rten dang / sangs rgyas bzhugs par mchod rten brtsigs pa/'gro ba thams cad nges par sangs rgyas rjes su dran par 'gyur/ chos kyi phyir 'brang bar 'gyur/ dge 'dun la dad pa so sor rnyed par 'gyur/ yul dang phyogs de dang der gnas shing rgyun mi 'chad7par mchod par bsam pas gnas nas / sbyin pa byin zhing bsod nams byed par 'gyur te/ de dang de dag mtho ris kyi yongs su dag pa so sor rnyed par 'gyur/ rigs chen po so sorasnyernyed par 'gyur/ longs spyod chen po dang g.yog 'khor rnam rdzi/par dag pa so sor rnyed par 'gyur/ lhaphudang mi'i phun sum ④tshogs pa so sor myong bar 'gyur/ngan par mi lhung56raba'i nan tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ de dag sangs rgyas byung ba na gti mug med pas sgrub par 'gyur/ dkar po'i chos la gnas pa so sor rdzogs par 'gyur/ khams gsum nas 'byung ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ ji ltar theg pa la dad pa dang / smon lam gyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ de dang de dag de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa shes shing〈pebyas pa gzo ba so sor rnyed par 'gyur te/ phyir 'brang ba dang / gnas dang /mgon dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sbyin gnas sbyong ste/ bsod nams yongs su mi gnas pa'i sbyin gnas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du skye ba 'di lta bu'i rnam pa mang por sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 61—478

sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yangs pa dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs ①ma gtogs par gzhan 'jig rten gyi yul thams cad kyi lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa gang gis kyang tshad gzung bar mi nus/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas su bcas pas kyang 'jug par nus pa ma yin no// //'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa/ bam po gsum pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo chos kyi dbang po'i chos mi gnyis par 'gro ba bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad lung ston te/ mi gnyis par 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems dang bsam pa sna tshogs med bcu rdul yab brjod du med par gshegs pa mi gnyis pa dang / chos kyi don ma lus pa thams cad las rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sku mi gnyis pa dang / 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i ngo bo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa dang / 'byung ba'i skad cig ma'i mtha'i ye shes mi gnyis shing thog⑧ma'i mtha' dang / tha ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba gnyis su med pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi zhing ②gi rjes su 'gro ba bstan pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa dang /sangs rgyas gcig gi gsung dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gnyis su med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dul ba dang / rab tu 61—479

phigs pa dang / rnam par rig pa gnyis su med pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi chos nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid gnyis su med pa dang /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang / gcig gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gnyis su med de/kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi dbang po'i chos kyis mi gnyis par gshegs pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams chos thams cad la nan tan gyis gnas pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings la gnas shing ye shes kyi rjes su sangs rgyas pa la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la gnas pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji ltar smon lam gyis 'byung ba la gnas pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can yongs su mi gtong zhing 'dul ba la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ngo bo med pa la rab tu gnas pa'i chos nyid la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das don med pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams skalatub mnyam pa ma yin par gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rtag tu sems mnyam pa la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ma nyamasalgepa'i dbang po la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems chags pa med par spyod pa la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la 'jug cing mi 'jigs pa yang dag pa'i mtha'i mtshan nyid la gnas pa ste / kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 61—480

rnams chos thams cad kyi nan tan la gnas pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ①chos thams cad ma lus par mngon par mkhyen pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'das pa'i grangs thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / ma 'ongs pa thams cad kyi grangs thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi grangs thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / ngag thams cad kyi lam thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'jug pa thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi ngo bo'i ye shes thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po dang / sna tshogs rnam par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang /bsam pa tshad med pa rgyun mi gcod pa'i mtshams kyi skad cig ma'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / chos thams cad rkyen dang 'dus pa ①tshogs par khong du chud pa thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rigs rab tu 'byed pa'i ye shes mthong ba thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings dbye ba mig 'phrul mkhan gyis rnam par phye ba ltar thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyisakhuchos thams cad ma lus par mngon par mkhyen pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi stobs chen po dang / stobs dang / stobs tshad med pa dang /stobs kyi bdag nyid che ba dang / bzod par dka'aphuba'i stobs dang /61—481

yongs su ma nyams pa'i stobs dang / snying po'i stobs dang / mi phyed pa'i stobs dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyis 91)bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang /sems can thams cad kyis (5)mi 'phrogs pa'i stobs dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal gyi chos bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi sku pha rol rgol ba thams cad kyis mi phyed pa dang / 'tsho ba'i dbang po 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyis mi chod cing dug gis mi 'jigs pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'tshig pa'i me'i bskal pas mi tshig (snyepa dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sdud pa dang 'dzin pa'i chu'i phung po'i chus mi 'chi ba dang / bdud thams cad dang / bdud kyi sde thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyi stobs dang / klu thams cad dang / gnod sbyin thams cad dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i stobs dang / sha za dang / 'bar ba thams cad kyi stobs dang / sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi mig ri gi stobs kyis mi tshugs pa dang / ri rab lhun po'i ri dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i char 'bebs pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor tshonasayug chen po'i ri dang mnyam pa dang / gzhan yang stong gsum gyi kyisastong chen po'i tshad kyi rdo rje'i char babs te/ des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgre bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ba spu yang mi 'gul/ bag tsha b.ratswayang mi 'gyur / bzhud pa dang / bzhengs pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba'i spyod lam spang ga riba'ang mi mnga' ste/ yul gang du de bzhin gshegs pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu ji tsam du bzhed pa kun tu de tsam du ma bab bo /61—482

sangs rgyas kyiphubasngags pa la yang gtses par ma gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyisasems can la yang gtses par ma gyur na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mi 'khrugs pa lta ci smos te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos dang po'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhed na chos thams cad kyi dbyings mchog ma lus pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / ri rab lhun po'i ri dang bcas/ kho ra khor yug dang / khor yug chen po'i ri dang bcas/ rgya mtsho'i ri dang nags stug por bcas pa dang / sems can gnas pa'i gnas sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig tu bcug ste tha (snyema'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mtha' gebazung na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs ④ma gtogs par sems can gzhan gyis shes par mi nus so/ /'jig rten gyi khams du ma de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi sku'i ba spu'i bu gar bcug nas mtha' 96)ma'i mtha'i bskal par bzung ste/ bzhengs pa dang / bzhud pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba dang / bskal par gshegs kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs la skad cig kyang sdug bsngal du mi 'gyur/ skyo ba mi mnga' ste/ stobs dang mthu yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/ spyod lam la rnam par rtog par mi 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'dzin te/'bying ba ma yin/ zhum pa ma yin/ 'phel ba ma yin/ 'bri bskodzom yin/'byung ba ma yin/ skye ba ma yin/ rnam pa58)ma yin no/ /de bzhin du sangs 61—483

rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ba spu'i bu ga gcig tu 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kun 'dzin kyang de'i phyir sdug bsngal tshor ba'i sems skye ba gcig kyang mi mnga' ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos brnyes0)pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gom pa gcig gi spyod pa'i ②sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dra'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal par gom pas spyod do/ /du ma'i sems skye zhing 'jug pa de ltar gshegs shing 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu phra ba'i rdulakhudang mnyam pa'i bskal par gshegs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sems bskyed pa bzhin du bskal par gshegs shing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun gnas shing tshad med pa dang / khor yug chen po'i ri brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par 'gyur ba dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa 'das shing ba spu'i bu ga gcig 'gag par 'gyur te/ ji ltar ba spu'i bu ga gcig pa de ltar sku'i༄spu'i bu ga thams cad de sems can thams cad ji snyed pa ba spu'i bu gar gyur la/ de ltar sems can thams cad lci bar gyur la/ sems can de dag thums cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sor mo gcig gi rtse mos tha ma'i mtha'i bskal par 'dzin te/ ji ltar sor mo gcig gis dang por 'dzin pa de ltar sor mo thams cad kyi rtse mos 'dzin kyang de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsnyel ba yang mi mnga'/ thugs la skyo 61—484
