bar yang mi 'gyur/ sdug bsngal gyi reg pa tshor ro snyam pa'i seṅges phra rab gcig tsam yang mi skye'o/ /de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams re rer gshegs shing 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' la gshegs shing 'jug pa dang / rgya mo'i phyogs thams cad du gshegs shing 'jug pa dang / de ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' ma lus pa thams cad dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi mthar 'jug pa dang / skra'i rtse mo'i mtha'i tshad kyi khams7thams cad du 'jug pa dang / skra rtse re re'i mtha' ②tshad kyi grangs kyi nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa thams cad yongs su gsol ba'i skra'i rtse mo'i mtha'i tshad kyi nam mkha'i khams su 'jug pa 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam thog ma'i mtha' dang tha ma'i mtha'i bskal par zad cing 'das kyi bar du phyogs dang phyogs na skyil mo krung ①gcig gis bzhugs ④shing yongs su longs spyod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i sku dang dbu du mar gyur la / dbu gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i ljags su gyur pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra dang gsung 'jug ste/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sems can gyi khams la go bar byed pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra dang / gsung re res kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i mdo sde dam pa 61—485

rab tu bshad la/ mdo sde re re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i chos ston pa'i rjes su 'brang la chos bstan pa re re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i chos kyi tshig dang 'byed pa rnams kyi brjod pa 'gro ste/ ji ltar gang gi7phyir chos ston pa de ltar chos thams cad ston te/ de dag la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal par (gyiston cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa rnams yongs su zad nas yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal par ston (cite / gzhung 'dis 'jig rten gyi〈gekhams thams cad kyi rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal par ston la/ gzhung〈pe'adis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa zad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa snyed kyi bskal pa zad cing 'das kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa ni de lta ma yin te/ chos thams cad mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'jug cing chos thams cad shes rab kyisarnyuston te/ brda sprod cing the tsoms57thams cad gcod pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / chos thams cad snang bar byed pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / chags pa med pa'i mdzod kyi (8ri'akhor lo skor ba dang / sems can mtha' yas pa nyu)tshim par byed pa'i 'dul ba'i rgyan gyi chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyan 7gyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / ye shes kyi nyi ma'i 61wa 486

dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyun gyi 3)'khor lo skor ba dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad la ye shes kyi sgron ma chen po'i〈khurgyun gyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / mi 'jigs pa chen po'i rgyan gyi ②chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing ji ltar sangs rgyas gcig gi sku'i byin gyi brlabs ④kyis chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i sprin chen po yang dpe thams cad kyis dper bya ba ma yin te/de ltar chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar ⑤spa'i rtse mo'i mtha' yonas rnam par phye ba chags pa med pa ma lus pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rab tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i sems kyi skad cig ma dang / sems kyi skad cig ma rgyare re de snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sprul pa dang / ji srid du mtha' ma'i bskal par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re ba de snyed de snyed kyi dbur gyur pa'i bar du sngar kun tu brjod pa bzhin du dbu re re la de snyed de snyed kyi ljags su gyur pa'i ljags re re la de snyed de snyed kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / gsung dang / sku dang ske/ gsung 'jug ste/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sems can gyi khams na go bar byed pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra dang /gsung re res de snyed de snyed kyi mdo sde rnams 'chad de(she/ mdo sde re re la de snyed de snyed kyi chos ston pa rjes su 'brang la chos ston pa re re la de snyed de snyed kyi chos kyi tshig dang 'byed pa'i brjod pa 'gro ste/ chos kyi tshig dang 'byed pa re res chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sgra gsal bar byed cing sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad la go bar byed kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung 61—487

'dzin7pa'ang med/ nyams pa'ang med/ zad pa'angasamed/ dmas pa'ang med de/ de ltar tha ma'i mthar bskal pa'i bar du gnas shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskorasate/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dpal gyi be'u'ikhurgyun dang ldan zhing / rdo rje'i snying po chen pos bzung ba de dag byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa rnams la bzhag nas sems can thams cad snyed kyis dubadud sdig can gyi sde gzugs sna tshogs bskrad cing mi sdug pa/ mchog tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'jig rten thams cad 'jigs pa'i gzugs mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gzugs su 'phrul par ⑦byed do/ /byang chub kyi shing mchog gi drung du song nas chos thams cad kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthar bdud kyi mi sdug pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ skrag pa chen pos 'jigs pa chen por byed pa/ 'gro ba thams cad 'joms pasal/'jig rten thams cad 'jig pa'o/ /de na de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs nas7thams cad la gzigs te/ gzigs nas mi bsnyengs / bag mi tsha/ spu 'ga' yang mi g.yo/ gzugs sna tshogs kyi mtshan ma rna7tshogs 'dzin pa yang mi mnga'/ sems phra mo yang mi mnga' bar gnas te mi g.yo/ mi bskyod7mi 'gyur rnam par mi rtog /shin tu rab tu zhi/bsnyengs shing ba spu ldang ba shin tu mi mnga'/ 'dod pa dang khong khro ba shin tu mi mnga' / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byams pa chen po chags pa med pa'i stobs kyis gtong bti/ dbang po sbed cing thugs rje chen po la gnas pa/ bag mi tsha ba'i thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i snying po thugs mi dngangs7shing zil gyis mi non pa'i 61—488

thugs kyis bdud dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad dang / bdud kyi sde mang po sna tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon cing gzod ①nas zil gyis gnon/bzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs su dong ste/ de dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis ②cho 'phrul gsum dang de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul ba bstan te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /'di lta steg/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos drug pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyasakyirnams kyi gsung thogs pa med pas 'jig rten gyi ⑤khams ma lus pa thams cad du 'jug cing de dang de dag tu 'jig rten thams cad kyis rnam par rig cing sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra de ri la thogs pa med de/ ri rab lhun po la mi thogs rin po che'i ri la ma yin/ khor yug dang khor yug chen po la ma yin/ lha'i gnas la ma yin/ klu'i gnas la ma yin/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas la ma yin/ dri za'i gnas la ma yin/ lha ma yin gyi gnas la ma yin/ nam mkha' lding gi gnas la ma yin/ mi'am ci'i gnas la ma yin/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnas la lta zhing chags par mi 'gyur rol/ /gal te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gshegs na'ang mi chags te /'jig rten srid pa'i khams thams cad kyi sgra chen po dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi sgra sna tshogs rab tu rdzogs pa de la de bzhin gshegs pas brjod pa'i sgras bsgribs par 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'dul ba'i sems can rnams kyi rna bas rnam par rigasheste/ gang 'di rna bas rnam par rig cing rnam par rig pa'i tshig dang 'byed pa nyams par mi 'gyur te/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i 61—489

sgra / lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i dpal gyi stobs la gnas pa'i chos kyi sgra bdun pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du shin tu yongs su sbyangs pas chags pa med/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyan dang zhing rnyog pa med panyu)/ bdag gi med pa'i chos thams cad la gnas pa/ nang dang phyi dang ldan pa ma yin/ma skyes pa la brtsam pa thams cad rnam par phye ba/ zhi ba/ gnas med pa/rtsom pa sna tshogs thams cad med pa/ ngo bo thams cad rnam par rtog pa'i 'du shes la gnas pa 'gagarwa pa/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ shin tu yongs su dag pa/ rtsom pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad la ma chags pa'i nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi yul gyi rjes su song ba/ yang dag pa'i mtha' 'dod chags dang bral zhing5snyedag pa/ chos kyi dbyings ston pa'i mthar song ba/chos kyi dbyings kun tu mi zad pa'i rjes su song ba/ 'du shes su gyur pa thams cad dang / tshad dang / tshad med pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / mngon par smra ba thams cad 'gagasalgepa dag gisasnyilam brjod du med pa'i mtha'i yul mi zad cing chags pa med pa'i dbyings kyi mtha'i sngon du ye shes 'gro zhing 'jug pa dang / stobs bcu'i rgyan dang chos thams cad rnam par dag pa/ thabs mkhas pa la zhugs pas chos〈sna tshogs dang / chos du ma dang / chos thams cad dang / ston pa 'gal ba med pa/ dus gsum du dbyer med pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang / chos thams cad dang /61—490

chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i dbang gi pha rol tu song ba/ chos thams cad kyi dbang gi 'byung gnas kyi mdzod kyi khyad par chos thams cad kyi tshul dran zhing kun nas gti mug pa zhing thams cad du 'gro ba'i dbang dang / rgya mo'i0)phyogs ma lus pa thams cad kyi mdo med bcu rdul ②yab la mi gnas pa/brtan par gnas shing mi 'pho (geb/ ye shes kyi lta ba chos ma lus pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa/ zag pa thams cad yongs su zad cing zag pa med pa/sems rnam par grol ba/ shes rab rnam par grol ba/ shin tu rnam par grol ba yang dag pa'i mtha' mi zad pa'i mchog chags pa med par gnas pa/ rtag tu mnyam pa dang rab tu ldan pa/ dus gsum la chags pa med par gnas pa/sems kyi skad cig ma la dus gsum gyi sems kyi spyod pa thams cad ma lus par rab tu shes pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i stobs brgyad pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi sgra 4)dang lus gcig tu 'dus pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang yul tshad med pa mtha' dang dbung (gemed pa'i sku yongs su grub pa/ 'jig rten thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa'i sku/ khams gsum gyis mi gos pa'i sku/ rkyen gyi sku rnam par rig cing lhag pa'i bsam pas rjes su dran pa la byin gyi 6brlabs 2kyi su'i 8)tshogs ston pa/ mi bden mi brdzun〈)zhing mnyam pa nyid rnam par dag pa'i sku/ 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba med pa'i chos kyi sku 'dus pa/ 'dus ma byas shing 'jig pa med pa'i sku/ mtshan nyid gcig dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ yul na mi gnas phyogs na mi gnas pa'i sku/ tshogs ma lus pa thams cad kyi sku/ sangs 61—491

rgyas khyu mchog rnam par sprul pa'i sku/ kha dog mtha' yas pa'i sku/ sku thams cad rjes su 'brang ba/ sku sna tshogs su rnam par rig pa/ chos kyi sku'i tshul gyi rjes su song ba/ mtha' yas par snang ba'i ye shes kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdzod kyi sku/ bya ba sna tshogs med pa/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings ston pa'i sku / sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad la khyab par gsol ba'i sku 'dus pa/ mi g.yo mi sems pa'i sku rnam par dag pa/ med pa dang med pa ma yin pa dang / tshul dang tshul ma yin pas phye ba'i sku/ sems can thams cad kyi dad pa sna tshogs kyi rjes su song zhing 'dul ba'i sku/ 'gags pa dang /'gags pa ma yin pa 'dul ba la gzigs7pa'i yon tan dkon mchog thams cad byung ba bsgreng ba'i sku/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos dang de bzhin nyid bsdus pa'i sku/ rang bzhin gyis shin tu zhi ba dang bsgribs pa med pa'i mtha'i sku/ thogs pa med pa'i chos thams cad las skyes pa'i sku/ zems cad kyi rjes su song ba/ chos kyi dbyings dag pa/ 'jig rten thams cad du rnam par phyesaba'i sku/ brtsam pa las mi ldog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa'i ye shes thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ kun 'brang ba'i rjes su song ba'i sku ste/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu chen po'i dpal gyi stobs dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku 'dus pa dgu pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyam pa dang / mnyam pa'i ye shes rnam par chud pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad las byung ba/ spyod pa las mngon par byung ba/ smon lam gyi khyad par dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 61—492

thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i ye shes bya ba sna tshogs med pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad las byung ba/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i spyod pa thams cad kyi cho ga shes pa/smon lam chen po dang / spyod pa mi chung ba/ spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par dga' ①ba ma yin pa/ spyod pa'i stobs bzod par dka' ②ba'i spyod pasathams cad las byung zhing spyod pa thams cad rnam par dag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bzang po spyad pa mi 'bri b.rarnyuspyod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa thams cad la gnas pa/ spyod yul mtha' yas pa lam thams cad ston pa/ lam ma yin pa'i yul dang lam thams cad la zhugs pa/ ye shes mchog gi stobs kyi7cho ga shes pa/ 'dzem pa med par chos kyi 'khor lo 'bebs pa/ dge ba 'dri ba dang / mi 'dri ba dang /btsun pa'i chos kyi tshul ston pa'i ye shes mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ye shes shin tu yongs su dag pa lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi spyod pa gsum yongs su dag pa / sangs rgyas kyi sgo ma rnyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyod pas song ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang /mdzad pa thams cad la zhugs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la gnas pa/ tshad med par ston pa dgatsoganas pa/ rtsa ba med cing mtha' med pa'i mngon par shes pa thams cad kyi ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ye shes 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams kyi rjes su 'gro ba/ 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi thams cad chos thams cad kyi ye shes kyisamathong ba dang / phra ba ma lus pa mtha' dang dbung7med pa'i ye shes/ dus gsum thams cad la 'jug pa'i tshul dang phra 61—493

ba'i ye shes rjes su rtogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don dang / ye shes dang /sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par brjod du med pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang ldan zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i ye shes kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku/ grangs la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi7༄chos yi ge med par rab tu rtog (snyepa/ brjod du med pa'i ye shes sna tshogs rnam par phye50ba dang / yi ge thams cad brjod dutswamed par shes par byed/ ye shes kyi (shedage bar spyod pa'i chos thams cad rnam par dag pa kun tu bzang po'i ye shes kyi rim pa/ sems skad cig ma gcig dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis (yichos thams cad khong du chud pa'i ye shes ji ltar 'osalgepa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus dang / ji ltar skye mched kyisachos gtong bar rab tu yid la byed pa'i ye shes chos thams cad kyi yul gyi mtshams ma yin pa(9ri / 'jig rten gyi yul khams ma lus pa thams cad dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad dang / sems can ma lus pa thams cad dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / dus gsum gyi sems kyi skad cig ma gcig la chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi khomathong ba'i yul de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i yul la 'jug cing thams cad 'dul ba'i yul ma lus pa thams cad kyi rjes su song ba/ rnam par dag par sangs rgyas kyi 31yid kyi 1 mtshams su thob pa mngon par mkhyen cing yul thams cad las mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ sems can gyi sems dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma lus pa thams cad rtogs pa/ dus gsum gyis phye ba'i sems kyi skad cig ma la ye shes kyi rjes su sangs rgyas shing mtshams ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas pa/61—494

sems can thams cad du 'gro ba mtha' yas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba mtha' med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba mtha' yas pa dang / dus gsum thams cad du 'gro ba dpag tu med pa dang / sangs rgyas khyu mchog thams cad du 'gro ba dang / khong du chud pa ma lus pa thams cad du 'gro ba dang / de dag ma lus pa thams cad las mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa rnam par chud pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mi gtong ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul pa la bzhugs te/ de na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mtha' dang dbung 6)med par gnas pa/ sangs rgyas khyu mchog gi sku mtha' dang dbung〈 med par gnas pa/ sems chags pa med par gnas pa/ mtha' dang dbung (5)med pa'i snying rje chen po sbyor ba la gnas pa/ dus thams cad du snortag tusko7rgyun mi 'chad par chos ston par gnas pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i dpal dang / ye shes chen po la gnas pa'i chos bcu pa'ozhu/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen po'i stobs kyi dpal la gnas pa'i chos bcu ste/sems can thams cad dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsam gyis mi khyab cing tshad mi zin pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa'i chos bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams tshe ji tsam par dga' ldan na bzhugs shing tshe zad nas 'pho bar byed pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams zla ba bcur bzhugs pa'i tshe ston pa 61—495

dang ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon par 'byung zhing 'byung bar bzhed pa'i thugs kyis bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi skad cig ma gcig la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi ①mngon par rdzogs par byang chub nas bzhugs shing / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par sprul par ston pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dul ba'i dus ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasasridage ba'i rtsa ba skyed ①pa'i dus ji lta ba bzhin du ston te brda sprod cing bzhugs pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dus ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brda sprod cing bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skad cig la sems can thams cad kyis ༷dri ba dris pa rnams skad cig la brda sprod cing bzhugs te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa'i chos bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzigs ma thag tu myur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can ngan par 'gro ba'i sems can rnams gzigs ma thag tu de dag myur du zlog pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can gzigs ma thag tu myur du bsod nams yongs su rdzogs par lhag par 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas 61—496

bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can gzigs ma thag tu myur du dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can gzigs ma thag tu myur du mtho ris su skye ba rnam par dag pa so sor thob par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems canatugazigs ma thag tu myur du nem nur dang / yid gnyis 'joms par nye bar gshegs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sems can gzigs ma thag tu phyir mi ldog par mdzad pa'i phyir myur du gshegs shing sems rgya chen po la dad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i 'gro ba byang chub tu sems ma bskyed〈kyepa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chagasha' mar zhugs pa gzigs ma thag tu ④dmigs par lta ba dang /gsha' mar 'jug pa'i rgyu rab tu 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams gzigs ma thag tu myur du sems can rnams kyi dbang po 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par dag par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dusems can gzigs ma thag tu myur du bsgribs pa thams cad zad par mdzad du gshegs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can gzigs ma thag ⑥ku myur du snang ba so sor rnyed cing zhum pa med de/ mi 'jigs pa la spobs pa rtsom par mdzad pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzigs ma thag tu myur ba'i de bzhin du gzigs pa'i chos bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag rjes su dgongs pa rnam par dag pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs 61—497

rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems kyi spyod pa rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa yang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 0)smon lam chen po yongs su rdzogs pa yang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsgrubs pa'ang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi sngon gyi tshangs par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'ang rjes su dgongs ②pa rnams yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sgo'ang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzugs kyi lus tshad med mtha' yas pa'ang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi yul dang rnam par sprul pa tshad med mtha' yas pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems kyi stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa yang rjes su dgongs pa rnams yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag rjes su dgongs pa rnam par dag pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa la gnas pa bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sems sna tshogs dang /sems gcig gi spyod pas dang / rnam par g.yo ba ldog pa sems kyi skad cig ma 61—498

la mkhyen pa dang / sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi dus gsum kun gyi las rnams dang / las dang ldan pa sna tshogs dang / rnam pa dang / rim pa dang /las rnams kyi 'phel zhing sog yo)pa'ang phyi ma'i rnam par smin pa'i rim pa sems kyi skad cig ma gcig la mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang ske/ sems can gyi ris sna tshogs dang / sems can gyi ris gcig dang /sems can ma lus pa thams cad dus ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams 'dul zhing ston pa'i cho 'phrul dang rjes su bstan ②pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis cho 'phrulasagyi byin gyis brlabs 5༄ston pa mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / rgya mo'i phyogs kyi ris thams cad dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du song ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyis mtshan mar bzung ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba lta ba rnam par phye ba mkhyen pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba dang / dad pa ji lta ba dang / 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du skad cig la tshad med pa'i rim pas sangs rgyas la lta ba dang / rnam par rig pa'i byin gyis brlabs 5tshomakhyen pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can pha rol gyi bsam par sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabasatswaston pa mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad 'dzin pa med pas sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams ji lta bus 'dul ba bzhin du 'doms shing rjes su bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba ston par mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang sems can thams cad kyi thams cad du 'gro zhing sems kyi skad cig ma la de dang de dag tu 'gro 61—499

ba'i nan tan mkhyen pa dang / sems kyi skad cig ma la chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyi phyogs thams cad la sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa gtong zhing sbyor ba mkhyen pa dang / sems kyi skad cig ma la chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyi dad pa tshad med pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sku la lta ba dang / gzugs kyi sku'i kha dog gi gnas mtha' yas pa ston pa mkhyen pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams thams cad mkhyen pa la gnas pa bcu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ①sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa5gebasam gyis mi khyab pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la rtag tu snyoms par 'jug cing sems kyi skad cig ma la chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad la snyoms par 'jug cing sems kyi skad cig ma la sems can gyi khams sna tshogs kyi rim pa bdag med pa'i mthar gyur pa kun nas snang bar mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / dus gsumasal snyoms par 'jug cing sems kyi skad cig ma'i mtha' la snyoms par 'jug cing gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa med bcu rdul yab thams cad kyi rgya mo thams cad dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi7rigs dang zhing thams cad la rtag tu snyoms par zhugs shing zhing mi zad pa'i mtharashegyur par gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 61—500

'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku mtha'0)yas pa la snyoms par tsozhugs shing skad cig la 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi sku sna tshogs rnam par rig pa ston pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / lus dang / ngag dang /sems yongs su gsal ba la rtag tu snyoms par zhugs shing sems can thams cad kyi sems sna tshogs kyi gnas mdzod du gnas shing skad cig lakhudad pa ji lta ba bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa dang / chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid la snyoms par zhugs shing 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar gyur pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi rkyen la snyoms par 'jug cing skad cig la smra ba'i rkyen ston pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang 'jig rten gyi dang 'jig rten las 'das pa med bcu rdul yab thams cad la rtag tu snyoms par zhugs shing skad cig la mtha' yas pa'i rkyen ④gyi rjes su song ba ⑤ste/sangs rgyas la lta ba mi gcod cing sems can sangs rgyas mtha' ⑥yas pa la lta bar mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad bsgrub ⑦pa med pa la snyoms par zhugs shing skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rtogs shing rig nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes dupa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 99)'dzin tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab 61—501

༄ga /'phags pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/stitsho༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dī paṃ (0ka ra byā (bka ra ṇa ④mā ma ma hā yā na sru tra45ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig56)tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya stong mang pos yongs su bskor cinga'adzomadun gyis bltas te chos ston to(ge/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyisarkyudage ba'i rtsa ba la so sor brtag pa nyid kyis bsam pa shin tu yongs su dag par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo ngas 61—510

sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la zhe sa dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur byas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis nga sngar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ma bstan gyi/ gang gi tshe ngas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad mthong nas ud pa la lnga phul ba de'i 'og tu nga chos bdag med pa nyid la mos par gyur cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de bas na khyod dge ba'i rtsa bas chog shes par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches grangs med pa yangs pa tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'das pa de'i tshe ①de'i dus na 'dzam bu'i lagling 'dir rgyal po ma skyes dgra zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po/ rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ kun dga' bo rgyal po ma skyes dgra de la grong khyer brgyad khri bzhi stong yod de thams cad kyang bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/skyedakyimos tshalasriphun sum tshogs pa/ rdzing bu phun sum tshogs pa/ me tog phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ bde ba lo legs pa/nyams dga' ba/ 'byor pa/ rgyas pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba sha stag gol/ /kun dga' bo rgyal posnyem skyes dgra de la rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ rgyal po ma skyes ñtsatshodagra de de na gnas so/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i mdun na 'don bram ze gling ldan zhes bya ba snying du sdug cing mthong na mi 'thunakhupa med pa dang ldan pa zhig yod do/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras durigs bzhi'i mi thams cad bsdus 3)nas bram ze gling ldan bkug ste/ cod pan bcings nas rgyal srid phyed byin te 'di skad ces7kyang61—511

smras so/ /bram ze khyod rang gi yul du song ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang byos la ming yang pad ma can du thogs shig /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyisaturang gi yul du rgyal po'i pho brang byas te/ ming yang pad ma can du btags so/ /kun dga' bo de ltar ②de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dzam bu'i nigling 'di na rgyal po gnyis rgyal srid byed de/ gcig ni ma skyes dgra'odu/ /cig shos ni gling ldan rnal/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyi btsun mo dam pa khang bzangs kyi7yang thog na bde bar nyal zhing 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mar me ⑦mdzad dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'phos nas glang po che'i phuphug thal kuralo1༄du bsgyur te/ 'od zer rab tu 'gyed cing ma'i glo g.yas par zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe btsun mo dam pa des rgyal po gling ldan la skabs 'diratshwa)smras so/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyis bram ze mtshan mkhan dang / ltas mkhan dang / mchod7sbyin mkhanatsornams bsdus te rmi lam gyi7skabs 'di bsnyad pa dang / bram ze mtshan mkhan rnams kyis smras pa/rgyal po chen po khyod kyis rnyed7pa legs par rnyed de⑩/ khyod kyi sras sems can rin po che zhig bltam par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan rmi lam bstan pa 'di thos nas dga' zhing mgu la yinerangs te/ rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ rgyal po gling ldan de'i rgyal khams su gtogs pa thams cad la sbyin pa byin te/ 'di lta ste/ zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas/ skom 'dod pa rnams la ni skom/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhon pa/ spos dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / byug pa dang / gnas mal rung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / gang ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad 61—512

byin no/ /kun dga' bo de nas zla ba bcu 'das pa dang / rgyal po gling ldan gyi bu gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig btsas te/ btsasatum thag tu lus las 'di lta bu'i 'od byung ste/ 'od des7rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang thams cad snang bas khyab par gyur to①/ /de nas de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin rang gi gnas nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ gzhon nu gang na ba der song ste phyin nas gzhon nu de la shis par brjod pa byas te/ 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /'di btsas ma thag tu lus las 'di lta bu'i 'od byung ste/ 'od des rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang thams cad snang bas khyab par gyur pas gzhon nu'i ming mar me mdzad du btags so/ /de nas gzhon nu'i ming mar me mdzad mar me mdzad ces bya bar gyur to/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan dga' zhing mgukhul yikyirangs te rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ yang de'i rgyal khams su gtogs pa thams cad la sbyin pa byin te/ 'di lta ste/zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas/ skom 'dod pa rnamasakyil ni skom/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhin pa/ spos dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / byug pa dang —/ gnas mal rung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / gang ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad byin no/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyis rgyal bu gzhon nu mar me mdzad bkug ste/ cod pan bcings nas rgyal sridashephyed byin te / 'di skad ces kyang7smras so/ /gzhon nu khyod song la btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug cing rtses shig /dga' bar gyis shig /dga' dgur spyod cig /kun dga' bo de nas re zhigatson rgyal bu gzhon nu mar me mdzad btsun 61—513

mo'i 'khor 1gyi nang du song nas bzhin pa chen po la zhonashete/ bud med kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas skyed ( nyemos tshal gyi gnas su song ba dang /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu dag gcig gis bdag cag ④nyid rgas shing 'khogs pa dang / nad kyis btab pa dang / shi ba yangasnyibastan te dge sbyong zhig kyang der bzhag pa dang / rgyal bu gzhon nu mar me mdzad kyis mthong nas kha lo sgyur ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye〈beb lo sgyur〈peb rnam pa sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag ci yin/ kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di dag ni rgas pa rin zhes bgyi ba dang / na ba zhes bgyi ba dang / shi ba zhes bgyi ba lags te/gzhon nu ji srid du chos nyid gdags59 pa mchis pa de srid du rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba'i chos rnams mchis te gzhon nu 1 rikhrod dang 'o skol yang de lta bu lags te/ 'khor ba na gnas pa kho na lags so/ /gzhon nus smras pa/kha lo sgyur ba mgo 511bregs te gos 12ngur smrig gyon la zhi zhing nye bar zhi bcaganya' shing gang tsam du blta 14ba 'di su zhig /kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di ni dge slong ste/ sdig pa thams cad spangs pa thar pa las7mngon par dga' ba'i 'du tsoshes bskyed nyu nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba lags so / /gzhon nus smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba legs so legs so/ /dge slong 'di'i lam 'di ni 'dod pa yin no zhes nas phyir log ste 1)khyim du song ngo / /kun dga' bo de nas re zhig tshen rgyal bu gzhon nu mar me mdzad yang skyedatshwakyemos tshal gyi zhu gnas su song ngo / /de skyedarwa rtemos tshal gyi gnas su phyin pa dang / de na sangs rgyas brgya stong mang pos bstana'agepa'i byang chub kyi snying po mthong ngo / /kun dga' bo de nas byang chub sems dpa' mar me mdzad kyis byang chub kyi snying 61wa 514

po de mthong nas skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs thams cad ha cang thag mi ring bar bor nas byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ des7)byang chub kyi snying po mthong ba dang / lan gsum bskor〈mib byas nas byang chub kyi snying po der skyil mo krung〈kyebacas te 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' mar me mdzad 'dug ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe de nyid kyi mtshan mo'i skya rengs ④dang po shar ba'i dus na de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas ma thag tu de'i tshe sku las 'di lta bu'i 'od byung ste/ 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bas khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin rang gi gnas nas mi snang bar (6)gyur te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas sgra 'di skad ces kyang bsgrags so/ /kye ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'di 'jig rten du byung ste/ 'di ltar de'i587'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bas khyab par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad lo lnga bcu'i bar du byang chub kyi snying po de na bzhugs kyang tha na sems can gcig tsamatsha97yang blta ba dang ske/ phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang gi 7'khor gyi mi rnams 37bde ba dang ldan pa'i phyir blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya 61—515

ba'i phyir nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /kun dga' bo de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams bde ba dang ldan pas ha cang bag med par gyur gyi/ ngas denyernams cung zhig yid byung bar bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis de'i tshe 'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad pas rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i (mipho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams kyi nang du be+e ②drur+ya dulas byas pa'i grong khyer chen po blta na sdug pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang la/ mi de dag kyang lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par blta na sdug (snyepa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dag cig mngon par sprul to/ /de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams bai ⑥drur+ya tshulas byas pa'i grong khyer na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyis spa gong bar ni gyur na gang yang skyo bar ni ma gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams ha cang bag med pa dang ldan par gyur pasatshunangs yang cung zhig skyo nyu༄ba bskyed par bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis yang 'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad de / rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad pas be+eḍūdrur+ya /glelas byas pa'i grong khyer chen po de la me chen po 'bar bar byin gyis 61—516

brlabs so/ /byin gyis brlabs ma thag tu de la me 'bar bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe sems can de dag dang grong khyer chen po de yanganyeyongs su zad cing mthar thug pa dang zhig par gyur nas sems can de dag kyang tshul ma yin pa mthong bas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams kyis bai ②drur+ya ①las byas pa'i grong khyer chen po rgyad par mthong nas dngangs ④spag par gyur cing skyo ⑤bar gyur nas spu zing zhes byed de/ de dag 'di snyam du sems par gyur to/ /gang gi phyir grong khyer de yongs su zad cing mthar thug pa dang zhig par gyur pa las na ring po mi thogs ①par bdag cag kyang de lta bu'i mi rtag ⑦pa'i gnas skabs su gyur phyen su zhig bdag cag gi skyabs su 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi 'di rnams yongs su smin pas ngas chos bstan pa kun shes par nus shing skal ba dang ldan pa dang mthu yod par gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyis mi de rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas de'i tshe dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis byang chub kyi snying po de las7bzhengs te/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong lha'i dbang po brgya ⑩byin dang thabs cig 8tu rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang ga la btsoder gshegs so/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad byon ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyis chos bstan pa dang po'i7tshe srog chags nyi 6khri rab tu phyung ste/ de dag thams cad len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /chos bstan pa 61—517

gnyis pa'i tshe srog chags sum khri rab tu phyung ste/ de dag thams cad kyang len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /chos bstan pa gsum pa'i tshe srog chags bzhi khri rab tu phyung ste/ de dag thams cad kyang chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /chos bstan pa bzhi pa'i tshe srog chags lnga khri bar tu phyung ste/ de dag thams cad kyang len pa med pa zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /kun dga' bo de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos yongs su bskor cing7mdun gyis bltas te chos ston to/ /kun dga' bo de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras rgyal po gling ldan gyi bu zhig skyes nas de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes thos nas de lasapho nya btang ste/ 'di ltar bdag kyang mchod par 'tshalashosan bdag gi thad du gshegs par gsol zhes spring ngo / /de nas pho nya des rgyal po ma skyes dgra las mnyan nas rgyal po gling ldan gyi rgyal po'i pho brang ga la ba dang / rgyal po gling ldan ga la ba der song ste phyin nas phrin 4༄de skad smras so/ /de nas rgyal po gling ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas skabs de gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po khyod snying las chung ngur gyis la slar song shigs /nga ni rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can du gshegs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa〈 byedagra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasams)mar me mdzad dge slong gi dge 61—518

'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing / rgyal po gling ldan yang rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang / rgyal po'i tshogs mang po dang / rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul0pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i bdog pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i rnam par rtse ba chen po dang chas7te yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te thabs cigasho tu gshegs so/ /kun dga' bo de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad de rim gyis rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na ri'i rgyal po gangs ri la bram ze rin po che zhes bya ba zhig 'dug ste/ bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam la bstan bcos44)dang rig byed dang / gsang sngags thams cad slob tu 'jug go/ /de na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam po de dag gi nang na bram ze'i khye'u sprin ces bya ba gzhon nu dar la bab pa/ gzugs bzang ba/mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/gsang sngags dang / bstan bcos dang / chog shes pa ji snyed pa thams cad la mkhas pa zhig yod do/ /kun dga' bo de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin ces bya bas mkhan po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye mkhan po bdag grong dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams su mchi'o/ /mkhan pos smras pa/ kye bram ze'i khye'u bdag cag bram ze rnams kyi chos nyid ni 'di yin te/ gang gis bstan bcos dang / rig byed dang / gsang sngags thams cad lobs pa des mkhan 61—519

po la zong lngatubargya dang / ras zung gcig5snyedang / kharakhub dang / ril ba rnams sbyin dgos so/ /bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis smras pa/ mkhan po bdag la pagasalgepa dang / kharasnyib dang / ril ba ma gtogs par ci yang ma mchis pas mchi'o/ /lan gsum gyi bar du gsol nas de bzhin gyis shig ces smras so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin rim ⑦gyis ri'i rgyal po gangs las babs nas grong dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du zhugs so/ /de'i tshe na grong khyer chen po bde bar pha rol tu 'gro bsnyen bram ze sa ga bzang po zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de la bu mo bzang len ldan zhes bya ba gzugs bzang7ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de'i phyir nyi ma re re zhing bram ze bzhi khri la zan sbyin par byed cing / de rnams kyi nang na thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin pa de la bdag gi bu mo sbyin no snyam pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu zhig gis bram ze'i khye'u sprin la grong khyer chen po bde bar pha rol tu 'gro ba'i lam bstan no0/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin mchod sbyin gyi gnas ga la ba der song ste phyin to/ /bram ze'i khye'u sprin mchod sbyin gyi gnas der phyin tem thag tu de'i tshe bu mo des rang gi7pha ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab bram ze'i khye'u 'di'i mtshan ma ji ltar gda' skyob las na 'di bdag 8gi khyim thab tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin bram ze de dag thams cad dang lhan cigatsokun tu smra bar byed cing / de na bram ze sprin nyid bstan bcos dang / gsang sngags dag gis khyad par du 'phags so/ /de'i tshe na mchod sbyin gyi gnas der bram ze dum bu byin zhes bya ba zhig rgan gral du 'dug 61—520

ste / mchod sbyin7byed do/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin bram ze dum bu byin ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bram ze dum bu byin dang lhan cig tu rig byed dang gsang sngags dag smra bar byed cings/ de na 'di lta ste/ sprin nyid rig byed dang ske/ gsang sngags dang / bstan bcos dag gis khyadashepar du 'phags so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis bram ze dum bu byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye bram ze bdag cag bram ze rnams kyi chos nyid ni gang gis bstan bcos thams cad rtogs shing khong du chud pa de stan59mchog la 'dug pa yin no/ /de nas yang bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis bram ze dum bu ⑤byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze chen po 'dir kho bo 'dug57gis stan 'di las longs shig /de nas bram ze dum bu byin gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u nga〈stan 'di las ma bslang shigashedang / kho bos zong lnga brgya thob pa khyod la sbyin rna smras pa/kho bo la mi dgos so/ /de ma langs pa dang de'i mgrin pa nas bzung ste bslang ngo —/ /de nas bram ze dum bu byin gyis bram ze'i khye'u sprin la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u khyod kyis kho bo stan7'di las bslangs nas tho btsams shing dngangs par byas pas khyod gang dang gang du skyes pa'i skye ba thams cad du sbyin pa'i bar chad bya'o zhes dam bcas so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin seng ge'i khri de la 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze sa ga bzang pos bu mo bzang len ldan lag migayas pas bzungasreste/ gser gyi khar ba dang / ril bcadang / ras zung gcig dang / zong lnga brgya khyer nas bram ze'i khye'u sprinam/3ga la ba der song ste7phyin nas/ bram ze'i khye'u sprin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di dag long shidzo /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis zong lnga brgya dang / ras zung 61—521

gcigs17dang / khar na ba dang / ril ba rnams blangs te bu mo de ma blangs so/ /'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /bud med 'dis ( ci zhig bya/ bud med ni spre'u dang 'dra ste/ rgod pa 'phyar54)ba dge ba'i bar chad byed pa yin la/ kho bo ni dgon pa dang rab tu dben pa rnams na gnas pas 95)'di kho bo la mi dgos so/ /rigs kyi bu bdag la snying brtse ba'i phyir long rinashig(7) /des0)ma blangs so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin mchod sbyin gyi gnas de nas song ste ri'i rgyal po gangs ga ri9)la ba der song ngo / /de nas bram ze sa ga bzang pos bu mo bzang len ldan la smras pa/ bu mo khyod khyim thab kyi phyi bzhin ci'i phyir mi 'gro/des de'i tshig mnyan te/ mnyan nas ri'i rgyal /1 po gangs ga la ba de7logs su 'phags so/ /de'i tshe na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu zhig gis ri'i rgyal po gangs su 'gro ba'i lam mi snang bar byas nas rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can du gang nas 'gro ba'i lam bstan cing / gang du bram ze'i khye'u sprin dro 'debs pa der bu mo bzang len ldan yang dgongs 'debs so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u des rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can dar gyi lda ldi nyu)bres pa/ me tog bkram pa/bdug spos 'thul ba'i snod dngar ba mthong nas des dris pa/ grong khyer chen po 'di ci'i rgyus mngon par brgyan par gyur/ de nas rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams kyis bram ze'i khye'u sprin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u khyod kyis ma thos sam/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de 8rgyal po ma skyes dgas spyan drangs nas de 'dir byon pa'i phyir grong khyer chen po mngon par brgyan to/ /de nas bram ze'i 61—522

khye'u sprin 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag bram ze rnams kyi nang na gang bstan bcos thams cad la spyod tsho pa gsal zhing mkhas pa yang (nyadakon na/sems can rin po che 'di ltar5ge'ajig rten du byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos kyis 54bdag gis zong lnga brgya po 'dis me tog nyos la de bzhin gshegs pa la55)mchod pa7bya gor ma chag snyam nas des phan tshun me tog btsal na gang nas kyang ma rnyed 57pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi rnams na re bram ze'i khye'u khyod kyis ma thos sam/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras bka' stsal te/me tog thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la mchod pa bya dgos kyisal / 'di ltar su yang ri9me tog nyor yang mi gnang / 'tshong du yangam mi gnang ngo / /gang zhig gis nyos sam btsongs na ngas de chad pa chen pos gcadalo11do zhe'o/ /de me tog tshol ba na bu mo bzang len ldan mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u ci tshol/ bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis smras pa/bu mo me tog tshol lo/ /de nas bu mo bzang len ldan me tog phreng brgyud 12mkhan zhig gi ()khyim ga la ba der song ste skaphyin nas me tog phreng brgyud tshamakhan de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo la me tog byin cig /kho mo'i khyim thab la dgos so/ /me tog phreng brgyud tshamakhan gyis smras pa/ tsho/ bu mo khyod kyis ma thos sam/ 'di ltar rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'di skad ces bka' stsal te/me tog thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la mchod pa bya dgos kyisapo / 'di ltar su yang /(me tog 'tshong du 'angs tshomi gnang / nyor yang mi gnang (1ngo / /gang zhig gis nyos sam btsongs na ngas 22de chad pa chen po gcad 3do zhe'o/ /lan gsum gyi bar du bslang ba 24dang de bzhin bya'o zhes 61—523

zer ro6)/ /de nas bu mo bzang len ldan gyis bum pa blangasalgenas ud pa la bdun bcug ste/ grong khyer du song nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin mthong ba dang mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces7smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u ci tshol/ bu mo me tog tshol lo/ /smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u ci bya/ smras pa/ bu mo bskyed par bya'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ ud pa la btogs ①zin pa gang dag yang skye bar 'gyur ba ni kho mos nam yang ma thos ma mthong ngo / /smras pa/ bu mo gang la bskyed pa tsam gyis skye ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing de lta bu lashibaskyed do/ /des0smras pa/gal te kho mo gang dang gang du skyes pa'i skye ba thams cad du khyod kho mo'i khyim thab tu 'gyur ba57dam 'cha' na de'i phyir ud pa la sbyin no/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni dgon pa dang rab tu dben pa na gnas pa yin la/ bud med ni rgod pa/ 'phyar ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad byed pa yin pas bud med 'dis ci zhig bya snyam mo/ /lan bdun gyi bar du smras pa dang ske/ de bzhin du gyur cigasheces smras so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'di skad ngas thos sngon srid na/ /sangs rgyas mar me 'jig rten byung / /'khor ni mang po bdun stong dang / /pad ma can du de phyin to/ /de yi phyir ni rgyal mtshan bsgrengasal/ /rnga ni brgya phrag de phyir brdungasatshu/ /grong khyer thams cad kun sbyangs7shing / /lam sung bzhi ni de phyir brgyan/ /grong khyer brgyan pa de mthong nas/ /bram ze'i khye bus dris pa ni/ /gang gi phyir ni rgyal mtshan bsgrengasatso/ /gang phyir rnga ni brgya phrag brdungasanyunye/ /grong khyer thams cad kun sbyangs shing / /gang phyir lam sung bzhi brgyan pa'i/ /bsam pa de ni lung ston cig /rig byed shes 61—524

khyod ma thos sam/ /sangs rgyas mar me 'jig rten byung / /'khor ni mang po bdun stong dang / /pad ma can7du de byon te/ /de yi phyir ni rgyal mtshan bsgrengs② / /de phyir rnga ni brgya phrag brdungasal/ /grong khyer thams cad kun sbyangs shing / /de phyir lam srang bzhi brgyan to/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sgra thos nas / /sangs rgyas yon tan gyis mgu ste/ / rings par0myur du song ba dang —/ /rgyang nas bram ze'i bu mo mthong / /pad ma ud pal g.yo ba'i mig /chu skyes thogs shing sgo na 'dug /de yis bram ze'i khye'u mthong nas/ /snyan pas smra bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ka la ping ka rma bya'i sgra/ /yid 'ong ngang mo khu byug sgraX/ /sgra chen spangs nas tshangs pa'i sgrasal/ /bram ze'i khye'u la bu mos smras⑤ / /khye'u ci nags kyi nang na de/ /sbyin sreg byed cing rig 'don la/ /rgyal po'i dmag gis ma gtses sam/ /'khrugs shing lam srang dag tu rgyu/ /bu mo nga khyim gnyen 'dun med/ /yongs su gzung7ba'ang nga la med/ /'dod pa'i yon tan nga mi 'dod/ /bu mo rgyal dmag nga mi gnod/ /nga de dag lasarwanyezan mi za/ /chos gos gos kyang mi len te/ /shes bzhin brdzun7ni mi smra na/ /bu mo rgyal dmag nga mi gnod/ /'bras bu rtsa bas nags na gnas/ /bu mo rgyal dmag nga mi gnod/ /seng phrug dag gis ma gtses sam/ /'bras rtsahūnags na med dam ci/ /ci'i phyir khyod ni brtan par 'ongs/ /seng ge'i phrugacagus ma gtses te/ /nags na 'bras bu rtsa ba yod/ /bzang mo ud pal dgos pa'i phyir/ /de phyir nga 'dir grong khyer 'ongs/ /gal te shed bu lang tsotsoyis/ /dregs lus brgyan phyir bram ze5)khye'u/ /bdag gi ud pal 'tsham pa yin/ /bdag gi phreng phyir mi nyo la/ /ud pal bsnams phyir 61—525

'dod pa min/ /brtse 1)ldan mar me mdzad kyi phyir/ /bzang mo bdag ni ud pal slong / /bde bar pha rol 'gro ba na/ /gang du pha las〈zan zos tshe/ /bslangs zhiba'i tshig smras mi dran nas/ /'dzem med ci phyir me tog slong / /bzang mo ud pal54)rin du dbyig /lnga brgya 'di byin dge mas gnangs/ /sangs rgyas yon tan tshol ba la/ /bzang mo bgegs ni ma byed cig /bzang mo bdag gi gzhi byas nas/ /slong ba rnams kyi bgegs su 'gyur/ /gzhan lta zhog gi bram ze'i khye'u/ /gal te slong la bdag (6byin na/ /bdag ni khyod kyi bgegs mi byed/ /bdag smon 'dir gyur gzhan du min/ /de gnyis smon lam btab nas ni/ /bram ze'i khye 'us ud pal blangs/ /de dag ud pal thogs nas kyang / /rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal〈penas/ /gal te bdag lus skams gyur cing / /bdag gi rus pa dkar〈85gyur kyang / /byang chub lung ma bstan bar du/ /bdag ni de ring mi ldang ngo / /bdag smon der gyur gzhan du min/ /de nas bu mo bzang len ldan gyis ud pa la lnga blangs te bram ze'i khye'u sprin la byin nas bram ze'i khye'u ud pa la 'di dag long la rang gi ming gis skrun cig /bram ze'i khye'u ud pa la 'di gnyis kyang kho mo'i ming gis skrun cig /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin ud pa la de dag khyer nas/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad mdzes pa dang bar 7bya ba/ dbang po dul ba/ thugs dul ba/mchog tu dul ba/ dang zhing zhi ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ dul ba dang zhi ba'i dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ glang po chen po dbang po bsrung lhazhing7thul ba/mtsho ltar dang zhing rnam par dang la rnyog pa med pa'i 1lhagaser gyi mchod sdong hurte61wa 526

ltar mngon par 'phags pa/ dpal gyis brjid pa/ gzi brjid kyis 'bar ba mthong ngo / /sems can bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / khye'u dang / bu mo brgya phrag du ma dang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang ske/ dri za dang / nam mkha' 1)lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po mang po dang / rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang 92btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig tu me tog dang / me tog phrengamatsho nodang / spos dang byug pa thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir 'ong ba yangasko4)mthong nas/ yang 'di snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 95)rtsa gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin par〈phyibadag gis thos na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'di la ni mtshan sum cu77)zhig snang ste / mtshan gnyis ni mi snang bas tshonamatshan sum cu497rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyi sems kyi kun tu rtog pa thugs su chud nas/ rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu tshimangon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad pas skyes bu chen po'i0nyamatshan sum cu nya2rtsa gnyis po de dag snang bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad denyurte/ bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis de mthong nas yang bram ze'i khye'u sprin dga' zhing mgu la yi tsharangs te/ rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas pags 6pa de bting ba dang / de nas rgyal po'i pho brang pad ma can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ba'i mi tshade dag gis pags 1 tshopa de blangs nas/ phan 61—527

tshun0)du bor te bram ze'i khye'u sprin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u ma smyos sam/ gang du rgyal po'i na bza' gding ba der khyod kyis pags pa btsog⑧pa 'di gding bar byed/ de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis pagasalgepa blangs nas/lam las bzur9)te/ lam gol bar 'dug5snyenas bden pa'i tshig 'di byas so ) / /bden pa dang bden tshig gang gis 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa/ 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba yin na/shul las bzurasho te bdag gi ral pa la zhabs 'jog par gyur cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad zhal phyir gzigs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang du nga'i zhabs gnyis 'jog pa der khyod kyis gzhag par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i ral pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad shul las bzur phyinas bram ze'i khye'u sprin gang na bar gshegs te byon pa dang / zhabs gnyis ral pa'i steng der bzhag〈pego/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin zhing bosa'i steng de nas langs nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ud pa la de dag gtor to/ /gtor ma thag tu de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug gi steng gi drang thad du ud pa la'i khang pa brtsegs pa grwa bzhir ka btsasprebazhi zug7pa/ cha mnyam pa shin tu rnam par phye ba/nyams5snyedaga' ba/ yid du 'ong ba zhig gnas par gyur te/ khang pa brtsegs pa de na yang 8/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku snang ngo / /de nas de bzhin 61—528

pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/yonye༄༅bha /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sdi (2bi ban+t+ra dbyu ka ra ṇa nā ma ma pahā yā na 5)sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod phung po'i ri la dge slong lnga stong gi dge slong gi 7nodage 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' brgyad stong mngon par grags pa sku/ mngon par shes pa thob pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ mi 'jigs pa thob pa/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ theg pa chen po'i rjes su song ba sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mu khyud 'dzin dang / sa 'dzin dang / bang rim 'dzin dang /61—542

mchod sbyin rus07'dzin dang / snang ba'i blo gros dang / rnam par dag pa'i blo gros dang / sbyangs pa'i blo gros dang / khyad par blo gros dang / mtha' yas blo gros dang / 'phel ba'i blo gros dang / mthong dga' dang / legs mthong dang —/ cher snang dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don kun mthong la sogs pa dang thabs cig natu bzhugs so/ /byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 92 thams cad kyang 'khorabade nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po na rten 5cing bzhugs te/ rgyal po dang —/ rgyal po'i bu rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / khyim bdag rnams dang / blon po rnams dang / 'khor rnams dang / grong rdal pa dang /yul gyi mi rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo nebyas/ mchod pa byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor snga dro'i dus kyi tshe smad g.yogs dang —/ chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 0te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdang sum 3)bdag gi rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa zhig mthong ste/ des phyag g.yas pa gser gyi mdog can brkyang nas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ rab 'byor sang 79khyod kyi misngon ma thos pa'i chos ston pa thos71)par 'gyur ro zhes de tshaskad ces bka' stsal na/ bcom ldan 'das de gang gi snga ltas lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 61—543

'byor de ni rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo chos 'dod pa rnams kyi sngon ma thos pa'i chos thos par 'gyur ba'i sngatsho)ltas yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de'i dus la dbab par shes nas song shig(5) /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por mthar chags su bsod snyoms la rgyu zhing song ba las/ khyim bdag cigashegi gnas ga la ba der song ste phyin nas sgo khang gi nang logs su cang mi smra bar sdod do/ /de nas khyim de'i nang nas bud med mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ blta na sdug pa/ rgyanasagyis legs par bklubasamanate/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / byitswaru dang /gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dpal shin tu 'bar ba/ kha dog rgyas shing mdzes pa dang ldan pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas bud med des tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor khyod ci zhig bzhed pa'i slad du sgo khang 'di na gzhes(kye/ rab 'byor gyis smras〈)pa/ che zhe bdag ni bsod snyoms 'dod pa'i phyir sgo gang 'di na sdod do/ /bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor khyod la da dung yang bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes 'byung lags sam/btsun pa rab 'byor khyod la da dung yang bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes thugs su ma 61—544

chud dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ che zhe bdag gis bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes7ni khong du chud mod kyi/ 'on kyang pha ma las skyes pa'i lus 'bras chan〈gedang zanasadron gyis bskyedasapa 'di zas medasnyikyi bar du 'tsho bar mi nus so/ /bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gyis ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shesalgepa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gags pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang /smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa 'gag⑧pa mngon sum du ma mdzad dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/che zhe bdag gis 'gog pa mngon sum du byas so/ /smras pa btsun pa rab 'byor ci zhig ni 'gogashepar 'gyur/ chos gang ni rab tu bsgom par bgyi/ smras pa che zhe 'gog pa ni chos gang gi rab tu bsgom par bya ba yang 37ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te 'gog pa chos gang gi rab tu bsgom pa yang ma lags na btsun pa rab 'byor gyi lus bsod snyoms kyis ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyurate/ smras pa/ che zhe 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs te tshor ba thams cad bkag7pa las langs〈3pa'i lus 'tsho bar byed do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te gtan du mya ngan las 'das na khyod kyi lus ji ltar 'tsho ba la 'jug par 'gyur/ smras pa/ che zhe bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams ni 61—545

lus 'tsho bar bya ba'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa/ des na0)bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu ma bstan getam/ smras pa/ che zhe de yin no/ /smras pa/ ci nyon mongs pa med pa de rgyu ba'am rab tu rgyu ba lags sam/ smras pa/ che zhe ma yin no / /smras pa/ 'o na ci'i slad du btsun pa rab 'byor bsod snyoms la rgyu ba mdzad / smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni lus chalo ciba'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu ba ma yin gyi/ srog gi phyir tshor ba dgag pa'i don du bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa / btsun pa rab 'byor da dung yang tshor bas 'phrogs sam/ smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni tshor bas mi 'phrogs mod kyi/ tshor ba dgag pa'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongs pa med pa ni (snyamatshungs pa med pa ste/ de ci'i slad 5du zhe na/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa ni lus dang sems kyi tshor ba myong ba ma mchis so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni lus dang sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa ma lags so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni dga' ba'am / yid ne mi dga' ba skyed pa mi bgyid do/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni su la yang nyon mongs pas nye bar gnas pa ma mchis so/ /gzhan yang gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan na( no/ ci'i slad du ni nyon mongs pa med pa nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bgyi/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ che zhe dmigs pa med pa'i nyon mongs pa med pa ni 'dod chags kyi rdul dang bral ba yin no/ /smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor ci nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ram/ smras pa/8 che zhe ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor 61—546

'o na nyon mongs pa med pa de 0)ji ltar 'dod chags kyi rdul dang bral bar gyur/smras pa/ che zhe nyon mongs pa med par bstan pa 'di ni bshad pa tsam du zad do / /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ci nyon mongs pa med pa la bshad pa mchis sam/ smras pa/ che zhe med do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te nyon mongs pa med pa la bshad pa ma mchis na ci zhig 'chad (57cing bzhugs/smras pa/ che zhe bcom ldan 'das kyi (kyinyan thos rnams ni tha snyad5getsam gyis tha snyad du 'dogs par zad do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ji tsam du brjod pa mchis pa de tsam du tha snyad 'dogs so/ /ji tsam du tha snyad 'dogs pa de tsam du phyin ci log go/ /jim5tsam du phyin ci log pa de tsam du rtsod par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam du rtsod pa de tsam du dge sbyong gi chos ma lags so/ /smras pa / che zhe 'o na dge sbyong gi chos gang yin/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gi chos ni tha snyad ma mchis pa/ phyin ci ma log pa rtsod pa ma mchis pa'o / /dge sbyong gi55)chos ni chos dang chos ma lags pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chags pa dang ma chags pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni yul ma mchis pa dang / yul ma lags pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chags pa ma mchis pa dang / ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chog shes pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni phrag7dog dang chags pa spangs pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 'dod pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa dang zhen pa ma mchis pa'o8)/ /dge 61—547

sbyong gi chos ni phung po'i bdud las nges par grol ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa ste/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud las yang dag par 'das pa'o / /dge sbyong gi chos ni ma skyes pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 'chi bdag gi bdud dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni g.yo ba ma mchis pa dang / rlom sems ma mchis pa dang / rtog0)pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam par ma bsgribasakhupa dang / spyad pa〈nyam lags pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni bdud kyi yul las yang dag par 'das pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni blang ba ma mchis pa dang /dor ba ma mchis pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni skye ba dang / 'jig pa dang bral ba'o / /dge sbyong gi chos ni lha'i bu'i bdud dang ma 'bags pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni yid la byed pa ma mchis pa dang / thams cad du gos pa ma mchis pa'o / /dge sbyong gi chos ni mngon par zhen pa ma mchis pa dang / mtshan ma masremachis pa dang / mtshan ma thams cad dang bral5geba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni khams dang khams ma lags pa'i tshul thams cad kyis bcos pa ma lags pa dang /bgrang ba dang / bral ba dang / gnas ma mchis pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos bstan pa 'di bshad pa na sgo gang der lha'i bu gang dag chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus pa de dag las lha'i bu bzhi stong chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /rgya chen po la mos pa'i lha'i bu lnga brgya ni bud med de'i spobs pa thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor 'di snyam du sems te/ che zhe 'di 'di ltar spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de ni ngo mtshar te/ che zhe 'di'i spobs pa 'di 'dra ba las na 'di 61—548

ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa yin par the tsom0)med rdo7snyam mo/ /de nas bud med de'i sems kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi sems shes nas gnas brtan rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor 'di ltar 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa yin par the tsomasamed do snyam du dgongs pa de ni ji ltar dgongs pa de bzhin te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin nyid thugs su chud pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang de bzhin nyid khong du chud de/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'ol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid dang / tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyang de nyid de/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni nams kyangasre/ de bzhin nyid ma lags par mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lags ⑤pa de ni nams kyang ⑥de bzhin nyid ma lags par mi 'gyur te/ des na /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni res 'ga' de bzhin nyid du 'gyur ba ma lags 'kho/ bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de yang res 'ga' de bzhin nyid du 'gyur ba ma lags kyi/ rtag tu de bzhin nyid de kho na lags so/ /des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni yang dag 61—549

pa ji lta ba dang / gzhan ma yin pa de ni0)de bzhin nyid de/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe ci khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bdag gi sems shes sam/ 'on te rang gi shes pas shes smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor nyan thos rnams sam/ rang sangs rgyas rnams sam/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams sam/ drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa gang yang rung ste/ sems can gzhan gyi sems shes pa de dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus gzhan gyi sems shes pa lags so/ /de ltar gnas brtan rab 'byor gzhan gyi sems mkhyen pa gang lags pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus mkhyen pa lags so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor dper na zla ba dang / nyi ma dang /me dang / nor bu dang / mar me dang / skar ma la brten nas skyes bu mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis gzugs rnams mthong ba de bzhin du btsun pa rab 'byor ma rig pa'i mun pa ni (mi'ajig rten gnas pa las gang su dag pha rol gyi sems shes pa de dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa la brten nas shes pa lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe khyod 'di lta bu'i spobs pa dang ldan pa khyod su yin pa dang /ga las 'ongs pa bdags dal ston cig /bud med des smras 54)pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la 'dri ste/ rigs kyi bu khyod su yin pa dang / ga las 'ongs pa bdag la ston cig ces de skad〈nyesmras na/ji skad du lan 'debs rinesapar 'gyur/ smras pa/ che zhe cungasko7zad kyang lan gdab tu med do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de bzhin du chos thams 61—550

cad sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du shes na bdag gis ci zhig zhes 517su mchis / gzhan yang gang zhig btsun pa rab 'byor la 'dri ste/ ci khyod so so'i skye bo yin nam/ 'on te slob pa'am/ dgra bcom pa yin zhes de skad smras na/lan ji skad gdab/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor sems pa la zhugs te/che zhe 'di'i lan ji skad gdab par bya snyam mo/ /de nas bar snang las btsun pa rab 'byor khyod kyis cung5gezad cigs nithob pa'am/ rtogs pa'am/ mngon sum du byas pa'am/ mngon par rtogs pa gang gis dgra bcom pa yin par shes pa de che zhe 'di la ston cig ces sgra byung ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bar snang de las sgra byung ba de'age)thos nas bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so / /che zhe bdag ni so so'i skye 51bo yang ma yin/ slob pa yang ma yin/ dgra bcom pa yang ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de bdag gis ji ltaranyugazung bar bgyi/ smras pa/ che zhe de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i gdags pa ji lta ba de bzhin du bdag la zung shigaX /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ni dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog dang yon gnas zhes 8bgyi ba lags so/ /smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi (9rimachog dang yon gnas ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ltar na shes bzhin gyis brdzun 1 rdzogasung bar mi 'gyur ram/ smras pa/ che zhe gal te bdag zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog dang / yon gnas yin par 'dzin par gyur na ni de ltar na bdag brdzun du 7smra bar 'gyur na/ gang gi phyir bdag de ltar mi 'dzin pa de'i phyir 61—551

bdag ni yang dag par smra ba yin gyi brdzun7du smra ba zhes mi bya'o/ /smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor sgo gang ②'dir lha bden pa mthong ba chos mnyan⑧pa'i phyir 'dus pa rnams la slu bar mi 'gyur ram/ smras pa/ che zhe bden pa mthong ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni slu bar mi nus so/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gyis bden pa rnams gzigs sam/ smras pa/ mthong ngo / /smras pa/ gal te bden pa rnams mthong du rungasnyin ni de dag bden pa ma lags par 'gyur ro//de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bden pa rnams ni sus kyang mthong bar mi nus pa'i slad du'o / /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ che zhe bden pa mthong ba57zhes bya ba de gang gi tshig bla dgas7yin/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor bden pa mthong ba zhes bgyi ba de ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du yang dag par mthong ba'i tshig bla dgas57so/ /bden pa mthong zhes bgyi ba de ni phyin ci log yang dag par mthong ba'i tshig bla dgasa'uso/ /smras pa/ che zhe khyod kyis gang las bsams te de skad smras/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor phyin ci log gis nyon mongs pa kun nas bslang ba gang lags pa de ni bden pa mthong bas skye bar 'gyur te/des na phyin ci log yang dag par mthong bas bden pa mthong zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas sgo gang der chos mnyan ⑨pa'i phyir lha 'dus pa de dag gis gnas brtan rab 'byor la rags7pa'i lus bstan nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor khyod kyis che zhe 'di'i spobs pa thos pa de57ni khyod kyis rnyed pa legs pa nyu)rnyed do/ /sems can gang dag gis bstan pa 'di thos nas7mos pa de dag kyang rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa yin no/ /gang dag mos pa de dag ni gang las kyang rnam par grol ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mos pa mang bca61—552

rnams ni gang las kyang rnam par grol ba med do/ /mos pa mang blto)la ni 'ching ba med pas na⑧de ni gang las kyangasarnam par grol ba med do/ /de nas bud med des yang tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor bsod snyoms la rgyur mi bzhudasnyidam/ bshos bcadasnyide ci bgyi/smras pa/ che zhe bdag gi zas ni 'di nyid yin te/ chos mnyan pa 'di lta bus chog go/ /che zhe gang chos gos dang bsod snyoms kyi phyir yid mi bde ba skye ba de ni chos 'dod pa ma yin no/ /gang rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang /tshigs su bcad pa 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa ma yin no/ /gang lus dang /srog dang / bsod snyoms 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa ma yin no/ /gang tha na legs so zhes bya ba 'dod pa de yang57chos 'dod pa ma yin no/ /smras pa/ che zhe rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag5nyachos 'dod pa ji lta bu yin/ smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor gang 'dod pa la mi srid7pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang mig dang gzugs mi 'dod pa dang / rna ba dang / sgra dang / sna dang / dri dang ske/ lce dang / ro dang / lus dang / reg bya dang / yid dang / chos mi 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang chos ci la yang mi rten pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gzhan yang gang dag phung po dang / khams dang ske/ skye mched mi 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang 'dod pa dang /gzugs dang / gzugs med pa mi 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang dmigs pa'i mtshan ma la dmigs pa mi 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe bzod par gyis shig /bdag sgo gang shi'adi nas 'gro'o/ /bud med des 61—553

smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor dper na sa'i khams la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du btsun pa rab 'byor gang gi sems sa dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo(17/ /btsun pa rab 'byor chu la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du gang gi sems chu dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo//btsun pa rab 'byor me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du gang gi sems me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gru ②dang /stegs dang / zam pa dang / lam po che la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du btsun pa rab 'byor gang gi sems gru dang / stegs dang / zam pa dang / lam po che dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor byis pa rnams la ni rabazod pa gsol lnga'atshal gyi 'phags pa rnams la ni 5ribazod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gang dag la gnod sems dang / khro ba dang / bag la nyal skye ba de56)dag la ni bzod pa gsol 'tshal gyi ri/ gang dag la mi skye ba de dag la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor dper na me 'bar ba ni zhi bar bgyi 'tshal gyi/ me〈8)mi 'bar ba ni zhi bar bgyi59)mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du btsun pa rab 'byor gang dag gi nyon mongs pa 'bar nyu ba de dag la ni bzod pa gsol 'tshal gyi/ gang dag nyon mongs pa med pa de dag la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe khyod ci zhig 'dod na 'di ltar seng ge'i sgra sgrogs/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gang 'dod pa mchis pa des ni seng ge'i sgra sgrogs par sna mi nus so/ /gang dag 61—554

ci yang mi 'dod pa de dag ni seng ge'i sgra sgrogs par bgyid do/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ dmigs pa mchis pa la ni 'dod pa mchis la/ gang la dmigs pa ma mchis pa de la ni seng ge'i sgra ci yang ma mchis so/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba mchis pa la ni 'dod pa mchis la/ gang la lta ba'i rnam pa ma4)mchis pa de la ni seng ge'i sgra ci yang ma mchis so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gzhan yang ci zhig bzhed pa las len pa med par zag pa rnams las 90sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur / smras pa/ che zhe 'dod pa yod pa la ni rnam par grol ba ci yang med dom/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gang bzhed pas len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol ba de bzhin du bdag kyang de lta bu'i 'jug pas zhugs so/ /bdag kyang de lta bu'i rnam par grol ba'i 'jug pas zhugs so/ /bdag kyang de lta bu'i chos kyi ri4)dbyings kyi 'jug pas zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe theg pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa rnams dang / rtags gang yin pa rnams dang /mtshan ma gang dag yin pa 'di lta bu dag bdag la ston pa las na/ khyod ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin par the tsom nyamed do/ /bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor theg pa chen po'i rnam pa rnams dang / rtags rnams dang / mtshan ma rnams mkhyen tam/ smras pa/ che zhe nyan thos kyis ni ma thos par theg pa chen po'i rnam pa rnams dang / rtags rnams dang /mtshan ma rnams shes par mi nus kyi/ che zhe theg pa chen po'i rnam pa rnams dang /rtags rnams dang / mtshan ma rnams shod cig /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor theg pa chen po zhes bgyi ba de ni chags pa ma mchis pa'i theg pa dang /61—555
