0210༄ga /'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya k+ṣe ma ②ba tī byā ka ra ṇa nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi ②phung po'i ri la dge slong nyi khri'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byams pa dang / 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu mang po dang thabs cig gtu bzhugs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus kyi tshe chos gos dang sham thabs gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang thabs cig du tu rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du 61—660

mthar chags kyis bsod snyoms rgyu zhing rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i pho brang ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma zhes bya ba khang bzangasatumachog gi steng na 'dug pas bcom ldan 'das thag ring po nas gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sems dga' bar gyur te/ khang bzangs kyi〈misteng nas babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i gdan dar dkar rin ①che ba bting ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa gdan bshams pasnyil bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo dubade ldan ma lus rgyan thams cad kyis ⑥brgyan pas ⑦bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasnyenas chos mnyan pa'i phyir zhe sa dang bcas/ gus pashedang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma lus rgyan 0thams cad kyis brgyan pa la gzigs nas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir mkhyen bzhin du rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma la bka' stsal pa/ bde ldan ma gang lusaspel thogs pa'i 'bras bu 'di lta bu shin tu lham me lhan ne 1)lha 1)nger 'dug pa'i shing de'i ming ci zhes bya/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan mas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gang gi 'bras bu khyod thogs pa/ /shing de'i ming7ni ci yin zhes/ /dpa' bo chen po mkhyen bzhin du/ /gang zag mchog gis rmas 8pa ni/ /bdag gis sngon ni gang bskyed pal/ /bsod nams las byung shing zhes bgyi/ /'dren pa bdag gis myong ba 61—661

gyi / /'bras bu 'disnyedag de yi lags/ /ljon shing bshad pa de nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas nyan thos rnams la yod/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob 'dod rnams/ /byang chub phyir ni de la gnas/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims chab stsal bas/ /ljon shing de ni rnam par bsrungs②/ /de ni rnam par 'khrungs pakun/ /'bras bu bzang po rnams kyang 'byung / /bzod pa dang ni brtson 'grus mthus/ /ljon shing bdag gis legs par bsrungasaX/ /de ni rnam par 'khrungs pa na/ /'bras bu dri med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shing 'di blta na mdzes pa ste/ /bsam gtan shes rab me tog rgyas/ /'dren pa bdag gis de dag gi/ /'bras bu rnams ni myong ba lags/ /ji ltar ri la rten7pa yi/ /shing rnams yal ga lo ma dag /chu zheng gab par rgya che ba/ /'phel bar gyur te bskyod mi nus/ /de bzhin ljon shing che bzang 'di/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid 'tshal bas na/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngon ni legs par bsrungasalgepa lags/ /'dren pa'ishebasod nams ljon shing 'di'i/ /'bras bu gzhan yang mchis lags te/ /bdag gis nyams su myong ba 'di/ /de yi me tog tsam du bas/ /de yi 'bras bu byang chub mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med lags/ /de ni bdag gis thob par 'gyur/ /smad pa bud med nyid spangs nas/ /skyes par bdag nyid 'gyur ba lags/ /sems can kun gyi dam pa mchog /chos rnams kun gyi pha rol phyin/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs/ /sdug bsngal kun gyis nyen pa yi/ /sems can rnams ni bdag gis dgrol/ /'jig rten kun lalosnying brtsechaba'i/ /skyabs su bdag ni 'gyur ba lags/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma la bka' stsal pa/61—662

bde ldan ma gang khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang glu/ 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyi don dang ske/ lha rnams dang / mi rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ①ma gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cukhudang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa〈brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po 'di rnams ci las grub lags/ de bzhin du gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ske/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhal du ma mchis pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa dang / bgrangasreb las 'das pa rnams ci las grub lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod pas na/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ngas kyang 'di ltar ljon pa'i shing / /sngon ni legs pa kho nar bskyed/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /de bzhin brtson 'grus bsam gtan bsags/ /yunasaring dus nas ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab nges par bsten pa yin/ /sems can rnams la mi mnyam sems/ /ngas ni bsgoms par mi dran te/ /rtag tu sems ni mnyam gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni ngas brnyes sonya/ /nga yi sems ni mnyam pa yisabya/ /rtag tu sdug 61—663

dang mi sdug dang / /mdza' dang mi mdza' snyoms pas na/ /bsod nams shing ni rnam par bskyed/ /des na ljon shing chen po 'di/ /yon tan mang por gyur pa yin/ /'khor los sgyur7nyid ngas thob ste/ /brgya byin nyid kyang byas pa yin / /rnam mang dbang phyug chen po dang / /tshangs pa nyid kyang de las thob /bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas chos/ /mtshan⑧nyid dag kyang ngas rtogs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan mas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan rnams ⑧thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par rab tu gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangasalgenas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa / ji ltar mi mchog dam pa po/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas/ /sngon ni spyod pa shin tu bslabs/ /de ltar bdag kyang rjes su slob/ /yon tan mthar phyin khyod kyi ni/ /yon tan rnams ltar bdag slob te⑤/ /srid par sdug bsngal spangs nas ni/ /bdag kyang 'di 'drar 'gyur bar bgyi/ /tshe rabs gzhan ni ma lus par/ /bdag gis sbyin pa gang stsal pa/ /mnyam med ye shes 'thob⑥slad du/ /de dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /srid pa 'di 'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag gis tshul khrims gang bsrungs pa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob slad du/ /de dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab dge ba gang bsten pa/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi don gyi phyir / /de dag thams cad bdag gis bsngo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis / /las dge gang dgakhubadag gis bsags/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yon tan phyiral/ /byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo/ /bud med lus 'di spangs nas ni / /skyes pa mchog tu bdag gyur cig /de ltar skyes pa'i lus thob nas/ /61—664

dam pa'i mchog tu bdag gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas bde gshegs kyi/ /'khor lo bla med bskor bar bgyi/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi/ /sems can bye ba dgrol bar bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/tshig 'di smras pa legs pa yin/ /sems ni rab tu sdom pa legs/ /khyod kyis bdud ni legs par mnan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su khyod 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' ba dang /dga' zhing yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa bza' ba dang bca' ba mang pos tshim par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bstsang sder ni 43)/ phyag ni bcabs nas rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma la chos kyi gtam rgyas pas yangashedag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug① /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas lung bstan te/ bde ldan ma khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa du ma zhig na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha dang mi rnams kyi stonasapa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen dpal zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang mchog tu yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i sdug bsngal med pa yid du 'ong ba ⑥yid dang 'thad pa (7mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas yin te/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na dge bsnyen ma stong phrag mang po zhig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 61—665

byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /srog chags stong phrag mang po dang / lha dang mi'i skye dgu rnams kyis ni chos kyi snang ba thob par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma dang /'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yinyerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs thebasdeske// //bsdur mchan/66 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mā/①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 kyi/ ①⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig661 ①〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bzang / ②〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bzang gi/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 po/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 pa/ ⑤〈〈khu 〉〉mi/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyi/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa / ⑧〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ ⑩〈〈li 〉〉brgyan/ ⑩〈〈khu 〉〉sangs rgyas/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉lhang / ⑩〈〈khu 〉〉med/ ④〈〈li 〉〉ni/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉smras/662 ①〈〈khu 〉〉yis/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉de/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bskrungs/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bsrung / ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'khrung ba/ 〈〈khu 〉〉'khrungs pas/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsgrungs / 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'khrung ba/ ⑦〈〈zhol 〉〉brten/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsgrungs/〈〈khu 〉〉srungs/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gyi/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉ya/ ⑩〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtse/662 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ ②〈〈li 〉〉bcu/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉bca/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bco/④〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bgrangs/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉yul/ ⑥〈〈co 〉〉nges la〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brnyes ste/ 〈〈snar 〉〉brnyed so/ ni〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉yi/61wa 666

664 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉bsgyur/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉chos ⑧〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rnam/rjo〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rang / rjo〈〈khu 〉〉te/ ()〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mthong /6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ba gang / 9)〈〈co 〉〉phyis/665 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉stsang sder ni gyu/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉stsang sdeng ni gyur/ 〈〈pe 〉〉stsar sder ni gyur/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gcang ster ni gyur/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉par yang / 〈〈co 〉〉par lang / ②〈〈khu 〉〉btsugarjo〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gzeng / 〈〈khu 〉〉gzings/ rjo〈〈co 〉〉sngon/ ()〈〈khu 〉〉bar/9)〈〈co 〉〉de/666 0)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉yid/ phu)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sto/bsdur 'bras re'u migamado rje/ (1༷༷)61wa 667

lung bstan pa/(1)༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya 〈〈snyeya ma hā de bī dubyu lika ra ṇa/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig snin/ bcom ldan 'das bde ba can na byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen yipo 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stinam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 61—668

dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jigs7pa thams cad sel ba dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dga'aphubyed kyi bkra shis thams cad 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams kyi mtshan thams cad 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi zla dang 'jig rten gsum 'dzin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mu stegs kyi bkra shis thams cad 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / de dag la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang thams cad dang thabs cigasatu bzhugs so / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal gote phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lha mo chen mo dpal yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasate/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bde ba can na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad la yang7mgo bos phyag 'tshalashete/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams brgya stong du mas brgyan cing de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba snyed kyis yongs su bskor7te/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags pas lha mo chen mo dpal la gzigs nas / tshangs pa chen po'i gsung7gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spyan 61—669

ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyal po'am/ blon po'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangasaturigs gang la la lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming brgya rtsa brgyad dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa 'disnye'achang na/ rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po de'i yul dang / sems can de dag gi⑧'jigs pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnode pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur zhing / chom rkun dang / g.yon can dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang /bang ba thams cad rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po de'i khyim du yang dpal nges par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis tshig 'di skad ces gsol to0/ /bcom ldan 'das tshig 'di legs par bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ / gang dag⑧lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming rnams 'dzin pa dang / thos nas nyams su len pa gang lags ⑥pa de dag gi yon tan ⑦dang phan yon ni de dag tu 'gyur lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha mo chen mo dpal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang du bskyed lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyisakhams rin po che las byung ba zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i me tog yon tan 61—670

gyi rgya mtsho 27drur+ya ②dang gser gyi ri bo mdog mdzes gser 'od dpal zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dang de bzhin gshegs pa mang po gzhan dag la yang ③lha mo chen mo dpal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag kyang lha mo chen mo dpal de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel ba dang / 'grub par byed pa dang / rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ de dag ni 'dir lha mo chen mo dpal gyis yang dag par brjod pa dang / sdig pa thams cad sel ba dang / nyes sdig thams cad med par byed pa dang / lus thams cad dri ma med par byed pa dang / nor dang 'bru rnams 'dusazhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / dbul ba gcod par byed pa dang / lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang —/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad 'dun par byed cing 'gugs par byed pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang —/ 'khrug pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / rtsod pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa dang —/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal stugasheposal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i me tog yon tan gyi rgya mtsho bai ⑨drur+ya tsodang gser gyi ri bo mdog mdzes gser 'od dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'itswamu stegs kyi sgo thams cad kyi bkra shis kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan gyi me tog gzi brjid skar ma'i 'od kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs gtsokun tu snang ba g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 61—671

dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi cho 'phrul rgyal mtshan shugs kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar 'od zhi ba'i spos snang dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can gyi bsam pa zhi bar mdzad pa'i sku'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smon lam rgya mtshos41)snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu yongs sumatsho brjod pasamatshan gsol dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rin po che'i gnas kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus grangs med pa laserab tu zhugs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sridapag tu med pa'i gser mdog57snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung gi yan lag thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab sgron ma grangs med pa'i 'od kyi me tog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sred57)med kyi bu'i〈khubartul zhugs kyi go cha ri rab kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ⑨dbang phyug chen po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla'i 'od dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zab mo'i chos kyi 'od kyi rgyal po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i sgron ma'icha'od bzang dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi 'od tog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi sgron ma'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgya 61—672

mtsho'i snying po las byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa'i 'brug sgra snyan pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi snang ba thams cad bkod pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shing gi rgyal po ltar skyes pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phrokhuri bo'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od 'phrosargya mtsho'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smon lam chen po'i shugs kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'i tog gi rgyal po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyisargyal po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nor dang 'bru thams cad sdud pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba 'dren pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum tshogs pa 'gugs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag rim gror byas te/ bcang bar bya'o/ /bklag par bya'o/ /de ltar byas nasnyerigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la bsod nams0shin tu mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chen mo dpal yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang lung bstan to/ /lha mo chen mo dpal khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams dpal rin po ches brgyan pa zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal nor bu ⑦rin po che las byung ba zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de yang lha'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi sa brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams der 61—673

de bzhin gshegs pa de nyidakyisnang bar mdzad par 'gyur la 'jig rten gyi khams de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang rang las 'odakhu'abyung zhing tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' las kyang sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der byang chub sems dpa' gang dag skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang pad ma'i snying po dag las skye bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de la ming brgya rtsa brgyad dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa brgyad cu zhuganyis pa gang zhe na/ 'jigs pa med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming rnams nyon cig /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba/ lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ lha thams cad kyi ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dpal/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po thams cad kyi dpal/ lha la sogs pa thams cad kyi dpal/gnas thams cad na yod pa'i dpal/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad kyi dpal/ rig sngags 'chang dang / lag na rdo rje dang ske/ rdo rje 'chang ba⑥thams cad kyi dpal/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang lnga'i dpal/ gza' brgyad dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dpal lo/ /oṃ nyi ma'i bu mo/ ma ma yum/ rig byed bzhi'i dpal/ bkra shis ma/ sems can rnams kyi ma/ rgyal ma/ rnam rgyal ma/ gang gātum/ mu stegs kyi sgo 61—674

thams cad kyi bkra shis ma/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma med par byed pa'i dpal/sdig pa thams cad 'phrog ma/ rgyags pa med pa/ zla7ba'i dpal/ nyi ma'i dpal / zla7thams cad kyi dpal/ seng ge la zhon mnya/ pad ma'i mchog 'bum gyis bkab ma/ pad ma pad ma la gnas pa/ pad ma 'dzin pa/ pad ma las byung mnya/ pad ma dang ldan pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba du mas 'khor ba/nor sbyin ma/ dkar mo/ dkar mo chen mo/ lag dkar mnya/ bkra shis thams cad 'dzin mkha/ bsod nams kyi phung po thams cad kyi lus can/shes nyen can gyi bu mo/ lag pa 'bum dang ldan ma/ mig 'bum dang ldan ma/mgo 'bum dang ldan ma/ nor bu rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i cod pan thogs pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ gzugs sna tshogs can/ rab grags ma/ shin tu grags ma/ zhi ba ma/ sprin ma/ skra gtsang ma/ zla ba ltar mdzes ma/ nyi ma ltar mdzes ma/ dge ma/ dgesabyed ma/ sems can thams cad la mngon du phyogs ma'i dpal/ 'phags ma/ me tog la gnas mnyaske/ me tog gi dbang phyug ma/ ri bo'i rgyal po ri rab thams cad kyi dpal/chu klung dang / mtsho thams cad kyi dpal/ chu thams cad kyi rgya mcho'i dpal/mu stegs thams cad du mngon du phyogs pa'i dpal/ sman dang / rtsi tog dang ske/ shing dang / nor dang / 'bru thams cad kyi dpal/ gser sbyin ma/zas dang gos sbyin ma/ 'od gsal ma/ snang ba ma/ lus gtsang mtsho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang sgyur ma/ lha'i tshogs thams cad la mngon du phyogs pa'i dpal/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang /brgya byinaspel sogs pa'i dpal/ sbyin pa ma/ longs spyod ma/ gzi brjid 61—675

ldan ma/ phun sum tshogs ma/ 'byor pa ma/ rnam par skye ba ma/ mthong ma51)ske/ chos kyi dpal/ khyab 'jug la brten ma(mi/ ku mu da ①la gnas ma/bzod ldan ma/ mthu rtsal gyi gnas/ dag byed dang bkra shis thams cad kyi lag pa dang ldan pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad med par byed pa bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i dpal/ sa thams cad dang / rgyal po thams cad kyi dpal / rig sngags ④'chang gi rgyal po thams cad kyi dpal/ 'byung po thams cad dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas ⑤dang / sha za dang /grul bum (pedang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad kyi dpal/ lha'i gnas dang /lha thams cad kyi dpal/ bzlas brjod dang / bzlas brjod du bya ba dang /sbyin sreg du dang / sbyin sreg (nyetu bya ba dang / bkra shis thams cad kyi dpal/'od la dga' ba/ skal ba dang ldan par 'dod pa/ drang srong thams cad dag par byed pa'i dpal/ bud med kyi gnas thams cad kyi gtso mo dang / dpal gyi mchog mi'am ri91ci mo thams cad dang lha ma yin mo thams cad kyi dpal gyi mchog /kha na ma tho ba med pa'i gnas na 'dug ma'i/ yid du 'ong ma0/sim par byed mas/ ku be ra'i snying du sdug matso/ chos kyi rgyal po'i dpal/oṃ sdug bsngal thams cad las rnam par gzigs shig /sgrol cig thar bar mdzod cig /bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad bdag la mngon du gyur par mdzod cig swā hās/ oṃ gi ga sarba tir+sha tsamu khi swā hā / oṃ sarba bi tri ⑩ swā 78/sarba rma ga la dhā hunyer ṇi hu ) swā hā skye/ tsa turbe da chasarba nak+ṣa tra gra hā ba 0ṇa ga ṇa a dhi myu sbyo ste swā hā ge/ braṅgā ya swā hā / biṇ+ḍa chabe swā hās/ ru dā ⑥ya swā hā0/bi shwa zhu mu khā ya sarte ṭ+wā hāshunye/ oṃ gli zhu steni kli ⑥ni sarba kār+ya sā dha ⑩ni/ sa ni sa ni/61wa 676

༄ga /'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ha ༄༄na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dza ya ma tisanā ma ma hā yā ④na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros5gezhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa ༅dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin 9)gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu mang po dag dang thabs cigashetu bzhugs sel/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bsod nams 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bya'o/ /shes rab 'dod pas thos pa la brtson par bya'o/ /mtho ris 'dod pas tshul khrims bsrung b.rarwa )bya'o/ /longs spyod 'dod pas gtong ba spel bar bya'o/ /61—681

gzugs bzang ba 'dod pas bzod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /spobs pa 'dod pas bla ma la gus par bya'o/ /gzungs 'dod pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal med par bya'o//ye shes 'dod pas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa la gnas par bya'o/ /thar pa 'dod pas sdig pa thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde bar bya bar 'dod pas byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /skad snyan pa 'dod pas bdenatupar smra bar bya'o/ /yon tan 'dod pas rab tu dben pa la dga' bar bya'o/ /chos 'dod pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten⑧par bya'o//zhi gnas 'dod pas 'du 'dzi med pa mang du bya'o/ /lhag mthong 'dod pas chos stong par so sor brtag pasamang du bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'dod pas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pas dge bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya'o/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar 'dod pas stong pa'i chos la mngon par dga' bar bya'o/ /yon tan thams cad thob par 'dod pas dkon mchog gsum la mchod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi ⑥rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ⑦la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs soli—// //61—682

༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/tunye༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a ba lo ki nī ②nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhesasnyebya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcigen/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi gophung po'i ri la dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / ༷ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu mang po (snyedang thabs cig ⑥ku bzhugs te/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rnam par dag pa la bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rnam par dag pa tshul khrims yongs su dag pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag pa dang / bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / phan pa'i dngos po yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par 61wa 684

dag pa byams pa yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnamanyepar dag pa snying rje yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs susnyedag go/ /blo gros rnamasaparasredag pa dga' ba yongs su dag pa dang / btang snyoms yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa rnam par grol ba yongs su dag pa dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa stobs yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa mi 'jigs pa yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su dag pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa la su zhig me tog dang / phreng ba dang ske/ spos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /rol mo'i sgra dang / byug pa rnams kyis bsti ④stang byed pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i mtha' rtogs par mi nus te/ de'i mtha' ni theg pa gsum po las theg pa gang yang rung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i ⑧mthar thug pa ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi phung po de phyi ma'i mthar yang zad par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis tshad med pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba yang tshad med do/ /mtha' yas so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /mtshungs pa med do/ /dpag tu med do/ /grangs med do/ /dpag gis mi lang ngo /brjod du med do/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa daphro61—685

ltar bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa la bstenyestang byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / rjed pa dang /② phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya tha nim la su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la bsti stang byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / rjed pa dang /yang dag par sems nye bar gzhag⑧ste byang chub tu gzhol ba'i sems bskyed pas phyag 'tshal ba dang / phyag byed pa dang / bsti〈stang byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / rjed pa dang /gsol ba dang / bsngagasalgepa dang / skor ba byed pa des phan yon lnga yongs su gzung7bar 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang —/ rtogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / mthong nas kyang dad pa skyed par 'gyur ba ste phan yon lnga po de dag yongs su gzung7bar 'gyur ro/ /de chos bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur te④/bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / de yang ji skad bstan pa bzhin du bsgrubalgepa dang / bsgrubs nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur ba stedzo/ chos bzhi po de dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis mi rdzi bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rigs mtho zhing rigs che ba dang / btsas ma thag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 61wa 686

rnams yid la byed pa dang / phyi ma'i dus na dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabatupar 'gyur ba ste/ blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na bdudasnyedam bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis mi rdzisabar 'gyur phro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /srog chags kun la phan pa'i phyir / /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la / /su zhig skor0ba byed pa ni/ /tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /dran dang ldan zhing blo gros ldan/ /bsod nams ldan zhing 'jigs med 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /srin po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ /ngas ni gang dag bstan pa yi/ /mi khom brgyad po de dag spong —/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab mdzes pa/ /mnyes par byed 'di dal ba gcigadu /mdog ldan gzugs ni phun sum tshogs/ /mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa dang / /mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /le lo can du de mi 'gyur / /de ni phyug cing nor cher 'gyur/ /bsod nams ldan zhing rdzi ba med/ /'jig rten sgron ma mnyes byas nas/ /yang dang yang du bsti〈stang byed/ /bdag med stong pa'i chos thos nasani/ /de ni chos la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /myur du dad pa 'thobashe'agyur zhing / /chos don ji bzhin mkhas par 'gyur/ /tshong dpon khyim dang rgyas pa dang / /phyug po rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ /dpa' zhing sbyin pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /gtong ba btang zhing ser sna med/ / 'dzam 61—687

bu'i0)gling na gang yang rung / /khyad par can gyi rigs mdzes pa/ /der ni brtan pa de skye ste/ /dma' ba dag ni rnam par spangs/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /skye ba thams cad kun tu yang / /dbang cher grags pa'i khyim bdag dang / /dpal dngalagazi brjid ldan par 'gyur/ /bram ze sā7la che 'dra dang / /tshul khrims ldan zhing mang thos dang / /rgyal rigs sā0la che 'dra dang —/ /phyug cing nor chen59ldan par 'gyur/ /ris bskor rgya mtsho tshun chad kyi / /sa kun la ni gang smon pa/ /gling bzhi dag gi dbang phyug bla/ /rgyal po chos dang ldan par 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur0ba rdzu 'phrul che/ /rin chen bdun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal srid gnas nas sangs rgyas la/ /yang dang yang du bsteshestang byed/ /'di nas shi 'phos mtho ris su/ /song nasakyisangs rgyas bstan la dad6)/ /lhun po'i zom gyi dbang phyug poyi/ / lha yi7dbang po brgya byin 'gyur/ /lha dbang shin tu7'thab bral dang / /de bzhin du ni dga' ldan dang / /lha dbang shin tu 'phrul dga' dang / /dbang sgyur 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /de ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /tshangs pa'i dbang phyug mkhas 'gyur zhing / /lha rnams bye bas mchod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mi gang skor0nyeb byed pa yitsho/ /bsngags pa bskal pa bye bar yang / /brjod pas zad par bya mi nus/ /su zhig byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /ston pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal ba/ /de ni bskal pa bye bar yang / / nams kyang7long zhing 'theng mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mngon du skor7ba byed pa ni / /bung ba sngon po mdzes 'dra yi/ /rnam par dag pa'i mig 'thob 'gyur/ /61wa 688

mchod rten bskor ba byasatun ni/ /de ni nges par rtag tu yang / /'thun⑧pa'i don kun 'thobasnye'agyur zhing / /don min rnams ni spang bar0'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ni le lo med 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu bag yod ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor bar byas na ni/ /brtson 'grus brtan zhing mthu brtan la/ /brtan zhing rnam par gnon brtan dang / /de ni myur du mkhas par 'gyur/ /me dang dug dang mtshon gyis de/ / nams kyangatswa'achi dus byed mi 'gyur/ /mkhas pasatshe'uni rdzogs rdzogs su/ /zad par byas nas 'chi dus byed⑩/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /pho brang 'khor dang yul 'khor dang / /grong rdal rnamasalosu longs spyod dang / /gzugs kyis7khyad par 'phags par 'gyur/ /byang chub spyad7pa spyod pa'i tshe'u/ /de ni 'dod pa mi sten7cing / /lus kyang gtsang la gos gtsang zhing / /gtsang ma'i chos la gnas par 'gyur/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa gang dag (9gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten mthong (rtenas dad pa skyed tho)de/pus mo gnyi ga'i7lha nga sa la btsugs nas phyag 'tshal zhing phyag byed de/ de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 0rtsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa de ci 'dra bar bdag gi lus kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig ces de la mos pa skyed na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa bsod nams kyi phung po de'i mtha' brjod par mi nus te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po de ni rgyal po nyid dam/ brgya byin nyid dam/ tshangs pa nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas nyid dam/ yang dag 61wa 689

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bla na med pas kyang zad par bya bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa rigs kyi bu des bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bzung ba'i phyir te/ blo gros rnam par dag pa 'di lta ste/ dper na de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa grong khyer ram / gtsug lag khang ngam/ grong du 'jug kyang rung / 'chag kyang rung /'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / chos ston kyang rung / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can lha'amatsho/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am/ lha ma yin nam/ nam mkha'7lding ngam/ mi'am ci'am / lto 'phye chen po'am/ mi'am/ mi masayin pa'am/ sems can gyi grangs su ma gtogs pa shing ngam/ ri'am/ khung bu'am/ bu ga'am/ bya skyibs kyang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba de0logs su 'dudakyipa dang rab tu 'dud pa dang / kun tu 'dud pa mi phyedakyipa de gang yang med de/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan pa la byed pa de bzhin du/ rigs kyi bu de dag grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/yul 'khor ramatsho/ pho brang 'khor na rgyu ba la sems can rnams 'dud/ rab tu 'dud/ kun tu 'dud par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas ji ltar 'gyur zhes mos skyed deni/ sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni pus mo gnyis 'dzugs dang ske/ /su zhig byang chub gzhol nas phyogs rnams kun 'gro ba/ /de 'gro tshe na 'jig rten gsum po 'dud pa byed/ /mi rnams gtso bo rang byung gang du 'gro 61—690

byed pa/ /de logs su ni rtswa dang shing dang sdong dum dngatu/ /sman dang shing lo rnams dang 'bras bu 'dab ma dang / /yid 'ong dri ldan me tog rnams ni 'dud par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la pus mo btsugasalgepa ni/ /de la mi yisadabang po kun kyang 'dud par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin dbang dang klu dang lha yisargyal po dang / /tshangs pa'i dbang po thams cad rkang par gtugs parasabyed/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la pus btsugs7phyag byas na/ /dpa' zhing stobs dang ldan pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ /gser gyi mdog ldan mtshan rnams kyisakuni go char 'gyur/ /mthu che bla mar bya zhing thub par dka' bar 'gyur/ /de yi yul na sems can gang dag gnas gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad byams pa'i sems dang dga' bar 'gyur/ /de la sems can gang yang sdig pa mi skyed7de/ /skye bo tshogs chen dga' zhing yid du 'ong bar 'gyur / /bcom ldan mchod rten dag la pus btsugs phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la 'jig rten kun gyi rgyal po rab tu 'dud/ / lha dang klu dang mi dang lto 'phye chen po 'dud/ /bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su dbugs phyin7thob par 'gyur//bcom ldan mchod rten dag la pus btsugs phyag 'tshal ba/ /gang tshe rgyal ba dam pa byung bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang nye bar 'gyur ba 'thobatso/ /'dren pa gzhal yas rnams la mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas gyur0ces7mos pa bskyed nas ni/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la pus btsugs phyag 'tshal ba/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya bgrangs zad 'gyur na/ /de ni ring por tsomi thogs byang chub mtshungs med 'thob / /gang zhig sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la/ /bskal pa bye ba 61—691

gzhal yas bste7)stang byed pa bas/ /gang zhig phyi dus mi bzadaltebaskal pa 'di la ni/ /mchod rten phyag 'tshal de yi bsod nams ches mang ngo / /sangs rgyas dam pa sbyin gnas mtshungs pa med gyur pa/ /spyod pa dam pa spyadakunas khyad par brnyes gyur pa/ /mi yi khyu mchog de la 'dir ni mchod byas na/ /rnam par smin pa dam pa mtshungs med rang bzhin 'gyur/ /byang chub tu ni sems bsngos te / /me tog phreng ba byas nas su/ /mchod rten dag la su 'bul ba/ /de ni nams kyang〈gelongs mi 'gyur/ / mi yisanang nas shi 'phos nas/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'gro bar 'gyur/ /der ni rin chen sna tshogs kyi/ /gzhal med khang pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten phreng ba 'dir phul〈nyan/ /khang bzangasashedag dang khang brtsegasalgepa/ / lha yi7bu mos bsten pa rnams/ /sum cu7gsum du spyod par 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang zhing / /gser gyi bye ma bdal〈nyegyur pa/ /be+ernyudur+ya7dang shel dag gi/ / lha yi7jing bu 'thob par 'gyur/ /der ni lha yi72dga' spyad nas/ /mkhas pa tshe tshad rdzogs par 'gyur / / lha yi7'jig rten shi 'phos nas/ /mi nang longs spyod ldan par 'gyur / /dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis/ /mkhas pa bag yod gyur nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes byas te/ci /rkang gnyis mchog la mchod pa byed/ /mchod rten phreng ba 'bul byed pa/ /de ni 'dod chags mi 'phrogs shing / /zhe sdang gis kyang 'phrogs mi 'gyur/ /de ni nams kyangasnyi rmongs mi 'gyur/ /rkang spreganyis mchog la mchod byas na/ /de ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /chags pa med cing zhe sdang med/ /brkamatsog med cing dbang po bsdams/ /mchod rten phreng ba 'bul5)byed pa/ /tshe rabs bye ba stong rnams dang / /khrag khrig dag ni 61—692

brgya bgrangs pa/ /kun tu bkur sti byas par 'gyur/ /mchod rten phreng ba 'bul byed pa/ /de ni 'khor los sgyur0)bar 'gyur/ /brgya byin lha yi7dbang phyug 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tshangs par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ /dar gyi dbul ba phul byas nas①/ / lha yi dag dang mi rnams kyi/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dma' ba'i rigs ni rnam7spangs te/ /der ni de skye 'gyur ma yin/ /phyug cing nor chen ldan pa dang ske/ /'jig rten dbanganyuphyug de 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod byas na/ /gzugs dang don dang longs spyod dang / /kha dog dang ni 'byor pa dang —/ /kun tu grags dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ni tshe rabs dran 'gyur zhing ske/ /'dod chags kyis kyang 'phrogs mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams kyi skyon shes shing / /tshangs par spyad pa spyod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegasalgepa mchod byas na/ /gzugs rnams dang ni sgra dag dang / /ro rnams kyis kyang mi tshugs shing / /sdig pa'i las ni byed mi 'gyur/ /rnam par 'dren pa mchod byed na/ /de ni spos dang me tog gis/ / nams kyang phongasalgepar mi 'gyur zhing ske/ /dran ldan shes rab ldan par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs la su mchod pa / /de yi nor gyi phung po la/ /rgyal po dang ni chom rkun dang / /me dang chus kyang reg mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po'i mchod rten la/ /dar7gyi dbul ba su 'bul ba/ /de ni skam dang mya ngan dang / /nad bu can du gzhar mi 'gyur / /'jig rten sgron ma mchod byed pa/ /tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ /mya ngan med cing gnod med dang / /'khor los sgyur7ba 'byor chen 'gyur/ /'dren la mchod pa byas na ni/ /rkang pa lag pa mnyen 'gyur zhing / /yan lag 61—693

rnam par dgatu'agyur la/ /gzugs dang kha dog ldan par 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i las ni rnam spangs te/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod par byed/ /gang dag 'jig rten rab dkon pa/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams dang / /khrag khrig dag ni brgya bgrangs par/ /mchod cing bde la shes rab ldan/ /byang chub dam pa 'tshang yang rgya/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ /phreng ba'i khang pa byas na ni/ /de ni g.yog 'khor mi phyed cing //rgyal po 'byor pa chen por 'gyur/ /'phags pa rnams kyisalgegang spangs pa/ /sdig pa'i las ni spong bar byed/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bshad pa yi/ /dge ba'i las la sten⑧par byed/ /lha 'am 'on te klu rnams sam/ /'jig rten dag na gang mkhas pa/ /de dag dga' zhing mgu ba dang / /bstibastang byas shing bsngags par 'gyur/ /brtan pa de ni gar skyes pa/ /bsod nams gzi brjid rab tu brjid/ /yul 'khor dag dang grong khyer dang / /rigs der bste0stang byed par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /rkang gnyis mchog la su mchod pa/ /de dag mthu stobs che ba dang / /g.yog 'khor chen pos mdzes par 'gyur/ /byang chub tu ni yongs bsngos te/ /phreng ba'i gtsug lag khang byas na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis0gang bsngags pa'i/ /'byor pa dag ni des 'thob bo/ /de ni 'theng dang zhar ba dang / /dman dang ma rungs mikhu'agyur gnas/ /gang dang gang du skyes par7yang / /mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan par 'gyur/ /sems can dbul po rnams mthong na/ /de ni nor gyisalgesdud par byed⑩/ /de ni nor dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /de ni byang chub spyad pa spyod / /blo gros chen pos sa 'di kun/ /yongs su btang ba byas nas kyang / /61—694

dman pa'i sems su mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni nams kyang7phongs mi 'gyur/ /gang dag byang chub mngon zhugs pa/ /de dag bu dang bu mo dang / /chung ma dge zhing bzang mo dag /btang nas mya ngan byed mi 'gyur/ /de ni sngon du 'gro 'gyur zhing / /bkri ba med la mthong na dga'/ /phrag dog dang ni nga rgyal gyis / / nams kyangasade la gnod mi 'gyur/ /gang dag byang chub rab zhugs pal/ /de dag phrag dog med cing des/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /phan pa 'dod cing yon tan ldan/ /gang dag byang chub mngon zhugs pa/ /'jig rten kun na de rin chen/ /de dag 'byung ba shin tu dkon/ /dmadakupa med pa'i sbyin gnas 'gyur/ /sa 'di dag ni rim gyis su/ /bgrang bar bya zhing dpag par nus/ /de dag rnams kyi yon tan mtha'/ /tshig gis bstan par mi nus so/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum sems ni shes par nus/ /de dag rnams kyi yon tan mtha'/ /tshig gis bstan par mi nus so/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi po dag /skra ni bye ba stong gshegs pa'i/ /skra yis zad par bya bar nus/ /de dag yon tan zad mi nus/ /sa rnams thams cad phyer brlags0pa/ /rab tu phra rdul shes par nus/ /sangs rgyas sras po de dag gi/ /yon tan mtha' ni brjod mi nus/ /chu klung thams cad rab 'bab pa/ /rgyun las ldog0ste 'gro yang srid/ /sangs rgyas sras po de dag gi/ /yon tan mtha' brjod de lta min/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kyi/ /sngon gyi lus rnams ji snyed pa/ /bgrang bar bya zhing dpag par nus/ /de dag yon tan zad mi 'gyur/ /sngon gyisalus rnams thams cad la/ /spu phreng ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bgrang bar bya zhing dpag par nus/ /de dag yon tan 61—695

zad mi 'gyur/ /'gro ba lnga por 'khor ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi spu rnams ni / /bgrang bar bya zhing dpag par nus/ /de dag yon tan zad mi 'gyur/ /sa 'di ji snyed thams cad pa/ / chu yi7phung por gnas gyur kyang / /de ni bgrang zhing dpag par nus/ /de dag yon tan brjod mi nus/ /mar me mdzad〈minas bzung nas ni/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa ji snyed pa/ / de yisabar du shing ljon rnams/ /ji snyed ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de dag 'bras bu me tog rnams/ /de dag zad par shes par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams dang —/ /khrag khrig dag ni brgya bgrangs par/ /brtson pa zhig gis de dag gis④ / /bsngagasatswaphreng yid du 'ong brjod kyang / /sangs rgyas sras po de dag gi / /yon tan mtha' ni brjod mi nus/ /sangs rgyas sras po de dag la/ /mi gang mi dga' byed pa de/ /lha dang mi ni spangs nas su/ /de dag dmyal ba spyod yul 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni/ /mi gang la la gnod byed pa/ /mig med pa 'am long ba dang / /sdug bsngal dpung gnyen med par 'gyur / /shi 'phos nas ni mnar med 'gro/ /de ni 'bar zhing 'jigs skrag 'gyur / /lus ni chen por7gyur nas kyang / /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong bar 'gyur / /tshe rabs de dang de dag tu/ /de lus dpag tshad tsam 'gyur te/ /de ltar phrum ltar zlum gyur la/ /kun nas yongs su bza' bar 'gyur/ /de tshe lus la mgo bo ni/ /lnga stong yod par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mgo bo de dag re re la'ang / /lce ni lnga brgya tham pa yod/ /gcig la'ang thong gsholashebargya dag gis/ /lce ni rab tu rmo bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /mi bzad chen por gshegs par 'gyur/ /mnar med de nas shi 'phos nas/ /61—696

de ni tsha dang rab tsha bar/ /blo gros ngan pa tshor ba myong / /de sngon nyes7byas 'bras bu yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni/ /ma bsdams gang zhig gnod byed pa/ /de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / /dmyal ba'i sa ni dkon ma yin / /tshe rabs bye ba stong rnams dang / /khrag khrig dag ni brgya bgrangs par②ske/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni bzang po rnams7mi mthong ske/ /sangs rgyas sras po skyobasatswarnams la/ /gnod pa dag ni byas gyur na⑤ / /a la gar rta 'jigs pa yi/ /shin tu gdug pa'i sbrul du skye/ /de ni bkres dang skom7pas nyen/ /sdig pa'i las rnams byed par 'gyur/ /de ni zas7kyang mi⑨rnyed de/ / nams kyang 'grangs7 par za mi myong / /shi 'phos gshin rje'i 'jig rten du4te/ /de ni rtag par gtun nyunyedu brdung / /dge slong dag la gnod byas pas/ / nams kyang5)skabs ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de nas shi 'phos dus byas te/ / mi yisalus ni thob gyur na/ /blo ngan de ni dmus long 'gyur / /gnod sems ldan zhing sdom pa med/ /de ni nyes par smras byas te/ /'phags pa rnams la skur btab pas/ / mi yishinang nas shi 'phos nas/ /ngan song dag tu myur du 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni/ /ma bsdams gang zhig gnod byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba stong dag tu/ / nams kyang7sangs rgyas mthong mi 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sras rnams la/ /gang zhig chos bzhin srung byed pa/ /des ni ngan 'gro kun spangs te/ /myur du bzang 'groratso'agro bar 'gyur/ /phyug cing nor chen ldan pa dang7/ /stobs dang ldan zhing 'jigs pa med/ /dran dang ldan zhing shes rab ldan/ /bde zhing ngo tsha khrel ltas ldan/ /gang du 'jig rten rnams kyi sgron/ /yongs su mya ngan 61—697

'das gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten mthong nas ni/ /yang dang yang du bstetustang byed/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /'di 'dra'i chos 'di thos gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas sras po rnams la ni/ /su zhig phyi phyir dad mi byed / /gang gisakhusangs rgyas stong rnams dang / /brgya dang bye ba bgrangasnyedag la / /bskal pa gang gā'ikhubye ma snyed/ /de snyed bskal par bkur0ba bas/ /'jig rten mgon gyis gsungs pa yi/ /dam chos 'jig tshe gang zhig gis/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /chos 'jig dus na chos 'dzin pa/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes rab gnas pa/ /ngakyil des0ni mchod pa byedal/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i bstan pa srung7byed pa0/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /de ni nams kyang7rgyad mi 'gyur/ /lus kyis bde ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni nad kyis btab mi 'gyur/ /de ni yid du mi 'ong bas / / nams kyang 'phrogasalgepar mi 'gyur ro/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung byas na/ /bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / /des dang gsalachadang mnyen pa dngatso/ /sems can rnams la byams sems 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /bde dang dga'akhe'athobalgemadzod ni mang por7'gyur / /sngon gyi rim gro bya ba 'thob7'gyur zhing / /mi khom brgyad po ma lus zad par spong / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /dper na nam mkha' skar mas yongs gang ltar/ /rtag tu mtshan gyis go char0byas pa dang / /rab tu tshig snyan yid 'ong dbyangs ldan 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /gang na yid bde med cing rab sdug pa/ /rigs dman de 61—698

ni de yis spangs paratu'agyur/ /phyug cing shin tu bde la longs spyod ldan/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas②/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus ldan①/ /mi dman pa rnams kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la bsnyen bkur byed/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bsal/ /mchog tu rab mdzes gzugs ldan shes rab ldan/ /mi yi 'jig rten mchog tu bsnyen bkur 'gyur/ /rgyal po mkhas pa mdzangs pa rnams kyis bsngags / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mchog tu gzugs mdzes blta na sdug pa dang / /skyes pa bud med lha rnams dga' ba dang / /bde zhing mkhas pas bsngags shing shes rab ldan/ /ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba lha yi lhas/ /gang gi mdun du mdo 'diphurab bshad pa/ /mi de lag tu mdo sde 'di 'dra 'di0/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe na thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig ston pa mi mchog gzugs byed pa/ /ras 'dri rtsig ngos 'dri 'am gser las byasal/ /de yi chos kyi khyad par gang yin pa/ /de dag ma lus rab tu bstan gyis nyon/ /de ni blta min long bar gzhar mi 'gyur/ / sgur por7mi 'gyur yan lag mi sdug min/ /de ni gzugs dang ldan zhing kha dog ldan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis go char 'gyur/ /lus ni rnam par dag cing khyad par 'thob/ /spobs pa 'thob7cing sgra snyan yid du 'ong / /shes bzhin ldan zhing 'jig rten kun gyi gtso/ /de mthong sems can bde zhing dga' bar 'gyur / /sdig byed mi 'gyur zhe sdang med sems ldan/ /g.yo med mi rku rgyal po 'khrug mi byed/ /mthu dang ldan zhing dbang cher grag par 'gyur/ /byams la gnas shing mi dman sems dang ldan/ /'dren pa'i sku gzugs rab tu mdzes 61—699

byas na/ /de ni mchog 'gyur skye bo mang mchod 'os/ /blo ldan phyug cing detunyid rgya cher ldan/ /dbang ldan 'khor los sgyur〈miba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /'dren pa'i sku gzugs rab tu mdzes byas na/ / lha yisadabang po dbang phyug dbang thob pa/ /lhun po'i zom na dbang thob brgya byin 'gyur/ /bdag po lhun po'i zom na rgyal srid ston/ /de ni dran dang blo gros mi ldan min/ /de ni rtogs mos shes rab tshang b.ralgi'agyur/ /'jig rten kun na dbugs phyin thob 'gyur te/ /'di ni ye shes ldan zhing dmyal ba spangs/ /sems can snying po mtshungs med mchod byas na/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas gshin rje'i yul mi 'gro/ /ngan 'gro gsum po des ni rnam7spangs te/ /bdag der phyis mi skye bar shes par yi'agyur/ /'dren pa'i sku gzugs rab tu mdzes byas na⑦/ /dbang ldan dbang phyug nyid kyi lhar 'gyur te/ /mi dman dga' ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod / /rgyal ba mchog gi bstan la dad par 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang thob tshangs par 'gyur/ /yid 'ong shin tu mdzes pa'i spos ngad ldan⑧/ / 'dzam bu'i〈steklung gser 'od byed dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /gzhal med khang mchog blta sdug thob par 'gyur/ /de ni ded dpon stobs bcu ldan pa po/ /sems can snying po mtshungs 'dra med pa 'thobakyi/ /kha dog mtha' yas 'jig rten kun na gsal/ /gser steng7rin chen be+e drur+ya〈rtedang mtshungs/ /su zhig dga' ba'i yid kyis me tog blangs/ /dad skyes 'jig rten mgon la char du gtor/ /de ni mi yi 'jig rten bsod nams ldan/ /rgyal srid gnas nas rgyal ba mchog bkur 'gyur/ /mya ngan bskams7shing tha ba drir ldan lus/ /yan lag legs gnas mtshungs med thob par 'gyur/ /skye bo mang pos blta ba'i 'os7yin te/ /61—700

dmyal ba dgra tsatu'adod pa spong bar 'gyur/ /spyad pa rnam par spyodakyitshe 'dod pa la/ /ngan skyugs khung ltar smad par shes par 'gyur/ /tshangs spyod dge ba khyad par 'phags lasaspyodaX/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis rtag tu spyod par 'gyur/ /bskal pa mtha' yas mang du de kha nas/ /rab mdzes ud pal bsung ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ / de yi lus ni gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /tsan dan lta bur dri zhim ngad kyang 'byung / /spyad pa rnam par spyod tshe khro ba dang / /tha ba dri skyon gti mug gnod mi byed/ /dman pa med pa'i sems kyis dbugs phyin rnyed/ /bag yod lha yi0nang na rgyal po 'thob/ /gang tshe rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa na/ /de ni gus pas de dag chos kyang 'dzin/ /mi dman dga' ba'i sems kyis sbyin pa sbyin/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i ring bsrel mchod/ /rgyal ba mchog gi bstan pa 'jig dus tshe/ /rab tu dga' bas ston pa'i chos tshul 'dzin/ /des ni chos mchog mdzadasnyepa de spyadaponyepas/ /gnod pas 'chi ba'i dus byed gzhar mi 'gyur/ /gal te sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shing / /nyon mongs med pa gser mdog stobs bcur gyur/ /de dag bskal bye khrag khrig brgya stong du/ /rgyal ba mchog la mchod pa'i bsngags brjod nus/ /'jig rten kun tu sdig pa'i las spangs te(nyu/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis mchog gi las byas shing —/ /rlabs chen spyod tshe don ni legs byas nas/ /'jig rten mthu chen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gang gis spos chu yungs 'bru tsam blangs te/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la bdug byed pa/ / de yi7)phan yon brjod kyisalgesems dang zhing / /rdul dang dri ma spongs la mnyan par gyis/ /de ni bsod nams ldan zhing phyogs kun rgyu/ /nad med gyur cing blo brtan bag yod la/ /61—701

spyad pa rnam par spyod tshe mya ngan 'dukho/ /skye bo mang po dga' zhing yid du 'ong ske/ /rgyal po thob nas rgyal ba mchog bkur 'gyur/ /mthu chen rab mkhas 'khor los sgyur7'gyur te/ /gser gyi mdog ldan mtshan gyi go cha can/ /'jig rten kun na yid 'ong dri ldan 'thob/ /de la yid mi bde dngasasdug bsngal med/ /spyad pa spyod tshe longs spyod nyams mi 'gyur/ /phyug cing nor ldan mdzod ni rab tu mang / /mya ngan med 'gyur 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /skye bo mang po lhags te de la 'dri/ /rgyal ba mchog gi bstan pa khyad 'phags chosadu//tshig rab rjodarnyucing the tsomashesel bar byed/ /chos thos yid bde slar yang smra bar byed/ /sdig pa'i las med blo rgya che dang ldan/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos mchog khyad 'phags pa/ /dga' bar 'gyur la rtag tu mkhas byas te/ /mig kyang sbyong zhingasamun pa sel bar byed/ /'dod chags mi che zhe sdang che ma yin / /mi yi 'jig rten gti mug che ma yin/ /de ni tshangs spyod7dag pa mchog 'di spyod⑩/ /mi yi don ni dpag tu med pa byed/ /bcom ldan mchod rten7rnams la spos bdugasalgen/ /de la gnod par sems pa7su yang med/ /de ni nams kyang7longs spyod nyams mi 'gyur/ /blta bar 'os shing nor chen ldan par 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya rnams su/ /sems ni rnam dag sdig pa rnam dag cingasnyi/ /zhi zhing rab zhi zhi dul ldan gyur nas/ /mi dman sems kyis byang chub mtshungs med 'thob/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya mtha' yas/ /mya ngan med bde zhi ba mchog bkod cing / /'khor lo mtshungs med 'jig rten kun bskor nas/ /phyi nas nyon mongs rdul med mya ngan 'das / /su zhig dga' mgu sems kyi gos kyis ni/ /bcom ldan mchod rten 61—702

rnams la mchod byas pa/ /de ni gos mdzes bye ba stong rnams dang / /khrag khrig brgya bgrangasatumatha' yas rtag tu rnyed/ /bcom ldan mchod rten gos kyis dkrisakyibyas na/ /de ni btsas ma thag tu gosalgemachog 'thob/ / lha yikyikhyad 'phags dar gos rab bzang rnyed/ /btsas ma thag tu de lus shin tu bde/ /gang zhig gos kyis bcom ldan mchod rten dang / /'dren pa mtshungs med rnams la mchod byed pa/ /de 'dir mtshungs pa med pa'i lus thob0ste/ /sum cukhurtsa gnyis mtshan gyi me tog rgyas/ /bcom ldan mchod rten gos kyisasnyedakris byas na / /lag mthil nas ni mu tig phreng mdzes pa/ /sna tshogs dag dang seng ge'i phreng ba dang / /gser skud rab mdzes bskal pa mtha' yas 'byung / /bcom ldan mchod rten gos kyis dkris byas na/ /lha 'am klu 'am mi 'am lto 'phye chetsho/ /su yang de la ma dad skyed mi byed/ /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa mchog 'di spyod/ /bcom ldan mchod rten gos kyis dkris byas na/ /stong gica'ajig rten khams kun zil gnon te/ /'dzam7klung gser gyis gser ni zil mnan bzhin/ /skye dgu don ni dpag tu med pa byed/ /gal te rin chen rab mchog 8sna bdun gyis/ /stong gi zhing kun rab tu bkang ba yi/ /de 'dra'i dpal 'di zad par bya nus kyi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten gos gcig phul ba'i min/ /nor bu rin chen zla ba'i 'od rnams kyis/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong zhing bkang ba/ /de 'dra'i dpal 'di0zad par bya nus kyi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten gos gcig phul ba'i min/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes mos bskyed de/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba dan phul byas na/ /de ni skye bo mang po'i mchod 'os 'gyur/ /byang chub mchog spyad dam pa zhi ba spyod/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba dan phul 61—703

byas na/ /dag cing mchog gi lus ni 'thob 'gyur te/ /dper na gser ltar shin tu dgar 'gyur zhing / /lha yis bsngags la mchod cing bla mar byed/ /de yi lus ni gser gyi mdog 'drar 'gyur/ /ras kyi gos dang la ba bzang rabatudang —/ /du gu la dang ku〈kyeshi ga⑧rnams dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyang rnyed par 'gyur/ /'dzam bu'i gling na rigs mchog dam pa gang / /phyug cing che nyid bdag dbang nor mang ba/ /de dag tu ni rtag tu de skye ste/ /dman zhing mchog tu dbul ba rnam par spangs/ /de la sems can su yang phrag dog med / /sems can gnod pararnyusems pa gzhar⑥mi 'byung / /gzhan gyi sdig pa'i las la de smod de/ /rtag tu bag yod tshul khrims rnam dag 'gyur/ /'dzin pa med cing ser sna med par 'ong ⑦/ /gtong baphurab btang mya ngan med pa 'thob/ /de ni srog phyir gzhan la sbyin mi byed/ /phongs pa med byed rtag tu bag yod 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas stobs bcu ded dpon mthong nas ni/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis〈stegadugs dang ba dan dang / /mar me rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod/ /byang chub spyod mchog⑩'di ni rtag par spyod/ /mi yi 'jig rten bla mar bsnyen bkur byed/ /lha nang lha yi7dag dang mi yi7gtsotso/ /yid 'ong spos mdzes blta na sdug pa dang / /nor bu shel 'dra sna tshogs ldan pa 'thob / /ri rab rtse mor lha nang rab tu gsal/ /lha kun slob mar gyur nas mngon du 'dud/ /chos kyis de dag yid bde skyed par byed/ /de la dad mchog gzha' gsang 'thobalgepar 'gyur/ /de nas she7'phos mi yi 'jig rten du/ /rgyal po dam pa stobs ldan 'khor los sgyur⑩/ /de la sems can su yang sdig mi skyed8/ /skye bo mang po dga' zhing yid 'ong 'gyur/ /rdul bsal 61—704

sems can mchog la rgyal mtshan phul/ /ring por mi thogs7nor mang rnyed par 'gyur / /shes rab mtha' yas mdzod ni mang ldan 'ong / /sems chung mi 'gyur dman pa'i sems mi 'gyur/ /longs spyod rnyed nas bged〈micingaphubadag kyang spyod/ /de ni 'jigasasremed yid mi bde ba med/ /rgyal po dga' nas grong dang yul 'khor bgedadu/ /de la sems can su yang sdig mi skyed/ /gtso bo khyad par 'phags pa mdzod mang zhing / /khyim bdag rin chen sna tshogs lus brgyan 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i bu 'am de bzhin blon por 'ong / /rgyal por gyur nas stobs ldan rdzitswab med/ /brnyas pa'i rigs dma' thams cad yongs su spongs/ /longs spyod khyad 'phags rigs mchog rnyed nas ni/ /rtag tu bag yod sems ni zhum mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams ni ngan skyugs khung ltar spong / /khyad 'phags gzugs dang mtshan rnams rab tu 'thob/ /khyad 'phags rigs dang de bzhin dbang phyug nyid/ /de yi g.yog 'khor rtag tu mi phyed 'gyur/ /skye bo mang pos mdun du bdar bar 'ong / /de ni gzhan la gnod pa'i sems mi skyed⑨ske/ /sems ni rab dang rtag tu bag yod ldan/ /de la me dang dug dang mtshon mi tshugs/ /skye bo tshogs chen gyis ni blta bar 'gyur/ /rab tu dga' zhing thub pa'i chos la spyod/ /shes bzhin ldan nas yid bde skyed par byed/ /'dzin pa med cing chags med sems dang ldan/ /chags〈nyemed gyur nas de la mi 'thun med/ /de yi lus gtsang kun nas nyon mongs med/ /rnam dag sems ldan de ni bden par smra/ /'jigs pas nyen pa rnams la yid bde skyed / /sems can rnams kyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen 'gyur/ /de ni bdag don rgya chen byas nas su/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs la 'god/ /61—705

shing dbang shing mchog dam pa'i7drung song nas/ /mtshungs med mchog zhi byang chub 'tshang ②yang rgyal/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten mar me gcigakyiphul na/ /'di nas bzung ste srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni 'dzam0klung gser gyis gang / /de 'dra'i dpal de zad par bya mi nus/ /bcom ldan mchod rten mar me phul byas na/ /de yi lus ni mdog ngan yong0mi 'gyur/ /gzugs mchog sra zhing lag pa gzu ba 'dra/ /snang ba thob nas 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /gal te rgyal ba dam pa byung gyur na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnamasalgedang nye bar 'gyur/ /nye dur 'gyur ram yang na bur yang 'gyur/ /de ni ye shes phung po myur du 'thob/ /gal te khrag khrig brgya stong sangs rgyas zhing / /yungs 'bru dag gis byur bur gang gyur pani/ /bgrang ba dang ni gzhal zhing brjod par nus/ /bde gshegs mar me gcig phul de lta min⑨/ /sangs rgyas dam pa mtshungs med sbyin pa'i gnas/ /spyod pa mchog spyad ⑩khyad par brnyes gyur patso/ /mi mchog de la mchod pa 'dir byas pa/ /rnam par smin pa dam pa gzhal yas 'gyur/ /gal te mi mjed7'jig rten khams 'di kun/ /nor bu rin chen be+e drur+yasalgegang ba/ /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal de zad mi 'gyur/ / kār ṣā pa ṇas7mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /'og nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gang ba/ /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal de zad mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing stong de dag tsan dan gyis/ /'og nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gang ba/ /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal de zad mi 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yod pa'i lha ris kyi/ /gos 61—706

kyis sangs rgyas zhing stong gang gyur pa/ /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal de zad mi 'gyur/ /klu dang lha min mi dang lto 'phye r+ṣa/ / lha yisalha rdzas nor bu rin chen mang / /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal desazad mi 'gyur/ /lha yi 'jig rten yod pa'i lha yi spos/ /de dag mi mjed 'di kun gang gyur pa/ /zad par bya nus sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mar me gcig phul dpal de zad mi 'gyur/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshamasakhutshad ni shes par nus/ /nam mkha'i khams 'di'i tshad kyang shes par nus/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten mar me gcig phul ba'i/ /de 'dra'i dpal de zad par bya mi nus/ /sangs rgyas dam pa mi mchog bzhud pa'i tshe/ /'dren pa mtshungs pa med la dad byas te/ /ston pa'i sku la nyi zer mi 'bab par/ /me tog ma li ka gdugs bcom ldan phul/ /de ni las mdzes dam pa gus byas pas/ /lha dbang brgyasabyin du ni lan 'bum gyur / /'jig rten kun tu tshangs pa'i bdag por gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten la ni 'bum phul nas/ /'khor los sgyurakhuba'i rgyal po stobs ldan gyurani/ /stong phrag bcu la dbang bar nga7gyur te/ /nor chen rab tu mdzod mang tshong dpon gyur/ /khyim bdag blo ldan bsod nams ldan par gyur⑩/ /bde gshegs mi mchog bye ba nyi shu dag /ngas ni mnyes byas gzims cha na bza' yis / /mi mchog dag la bla mar bste stang byas/ /de dgo gtsug lag khang la spos kyis bskus/ /nga yi kha dog ngan pa kun med 'gyur/ /ngas7ni tsha dang grang dang ngal ba spongakhe/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar dman med sems gyur cing / /de dag mchod pa dam pa mchog gis mchod/ /rgyan sgyus brgyan pa'i gdugs 61—707

mdzes blta sdug pa/ /su zhig bcom ldan mchod rten 'bul byed pa/ /de 'dir lus ni mtshungs pa med 'gyur7te/ /sum cu7rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis go char 'gyur/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i sku ni rab 'bar zhing / /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs dang sems 'dra dang / / 'dzam klung〈migaser ltar rab mdzes blta na sdug /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pas mngon du gang / /mngon par shes pa 'thob cing dbang cher zhi)grags/ /byang chub spyod mchog dam pa zhi ba spyod/ /de ni nams kyang 55)longs spyod 'grib mi 'gyur/ /lhas kyang bsti〈)stang bya7zhing mchod par 'ong / /brtan pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod gzhar mi dka'/ /tshul khrims rnam dag rab mkhas tshangs par spyod/ /yi dam bcas nas nags dang nags 'dabashogasong / /mngon shes 'thob cing khyad par 'thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la gdugs 'bul ba/ /ji lta bu yang byang chub sems mi 'dor/ /byams la gnas shing mi dman sems su 'gyur/ /de yi shes pa nams0)kyang nyams pa med/ /rol mo'i sgra yis mi mchog mchod byas na/ /mya ngan med cing dbang ldan rgyal por 'ong / /mi yi 'jig rten yid 'ong sgra ldan 'gyur / /de sgra yan lag tshang zhing dag par 'ong / /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /shes bzhin ldan zhing mig ni rnam dag 'gyur/ /rna ba rnam par dag cing sems kyang dga'/ /sna yi dbang po mchog dang ldan par 'gyur / /de yi lce ni rab mdzes blta na sdug /thog mar rab mnyen mdzes shing sgra yid 'ong / /dper na lha yi rin chen bye ru 'dra/ /sgra skad yan lag bye ba dpag med 'byin/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ / nams kyang7)sbrul du mi 'gyur lce med min/ /zhar ba skur7po ya yo can mi 61wa 708

'gyur / /lus ni khyad par 'phags shing shin tu mdzes/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /lha 'am klu 'am mi 'am lto 'phye che/ /su yang de la matudad skyed mi 'gyur/ /dbugs phyin thob nas 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /de ni ma ning za mar gzhar mi 'gyur / / nams kyang semadze dang sha bkra mi 'byung zhing / /bsngags par 'os pa'i lus ni thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /lce ring 'gyur zhing lus kyang che bar 'gyur/ /gser gyi gzugs ltar kha dog 'bar bar 'ong / /ting 'dzin brtan zhing shin tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /lha nang bdag por 'gyur zhing dbang phyug 'gyur/ /mi yi 'jig rten skyes na dga' bar 'ong / /brtson 'grus ldan zhing bag yod 'bar bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i sgra byas na/ /de la su yang yid mi bde mi skyed/ /de la su yang tshig rtsub smra ba med/ /phra ma thams cad spangs shing yang dag smra/ /bsod nams 'dod pa su zhig phyags thogs te/ /bcom ldan mchod rten gus par 'phyag tshon byed pa/ /de ni smad cing mi gtsang lus mi 'gyur/ /ba spu khung nas tsan dan dri ngadaskoho'abyung / /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du / /yan lag ma smad khyad 'phags lus 'thob cing / /mdzes la mtshan gyis go char byas par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /lha yi tsan dan khyad 'phags rab mdzes pa'i/ /gzhal med khang mchog yid 'ong dri ldan 'thob/ /de ni de la gzhar yang srid mi skyed/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /yid 'ong dri ldan mchog tu blta sdug pa'i/ /61—709

lha yi7bu mo bye ba stong 'thob cing / /de ni de la nams kyang〈chags mi skyed/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /skyedasamos tshalakyimachog yod pa'i rdzing bu ni/ /yan lag brgyan ldan chu gtsang mdzes gyur pa/ /me tog ud pal las ni rgyas pa 'thob/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags / /de yi g.yog 'khor rtag tu 'thun⑧'gyur zhing / /mi dman sems can lha yi sgra yang thos/ /lha mo rnams kyi glu dbyangs snyan sgra thosal/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /'jig rten kun tu skyes tshe bdag nyid kyis/ /'di nas shi 'phos ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing / /mi yi 'jig rten sangs rgyas mthong bar shesal/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags / /de ni lha la snyan pa'i gtam byas te⑩/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs la lha bkod nas/ /shi ba'i dus byas 'dzam bu'i7gling du skye/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /btsas ma thag tu bskal pa mtha' yas dran⑩ / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas gtso rnams bkur ba dang / /de dag mtshan dang yon tan chos kyang dran/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas ji ltar 'gyur zhes te/ /mos pa bskyedacanas mchod rten rtswa skyes sel/ /de yi phan yon de dag ngas bshad kyis/ /tha ba dri sol dang ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /mthu chen skyes bu dam pa khyad 'phags pa/ /rgyal ba dam pa ma 'ongs dus na mthong / /de dag mchod pa dam pa mchog gis mchod/ /de ni gzhar yang dad pa dam pa 'thob/ /sangs rgyas stobs bcu ded dpon des mthong nas/ /'dren pa mtshungs pa med lachamachod pa byas8/ /mtshan gyis go char byas pa'i sangs rgyas su/ /'gyur zhes thugs dgyes de dag lung7yang ston/ /grong khyer yangs pa nyams dga' 61—710

mchog gnas shing / /ngatuni chos ston gang gis mthong gyur pa/ /de dag phyi dus rab tu 'jig pa'i tshe/ /rgyal mchog mya ngan 'das pa'i chos 'dzin 'gyur/ /mchod rten rtswa skyes sel bar byed pa ni/ /rgyal ba dam pasami thul mthong 'dod pa'i / /rgyu dang sa bon 'gyur ba 'di yin no/ /'dod dang dmyal dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas spong / /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis mdo mchog 'di/ /phyi ma rab 'jig⑧dus na 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten sangs rgyas lha yi lha / /bsod nams khyad 'phags mtshungs med zhing du 'gyur/ /'di bshad tshe na gang dag 'dir mchod dang / /tshul 'di bshad pa gang dag thos pa dang / /gang dag mdo mchog 'di ni 'dir bzung ba/ /de dag phyi ma'i dus na 'dir 'di 'dzin/ /gang dag phyin chad mdo mchog 'di 'dzin pa/ /de dag rtag tu ngaphudang 'thun pa'i sras/ /sangs rgyas bye bas de dag bsngags brjod kyang / /de dag bsngags pa mthar ni phyin mi 'gyur/ /gang dag phyi dus rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya mtha' yas/ /bskal pa bye bar bzhugs te de dag gi/ /bsngags pa brjod kyang mtha' mar phyin mi nusal/ /dri zhim yid 'ong spos kyisacho ga bzhin/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni su skud pa⑨ / /de ni thob rnyed 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /de ni sa 'dir snying po blangs par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'jig 'gyur tshe/ / 'dzam bu'i7gling du skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni de tshe mtho ris bdag por 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /dri mi zhim dang mi gtsang smad pa rnams/ /rtag tu spong zhing tshul khrims phung por gnas/ /de ni rtag tu tshangs spyod mchogatso'adir spyod/ /rgyal 61—711

ba'i mchod rten spos byug7)phul byas na/ /'di nas shi 'phos mtho ris lha dbang 'gyur/ /ring por mi thogs don stong rnams la rtog /lha rnams la ni rgya chen don kyang byed/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /gang gi tshe na mi yi ②'jig rten na/ /zhe sdang med sems 'jam zhing mnyen⑧gyur pa/ /de 537tshe de na 'dzam bu'i57gling du gnas/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /khyad 'phags tshigalo6)ldan sgra dbyangs yid 'ong 'gyur/ /skye bo mang po yid 'ong dga' zhing bkur/ /de yi kha bzhin rtag tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /de ni ngan song sa rnams ma lus spong ⑦/ /de bzhin gshegs dang nye ba thob par 'gyur/ /dad pa thob cing rtag tu bde la dga'/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /rgyal po stobs ldan 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyurani/ /blon po tshongashedapon khyim bdag bsod nams ldan/ /chos rje 'od mdzad sangs rgyas su yang 'gyur⑩/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis mgu ba'i shugs skyed57de/ /bcom ldan mchod rten nor bu'i dra ba 'bul/ /de ni rgyal po mtshan gyi go cha can/ /mthu chen7bla ma 'khor los sgyur /snyebar 'gyur/ /blta 'os mtshan gyi go cha ldan gyur nas/ /gzhal med khang chen rab mdzes blta 8sdug pa/ /kha dog sna tshogs dpag med ldan pa dang / /rin chen khang bzangs mche 'os dag pa 'thob/ /rgyal po'i7pho brang khyad par 'phags gyur pa/ /skyes pa bud med dag gis gang ba dang / /mnyam zhing legs byas rab mdzes blta nyanasdug pa/ /dra ba sna tshogs bde byed bde 'jug 'thobaske/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan gsal bar mdzes byas shing / /gdugs bresalgeshin tu mdzes la blta sdug dang / /mu tig dra ba phreng ba de 'draloba'i/ /rgyal 61—712

srid yon tan khyad 'phags gzhan yang 'thob/ /de yi yul na gzhan nor 'jig byed pa/ /chom rkun g.yo ldan g.yon7can gnas mi 'gyur/ /sems can rgya chen blo mchog ldan pa dang / /phan byed byams sems ldan pa de na gnas/ /shi 'phos bag yod de ni lhar 'gro ste/ /dkar gnagashegang yin bdag cag ji ltar gnas/ /'di nas shi 'phos ji ltar mir skye zhes / /blo ldan de ni mtho ris 'di gnas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sbyin gnas myur du mthong 'gyur te/ /mthong nas mchod cing mtshungs med bstisastang byed/ /sangs rgyas mthong nas byang chub mos skyed cing / /rdul bral rnams la phyir zhing bsti stang byed/ /ye shes mtha' yas ldan dngakhumathu chen 'gyur/ /khyad par sa gnas 'phags pa'i sems can 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das la dad pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /'di 'dra'i dpal 'di phyir zhing myong bar 'gyur/ /nga sheyi bya ba 'di ni brjod par bya / /ngas brjod 'di la the tsomaphrom skyed cig /sangs rgyas bka' spangs mnar med 'gror 'gyur zhing / /phyin chad sdug bsngal nyon mongs gyur ta re/ /'jig rten sgron ma mtshungs med bsod nams zhing / /de yi mchod rten ba rgya su sel ba/ /bag yod gyur nas de ni bdud rgya 'dral/ /dus rnams kun tu ngan song sa yang spong / /rtag tu sangs rgyas rdul bral bsti〈nyestang byed/ /rtag tu stobs ldan 'khor los sgyur7bar 'gyurahurte/ /mi yi 'jig rten skyes nas bsod nams ldan/ /rgyal po kun gyisalgemachod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /lha nang lha yi dbang po mchod gnas 'gyur/ /der ni myur du lha yi tshe yang 'thob/ /dpal ldan gser gyi gzhal med khang pa rnyedatshu/ /lha yi bde ba mtshungs med dbang phyug nyid/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri rabatsor mchog dang / /reg bya dpal 61—713

ldan lha yi 'jig rten 'thob/ /mthu chen ldan zhing blta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /lha mo rnams la 'dod pa'i sredatumi skyed②/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /'di nas shi 'phos mi yi 'jig rten 'gro/ /yan lag legs gnas khyad par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /nam yang bstan bcos mi nyung mang po 'thob/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de gi⑧mi khom brgyad po kun spong zhing —/ /de ni dal 'gyur de bzhin khyad par 'phags/ /de ni sangs rgyas mtshungs med mchod pa byed/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /bag yod blo gros brtan la dpa' bor 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i yon tan dag la dga' mi skyed/ /mi dman sems kyis mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de ni nams kyang byang chub sems mi 'doraspyo/ /tshul khrims skyon med shin tu bsdams par 'gyur/ /rnam dag 'dod chags bral ba'i chos kyang 'thob/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de yi mdog ngan lusasnyernams kun tu spong / /'chal pa'i shes rab ma lus rnam par spong / /shes rab rgya chen gyur nas spyod la gnas/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /kha zas gtsang ma dag kyang rnyed 'gyur la/ /khyad 'phags kha dog ldan zhing blta sdug la/ /reg dang ldan zhing rab mdzes gos rnams 'thob/ /dad pa'i shugs bskyedasnyebacom ldan mchod rten la/ /me tog skam po nyal nyil phyags byas na/ /'dod pa smad pa sdug bsngal byed pa spong / /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ded dpon mnyes par byed/ /mchod rten me tog rnyisashepa su 'phyag pa/ /de ni mdzes shing rnam dag lus su 'gyur/ /skye bo mang pos mchod 'os blta 'os 'gyur/ /de la rgyal po gnod par sems mi 'gyur/ /61—714

bcom ldan mchod rten dag latusnga rabs mis/ /me tog phul ba skam po phyags byas na/ /ngan song sa yi lam ngan thams cad gcod/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims phung por gnas/ /mchod rten me tog rnyisalgepa su 'phyag⑧pa//bag yod mya ngan rnams dang skyon rnams spong / /nad rnams du ma ma lus rnam par spong / /bskal pa mtha' yas rnams ④su dbugs phyin thob/ /mchod rten me tog rnyis pa su 'phyag pa/ /sbyin gnas mtshungs medashesangs rgyas thob par 'ong / /mtshungs med thob cing lha mis mchod 'os 'gyur/ /rnam dag lus ldan rgyan gyis brgyan par 'gyur/ /lha yi me tog rab mdzes man drasher / /mtshungs med pa ta la yang su 'bul dang / /mchod rten me tog nyal nyil7su 'phyag pa/ /de dag rnam smin 'dra ste mchog tu 'gyur/ /mchod rten me tog rnyisalgepa su 'phyag7pa/ /de7lus dug gis mi tshugs mtshon mi tshugs/ /me 'bar 'od 'phro phung po ches mi tshugs/ /nor gyi phung po rkun pos brku mi 'gyur / /mgu zhing rab tu dga' ba'i shugs skyed7de/ /bcom ldan mchod rten me tog skam 'phyagatson/ /de yi bsod nams bzung bar gang gyur pa/ /grangs sam cha yang brjod par sla ma yin/ /mchod rten me tog rnyis pa su 'phyag pa/ /sum cu7rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis go char 'gyur/ /mi yi 'jig rten na ni rtag tu dga'/ /mthu dang ldan zhing yid 'ong sgra skad 'byung / /mchod rten me tog rnyisalgepa su 'phyagasrepa/ /chos mchog rab mdzes yang dag sbyor byed cing / /de lus rnam par dag la chen por 'ong ring por mi thogs 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur byar mos skyed de/ /ston pa'i mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /'jig rten 61—715

dag na bla mar bkur stenyebya/ /de ni mdzes shing blta na sdug par 'gyur/ /de 'dis〈brgyal srid thob nas lha klu mi/ /lto 'phye chesnyedang 'jig rten thams cad 'dudabya / /stong gi 'jig rten khams kun rgyas par 'gyur/ /dbang phyug nyid du dbang thob rgyal srid ston/ / de yisayul na sems can gang gnas pa/ /de kun sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs la 'godabu/ /des7ni ngan song sa yang rnam par spong ske/ /de dag rnams kyi don mchog dam pa byed/ /bsod nams blo gros dran ldan mchod 'os 'gyur/ /dbugs phyin thob nas 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /de yi g.yog 'khor yid 'ong sgra skad ldan/ /bsam pa ji bzhin de dag dga' ba skyed / /sems can rnams la mi lhod7zhi tshig ston/ /de la su yang dbang phyug med mi byed/ /skye bo tshogs chen dag gis blta 'os 'gyur/ /de yi g.yog kyang sgra dbyangs yan lag dag /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra dang don spyod dang / /don 'thun7pa dag skye bo mang la byedam/ /spyos shing brgyad kyang khro ba'i dngos mi skyed/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /mtho ris 'jig rten gnas shing lha dbang 'gyur/ /mir gyur na yang mi yi rgyal por 'ong / /de ni gzhar yang yongs su nyams mi 'gyur / /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /de ni gzhar yang ngan song phyis mi ltung / /'jig rten 'dir de rtag tu 'dod pa spong / /nor can nang na phyug cing mdzod mang 'gyur/ /yon tan ldan la tshig gcig su smra ba//de ni mi rigs sngags la gzhar mi spyod/ /mi yi 'jig rten gnas min spyod mi 'gyur / /de la sems can mi ngoms dga' bar 'gyur/ /yid 'ong dbyangs ldan pho brang 'khor gshegs shing / /'jig rten mgon po sgo gtan7bzhugs 61—716

pa'i tshe/ /su zhig shugs bskyed me tog blangs te gtor/ /de ni brgyan nas rgyal ba dam pa mthongatu/ /rang gisakhyimasadu stobs bcu bsnyen bkur byed/ /de yi bshos gsol chos bzang ston pa mdzad/ / dad pasnyeskyes nas mi mchog bsnyen bkur byed/ /gos kyang thogs te rnam par 'dren la 'bulo7/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mtshungs med mchog thob nas/ /stobs bcu ldan zhing g.yo ba med gyur la/ /byang chub sangs rgyas sdug bsngal skye bo 'gro'akho/ /'jig rten kun tu mtshungs med sangs rgyas shog /de yi smon lam 'di 'dra 'di dang ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes de sems dga' mkhyen nas/ /stobs bcu 'dzum mdzad 'jig rten thams cad du/ /mtshungs med sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes lung ston to/ /skyes bu dam pa mchog gi gsung thos nas/ /bde gshegs mchog gsung gzhan du mi 'gyur te/ /bdag ni rgyal ba mchog 'gyur dogs med ces/ /dga' zhing mgu nas bar snang kun tu rgyu/ /'jig rten lha yi lhar gyur ponyesangs rgyas su/ /khyad 'phags mtshungs med sbyin gnas 'gyur ba dang / /de sems spyod dang dga'algebar gnas mkhyen nas/ /de la stobs bcu mnga' bas bzhes par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs mchog gis gos ni bzhes rig nas/ /de ni shugs skyes rab dga' sems mgu ste/ /mtshungs med 'jig rten mgon la bltas nas ni/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas bdag 'gyur mos pa bskyed/ /skye shi pha rol sems can bsgral bar bya/ /grol nas skye bo mang po 'dus byas dgrol)/ /'jig rten kun na long ba'i mig bdag 'gyur8/ /snang ba thob nas mun pa rab rib bsal/ /de ltas phan yon dam pa 'di thos nas/ /me tog phreng ba rgyal mtshan gos mchog dang ske/ /rol mo sgra dang gdugs dang byug bdug gis/ /mgon po mchodapo/la 61—717
