gser 'od gser bkod 'od bzangs7des gsungs pa/ /kye kye sa yi bdag po mnyan par gyis②/ /bde ba'i rgyu yikhubasod nams khyod la bshad/ /bslab pa'ang bshad kyis0de phyir nga las nyon/ /gang gis stong gsum rin chen gang byas la/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams la 'bul byed pa/ /de bas byang chub tu ni smon byed pa/ /bsod nams shin tu mang po 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang gis zhing rnams gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /rin chen gang bar byas nas sbyin pa byin/ /de bas byang chub tu ni smon byed pa/ /bsod nams shin tu mang po 'phel bar 'gyur / /gang gis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /sems can thams cad la ni mchod pa byed/ /de bas byang chub tu ni smon byed pa/ /bsod nams shin tu mang po 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gal te sems can thams cad dgra bcom gyur/ /ye shes dbang thob gyur pa de dag la/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i gang zag la la zhig /bskal pa khrag khrig bar du mchod pa byed/ /gang gis snying rje bskyed nas byang chub tu/ /rgya chen sems ni skyed par byed gyur te/ /sems can la la gang gis byang chub tu/ /sems kyi gtso bo bskyed pa byas nas kyang / /gom pa bdun ni bor ba'i bsod nams niX/ /de bas khyad par 'phags par 'gyur ba yin / /gal te sems can mtha' dag sangs rgyas te/ /spobs pa mtha' yas ldan pa nyid gyur laX/ /ji ltar sngon gyi 'khor ba'i bskal pa'i bar sems can gcig pus mchod pa byas pa dang / /mkhas pa'i mi ni gang yang rung ba yis / /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed nas kyang / /me tog gcig pu phul ba'i bsod nams 'di/ /de bas khyad par 'phags par 'gyur bakhuyin/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por nidu/ /bsod nams de yi bshad pa brtsams761—782

byas kyang / /bsod nams 'bras bu de yi bshad pa ni/ / nams kyanganyezad par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs ②'od des rgyal po gser mdog de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po chos gcig dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myur du theg pa bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde bsnyeyang mi 'gyur ro/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bag yod pa ste/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' bag yod pa ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par0'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de la bag yod pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/bslab pa yongs su mi gtong ba dang / dam bcas pa las mi nyams pa dang /sems can thams cad la byams pas gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba dang / byang chub la 'dun pa brtan pa dang / brtson 'grus mi gtong ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la stenasacing bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos la gus pa dang / thos pa mang pos chog mi shes pa dang ske/ gzhan dag la chos kyi bgo bsha' byed pa dang/ zang zing med par chos ston pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo7byad bsnyungs pa rnams mi gtong ba dang / 'dod pa nyung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / nga rgyal bcom pa dang / chos mnyanashepa la na⑧blags te nyan pa dang / bla ma la gus pa dang /bzod pa la gnas pa dang / gnod sems kyi tha ba'i nyes pa rnam par spangs pashedang ske/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos la mos pa dang / dmigs par lta ba thams 61—783

cad rnam par spangs pa dang / nang du yang dag 'jog la 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la mi g.yel ba dang / 'du shes zlog pa dang / bre mo'itugatam rnam par spong ba dang / lus dang sems dben par gnas pa dang / dgon par gnas pa dang / sems mnyen pa dang ske/ tshul khrimasalgemachog tu mi 'dzin pa dang / bdag la mi stodasapa dang /gzhan la mi smod pa dang / 'gyod pa thams cad las nges par 'byung bar byed pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dge sbyong gi tshul la rgyun du dga' ba dang —/ gsong por smra ba dang / bzhin khro gnyer med pa dang / chos thams cad skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa la 'dzud pa dang / chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar rtogs pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i bag yod pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i bag yod pa ni 'di lta ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems dang / dmigs par lta ba'i sems tha na rmi lam du yang yid la mi byed pa ste/ rgyal po chen po 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i bag yod pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' duni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ mgo bo dang / rkang lag dang ske/ mig dang / yan lag dang / sha dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang /rkang dang / tshil dang / mdog dang / pagasalgepa dang / lus thams cad yongs su gtang ⑥ba yang yongs su gtang ⑦mi dgos par bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong bar yang 'gyur la/ theg pa bdesabs kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/61—784

bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i chos yongs su btsal ba la yid matubartan pa yin te/ de ni dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci bskyedakhukyang rung ste/ de la brtan por gnas shing zhumasapa med pa'i sems dang ldan la theg pa chen po la shin tu brtan nodu/ /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni tshul khrims kyi phung po shin tu yongs su dag pa/'phags pa dang mkhas pas bsngags pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis yongs su zin pa dang ldan pa yin te/ des ni bdag nyid tshul khrims la gnas par rig nas chos kyi dga' ba nyams su myong ngo / /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni byams pas gnas pa dang / bsam gtan la bsam gtan pa dang / mi gnas pa'i bsam gtan pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing mi gnas (nyepa ⑥yid la byed pa dang / sems can thams cad la snyoms pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i bde bar gnas pa ci 'dra ba de lta bu'i bde ba'i rnam pa gzhan med deX/rgyal po chen po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni ji lta ba bzhin du chos la rtog pa yin te/ de ni 'di ltar ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rtog ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa 'di dag thams cad ni stong pa ste/ 'di la7bdag gam/ sems can nam/ srog gam/ gang zag gam/ yongs su gtong ba gang yin pa'am/yongs su btang ba gang yin pa'am/ len pa gang yin pa'am/ bzod par byed pa gang yin pa'am/ gang la bzod par bya ba'am/ bzod par bya ba gang yin pa'am/ rtsom7pa gang yin pa'am/ gang gi phyir rtsom pa'am bsam gtan byed pa gang yin pa'am/ bsam gtan du bya ba gang yin pa'am/ sgomanye61—785

par byed pa gang yin pa'am/ bsgom par bya ba gang yin pa gang yang med do snyam mo/ /de de ltar ji lta ba bzhin du rtog pa na 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par rig nas dmigs par lta ①ba gang la yang mngon par zhen pa med la bde bar yang gnas te/ rgyal po chen po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bde ba thams cad dang ldan par myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyal po gser mdog des bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu ri ②ba'i gos kyi sbyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa de la phul nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs bya'od de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la glo ba rje ba'i slad du bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do zhes gsol nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /bdag ni zhum pa ma mchis sems kyis su/ /mi mchog spyan sngar tshig ni gsol bar bgyi/ /sems can kun la snying rje bskyed nas kyang / /'dren pa sems ni byang chub gzhol bar bgyi/ /bdag la nams kyangasnyigayo sgyu ma mchis te/ /stobs bcu ldan pas bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen/ /yon tan mnga' ba grags chen 'dra ba ni/ /lha mi gzhan la bdag gisarnyudabang ma mchis/ /bdag ni sdug rnams skyabs dang skyob pa dang / /dpung gnyen gyur te sdug bsngal chos rnams dgrol / /khyu mchog bdag nyid bde la gnas nas kyang / /srog chags rnams ni bdag gis bdesal dgod/ /'dren pa bde gshegs gsungs pa'i chos gang 61—786

dag /de la bdag ni spyad phyir gnas par bgyi/ /'dren pa ji ltar khyod ni lha mis mchod/ /detultar bdag kyang mi rnams mchod rten shog /byang chub thams cad mchog ni tshol bgyid cing / /bskal pa mang por sbyin pa sbyin ②par bgyi / /zas skom gos dang shing rta bzhon pa dang / /gser dngul rin chen du ma'i sbyin pa bgyi/ /'dren pa bdag ni bslab la gus par bgyid/ /de ni ji bzhin yongs su bsrung bar bgyi/ /nyams par mi bgyid gang la'ang gnas mi bgyid / /'dren pa bdag ni tshul khrims dag par bgyid/ /sems can kun la snyoms pa'i bsam pa yis/ /srog chags rnams la byams pa'i sems su bgyi/ /bkur ste bgyis dang bkur sti ma bgyis la/ /mthoshebar 'gyur dang dma' bar 'gyur ma mchis/ /bskal pa bye ba mang po bsam yas par/ /bdag ni ji srid sngan chad 'khor bar gyur⑤/ /mi dpa' khyod la brten nas de srid du/ /sems can gcig gi phyir yang spro bar bgyi/ /lha mi'i 'dren pa bde gshegs gsungs pa yi/ /bsam gtan bde ba de la gnas par bgyi/ /'dren pa bsam gtan bde la reg gnas shing / /rtag tu dgon pa'i gnas su gnas par bgyi/ /bdag ni stong pa nyid la nges par bgyi/ /lta ba la ni rtenakhupar yong mi bgyidadu/ /dma' ba'i spyod pa rtag tu rnam par spang / /mchog gi spyod pa dri med spyad par bgyi/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyal po gser mdog gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed ma thag pa de'i modaphrol stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi0stong po de dag gis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /khyim bdag brgyad khri bzhi 61—787

stong po de dag dang / tshong dpon brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag dang / bu dang —/ bu mo dang / chung ma de dag dang / gzhan skye bo'i tshogs chen po de dag dang / lha'i bu brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams rgyal po gser mdog de'i rjes su slob cing thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar rgyal po gser mdog des/ bu thu bo rgyal por bcug go/ /bcug nas kyang bu rnams dang / bu mo rnams dang /chung ma rnams dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / blon po dang /rgyal phran rnams dang lhan cig ①tu srog chags bye bas bskor te dad pas khyim ②nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de dag de ltar rab tu byung nas lo khri'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba spyad do/ /rgyal po gser mdog gis kyang mngon par shes pa bsgrubs nas mang du thos pa'i mthar phyin par gyur to/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang bsgrubs so/ /de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang / lhag pa'i bsam pasayang dag par zhugs pa des 'khor los sgyurasriba'i rgyal por gyur pas sangs rgyas nyi khri mnyes par byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la yang na bza' dang / zhal zas dang /gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ bla mar byas nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyi thad du dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gser mdog tu gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod som nyi'am/ yid gnyis sam/ the tsomabaza na rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 61—788

dpa' chen po byams pa 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gser mdog tu gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na tshangs par gyur pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs ①'od de la mchod pa'i las la brtson par gyur pa gang yin pa de gzhan zhig yin pa ③snyam du khyod som nyi'am/ yid gnyis sam/ the tsomasaza na rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam par rtse0ba khyod nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na tshangs par gyur toyi/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na lha'i dbang po brgya byin bcom ldan 'das gser bzangs ⑦'od de ⑧la bsnyen bkur dang rim gro byed par spro bar gyur pa gang yin pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod som nyi'am/ yid gnyis sam/ the tsom7za na rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar7mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga7nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na lha'i dbang po brgya byin du gyur te/ byang chub tu sems ma bskyed par mi gnas pa'i sems kyis7de bzhin gshegs pa de la bsnyen bkur byas so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i tsodus na sems can ji snyed kyis rgyal po gser mdog dang lhan cig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de dag gi nang na 8tha na sems can gcig kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog pa ngas ma mthong ste/ de dag thams cad ni shes rab che ba dang / brtson 'grus che ba sha stag steyi/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yang dag par bsgrubs shing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa dag tu mtshan tha dad pa'i de bzhin gshegs par gyur tetu 7/ 'jig rten du byungatsonas thams cad kyis chos 61—789

kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyang nga dang / khyod dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / 'khor 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus pa gang yin pa 'di dag gis kyang mthong ngo / /mchod pa byas so/ /bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi dam pa'i chos kyang bzung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtse'ubs 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de tsam du yun ring du thogs pa dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yang de tsam du dka' ba ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ derakhusrog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag de snyed kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs la'od de'i gsung ④rab la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la / bcom ldan 'das kyis ni ma bskyed pa'i slad du'o/ /de skad ces gsol nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtse0 ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de ni de bzhin te/khyod ji skad zer ba bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di ni yun ring du thogs so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yang dka'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas mngon par shes pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 61—790

rgyas gser bzangasatu'od de'i sngon rol dang de'i 'og tu yang sangs rgyas mang po bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bumasadag la ngas ri mosabyas/ mchod pa byas/ bkur ste0byas/ bla mar byas mod kyi/ de srid du ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dusems ma bskyed ༷de gzhan du na nga 'di snyam du sems te / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag de tsam du mdzes shing de tsam du blta na sdug la/ de tsam du snying du sdug pa ni ngo mtshar to snyamasheste/ de dag la nga'i sdug pa'i sems dang / dga' ba dang / gus pa skyedasapar zad de/ngas7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ni sems ma bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na rnam grangs 'dis khyod kyis 'di ltar rig par bya ste/sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med grangs med pa dag dang /rang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med grangs med pa dag dang /nyan thos bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med grangs med pa dag la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar mchod pa byas su zin kyang de srid du yang de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems mi skyed de/ gzhan du na phyis gang gi tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dus par gyur pa de'i 'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par zad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /dang por nga ni don dam gzigs pa dang / /grags pa chen po shes rab pha rol son / /mi mchog sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dang / /bsam yas rnams la gus pas mchod pa byed/ /dang por yon tan 'byung gnas rnams mchod kyang / /bdag ni mkhas pa chos kun shes pa'i mchog /'jig rten mchod rten sangs 61—791

rgyas gyur cig ces/ /de srid du yang sems ni skyed mi byed/ /de dag rang rgyal bye ba snyedatul yang / /gus pa bskyed nas mchod pa byed mod kyi/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gyur ces sems ni de srid skyed mi byed/ /gus pa rgya chen yang dag bskyed nas kyang / /dbang du gyur pa bye snyed mchod mod kyi/ /ye shes rgyasamatsho mi mchog 'dra bar ni/ /de srid du yang sems ni skyed mi byed/ /don dam gzigs pa rnams kyi gzugs mthong nas/ /dga' ba'i shugs ni rgya chen bsam mi khyab/ /mkhas pa mi 'dul rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su/ /gyur ces sems ni de srid skyed mi byed/ /gang tshe de dag⑧bsod nams rgya chen bsagadu /lus dang yid kyi bden pa bsgoms pa na/ /'dren pa mi rnams mchog tu gyur cig ces/ /byang chub don du sems ni skyedashepar byed/ /de dag gis ni bskal pa bye ba snyed/ /bsnyen bkur byas pas bsod nams tshogs bsags nas/ /sems dge ba dang 'jam zhing mnyen pa yis/ /de tshe byang chub tu yang sems bskyedasnyede/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa/ /des ni bdag kyang thams cad gzigs gyur cig / nams kyang ⑨bdag gi smon lam nyams ma gyur/ /de dag de skad smon lam 'jug par 'gyur/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa/ /des ni srog chags thams cad rgal gyur cig /mi dge'i las ni bdag gis gang byas pa/ /de yi 'bras bu mi bzad7bdag gis spangaca/ /mthu dang brtson 'grus brtan po bskyed nas ni/ /phyi nas byang chub mchog tu sems kyang bskyed/ /sems ni nams kyang7zhum par ma gyur cig /dga' ba rgya chen bsam yas thob gyur cig /mkhas pa sems la dmigs par mi byed de/ /byang chub mi dmigs bdag nyid kun mi dmigs/ /61—792

chos 'di mtha' dag stong par shes na ni/ /des na byang chub sems ni brjed mi 'gyur / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par stetubs 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen po byams pa la/ byams pa zhes bgyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa 'dis ming 'di ga las rnyed lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtsesab la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa bas kyang ches grangs med pa yun ring po tshad med pa 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen gdugs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs de btsas ma thag tu gom pa bdun bor ba na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis steng gi bar snang la rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs bzung ngo / /rin po che'i gdugs des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas so/ /der0lha rnams kyis kye ma 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes sgra bsgrags te/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan rin chen gdugs ⑦zhes ⑧bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin7gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 61—793

rgyas rin chen gdugs de'ishegasung rab la dge slong blo gros brtan po zhes bya ba tshong dpon gyi rigs las rab tu byung ba zhig yod de/ rigs kyi bu dge slong blo gros brtan po de bsod snyoms par gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs de'i bstan pa la bab pa na 'dzam bu'i rgyagling de na grong brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /grong khyeraphubargyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /grong rdal brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /yul 'khor brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /tshong 'dus brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /dge slong blo gros brtan po de yang grong dang ske/ grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / tshong 'dus de dag thams cad du bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu bar gyur la/ de 'di snyam du sems te / nam srog chags brgya tshang bar bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la ma bkod kyi bar du bdag gis zan mi bza'o snyam mo/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar dge slong blo gros brtan po des de lta bu'i yi dam de bcas nas grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/grong rdal lam/ yul 'khor ram/ tshong 'dus gang dang gang du bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ba de dang der nam0srog chags brgya tshang bar bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la ma bkod kyi bar du zan mi za'o/ /rigs kyi bu dge slong blo gros brtan po des gang gi tshe nyi ma gcig gis srog chags brgya bslab pa'i gzhi 0lnga la bkod pa ⑧de'i dus dang de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma gnyis kyis srog chags brgya bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod pa7de'i dus dang de'i skabs kyang yod do0/ /des zan bcad nas nyi ma gsum pa'i tshe zan za'o/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma gsum gyis srog chags brgya bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod pa de'i dus dang de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /nyi ma bzhis srog chags brgya tshang bar bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod pa 61—794

de'i dus dang de'i skabs kyang7yod do/ /rigs kyi bu gang gi tshe nyi ma lnga dang /drug dang / bdun gyis srog chags brgya bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod pa de'i dus dang de'i skabs kyang yod de/ de zhag bdun gyi bar du zan chad kyang sems can rnams la snying rje ba'i phyir sems yongs su mi skyo ste zhag brgyad pa'i tshe zan za'o/ /rigs kyi bu rnam grangs de lta bus dge slong blo gros brtan po des lo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems kyis grong khyer chen po de dag tu song zhing grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / tshong 'dus7de dag tu song nas sems can de dag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod do/ /rigs kyi bu dge slong blo gros brtan po des lo brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag 'das nas srog chags skyes pa dang / bud med dang /khye'u dang / bu mo bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag sum cusartsa drug bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar dge slong blo gros brtan po de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can mang po 'di dag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod zin gyisaX/ bdag gis 'di dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gzud gor ma chag go snyam ste/ de de dag gi thad du song nas lo bzhi khri nyis stong gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /chos kyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa brjod do/ /sems can bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod pa gang yin pa'i sems can de dag gi nang nas lo brgyad khri bzhi stong pokhugazhan 'das nas srog chags bye ba phrag sum cusatshang ba gang dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa rgya chen po la mos pa de dag bla na med pa yang dag par 61—795

rdzogs pa'i byang chub la btsud do/ /lhag ma dman pa la mos pa rkyen gyi mthu dang ldan pa de dag ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa la sems bskyed du bcug go/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar dge slong blo gros brtan po de7'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag theg pa gsum po la mos par byas zin gyis②/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag bag yod par gnas par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin 'disal gzud pasnyibastan to snyam mo/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar dge slong blo gros brtan po des yang lo nyi khri chig stong gi bar du srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag sum cu dum drug po de dag la ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pa'i lung phog go/ /rigs kyi bu dge slong blo gros brtan po des srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag sum cu durtsa drug po'i sems can de dag thams cad ci nas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrub ⑦par 'gyur ba de lta de lta bur gdams ngag bstan cing / de lta de lta bur rjes su ston to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar dge slong blo gros brtan dupo de gang gi tshe grong du 'gro ba de'i tshe byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'gro'o/ /de byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/yul 'khor ram/ tshong 'dus7su bsod snyoms kyi phyir 'gro ste/ de 'gro ba na de na kyisems can byams pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad dge slong blo gros brtan po de'i rkang pa sgo'i them pa la bzhag pa'i tshe byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu lhag pa'i bsam pa dang —/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la yid ches pa dang / stong palonyid la mos pa'i khyad par la ltos/ de'i phyir dge slong blo gros brtan po'i rkang pa sgo'i them pa la 61—796

bzhag pa'i tshe sems can de dag thams cad byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la ji ltar 'dzud7pa bzhin du byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas de'i tshe dge slong blo gros brtan po de'i ②byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul ①pa de lta bu mthong nas sa bla pa'i lha rnams kyis a la la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni byams par 'gyur te/ 'di ltar 'di grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / tshong 'dus0su 'gro ba na sems can rnams byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyir ro zhes sgra sgrogs shing skad 'byin par byed do/ /sa bla pa'i lha rnams kyi sgra thos nas bar snang gi lha rnams kyis sgra bsgrags shing skad phyung ngo / /de dag gi sgra thos nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi bar du gcig nas gcig tu sgra thos nas a la la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni byams par 'gyur te/ 'di ltar 'di grong dang /grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / tshong 'dusakyisu song ba na sems can rnams byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'i phyir ro zhes sgra bsgrags shing skad phyung ngo / /de'i ming de la yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gdugs des rjes su yi rang b.rasnyemadzad de/ 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' dge slong blo gros brtan po7'di ni srid par 'gro ba'i 'chi 'pho dang skye ba thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa zhes bya bar 61—797

'gyur te/ mngon par grags par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub thob pa'i tshe yang 'di'i ming de nyid du 'gyur te 'jig rten du nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dpag tu med pa dang / rin po che bkod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams 'dus pa'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong blo gros brtan po zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod7som nyi'am/ yid gnyis sam/ the tsomasazasasrid de/ de tshun chad tshe rabs thams cad du ming 'di lta ste/ byams pa zhes bya ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur to/ /byang chub thob pa'i tshe yang 'di'i ming 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa zhes bya ba de 0kho nar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu rgyu ni de yin no/ /rkyen ni de yin te/ de bsalgen byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la byams pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i sngon byung ba 'di bshad ma thag pa de'i mod la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /steng gi bar snang la yang lha'i glu dbyangs grag go/ /me tog gi char yang bab po/ /de nas de'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhi dang ske/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / mi mjedasakyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /gzhan yang lha'i bu 'bum phrag du ma dag gis lha'i me tog man dā ⑨ra ba dag khyer nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa ga la ba ⑩der gtor te⑩/ tshig 'di skad du kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 61—798

byams pa 'di ni skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs te/ skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi skye bo phal po che'i don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir go cha chen po bgos te/ 'di ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma thob par yang sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag de snyed kyi don byas pa'i phyir ro/ /sems can gang dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i ming ①tsam thos pa de dag kyang rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pa yin na ②sha'i mig gis mngon sum du mthong nas dga' ba thob pa de dag lta ci smos/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la bdag cag phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras so/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis tshig de skad ces smras ma thag pa de'i mod la skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang bcas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dngasabacas pa'i 'jig rten gyis tshig 'thun par tshig 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa na srog chags khri nyis stong chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /dge slong lnga stong ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /srog chags stong phrag du ma ni dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par gyur te/ de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa'i 'khor 'dus pa gnyis pa la dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes de dag kyang ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las 61—799

langs te/ bla gos phragashepa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung〈bar bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming byams pa'i dang po sems bskyed pa zhes bya bar zung shigani /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rtse0bas zhus pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigadu /byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigadu /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑦ /byang chub sems dpa'i sgo so so ba zhes bya bar yang zung shigadu /kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung ba'i phyir dang〈nye/ gzhan dag la yang rgyas par yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i bar gyi phyir khyod la gtad do/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis gang bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul ba bas ni gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i dang po 'jug pa ⑩'di thos nas ⑩sems kyi rgyud byang chub tu gzhol ba dang / byang chub tu7smon pas mos par byed dam/ 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngamal/ kun chub par byed dam/ sgom mamadzo/ gzhan dag la rgyas par yang dag par ston par byed na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du snyed 8par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag 61wa 800

bka' stsal to/ /mi lus 'thob pa rnyed par dka'/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'angaturnyed par dka'/ /sangs rgyas dad pa rnyed par dka'/ /byang chub sems kyang rnyed par dka'/ /gnas skabs bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /bskal pa bye bar rnyed dka' ste/ /de phyir thob nas ma spangs7shig /mthu rtsal dag kyang chud ma gzan / /mi lus thob pa rnyed pa dang / /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed pa dang / /sangs rgyas dad pa'ang rnyed pa dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed gyur na/ /de phyir brtson 'grus bskyed nas kyang / /rtag tu bag ni yod par gyis/ /drang srong chen po de dag gis/ /bgasayod pas ni byang chub brnyes/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba'i sgo dang tshul gyi lam/ /bag yod pa dang brtson 'grus yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang 'di la slobadu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rtse ba dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yikhurangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa byams pa 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs jok+ṣa// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā warmarkudang / dzi na mi tra dang / su ren7dra bo dhi dang ske/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde7la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //61—801

pa dga' ldan gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/① ༄༅gi /rgya'i skad du/ kun ji li'u phu sa zhang sh+yan te'u shis rgyan kyin/bod skad du/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dga' ldan gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod kyi yul rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal/ mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu mang po dang thabs cig⑧ku bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das mtshan mo'i thun dang po la/ sku las 'od zer gser gyi kha dog lta bu byung nas/ rgyal byed kyi tshal lan bdun bskor te/ khyim bdag su ta sha la sogs pa 'od kyis reg par byas nas/ 'od gser gyi kha dog lta bu nam mkha' la sprin bzhin du khyab par byas nasalgemanyan du yod pa'i yul kun tu 61—810

gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i me tog char rab tu phab bo/ /'od gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i nang nas sprul pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa brgya stong snang ba thams cad kyis gsung 'thun7par bskal pa 'di nyid du/ byang chub sems dpa' stong gi dang po log par dad sel sangs rgyas pa nas/ tha mar snang mdzad sangs rgyas pa'i don bka' stsal to/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi7rgya ting nge 'dzin las langs nas 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod galasagyi bu 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / ma ha pa⑥sha pa ti la sogs pa dge slong ma stong dang / khyim bdag su ta sha la sogs pa dge bsnyen pha sum stong dang /byi shwa khra 'pho ta la sogs pa dge bsnyen ma nyis stong dang / kun tu bzang po la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dang / chos kyi rgyal bu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa 'khor thams cad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis bskul nas sprin bzhin du 'dus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ljags kyi dbang po las 'od zer stong phyung nas/ 'od zer re re kha dog stong stong / kha dog re re'i nang nas/sprul pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa snyed snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis gsung 'thun par/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi chos thams cad rnam par dag pa zab mo'i gzungs bstan pa 'di lta ste/ a nan ta mu dra zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / stong pa nyid 61—811

kyi ye shes zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / sgrib pa med pa'i dngos po zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / mtshan ma med par rnam par grol ba chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs la sogs pa/ sgra skad gcig gis brgya phrag bye ba'i gzungs kyi sgo bka' stsal to/ /gzungs kyi sgo bka' stsal ma thag tu/ 'khor 'dus pa'i nang nas/byang chub sems dpa' byams pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa thos nas/ de ma thag tu bye ba brgya phrag khri'i gzungs kyi sgo thob nas/ stan las langs te gos tshags bcos nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u pā li stan las langs te/ gdong dang spyi bos phyag 'tshal 'o9/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon du yang mdzod kyi chos thams cad las / ma pham pa ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas par gsungasalgen/ ma pham pa so so'i skye bo'i lus dang ma bral/ zag pa yang ma zad/ ma pham pa 'di nyid du rab tu byung yang / ting nge 'dzin mi bsgom/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs na/bcom ldan 'das kyis nges par sangs rgyas par bka' stsal na/ ma pham pa de tshe'i dus byas nas/ khams gang du skye ba len par 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis u pā li la bka' stsal pa/ u pā li gcig tu gyis la nyon cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pas 'khor 'di'i nang du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgyas par 'gyur bar lung bstan gyis② / dus 'di nas lo bcu gnyis kyi 'og tu che'i dus byas nas/ nges par dga' ldan gyi gnam du skye ba len par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dga' ldan gyi gnam 61—812

gyi steng na/ lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig phrag lnga brgya yod pa/ lha'i bu re res kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyod pas/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i don du/ lha'i bsod nams kyi mthus/gzhal med khang byas te/ rang rang gi lus kyi gos dang / tsan dan dang /rin po che'i dbu rgyan phud de/ pus mo btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te/ smon lam 'di skad ces btab bo/ /bdag gi rin thang med pa'i rin po che dang /lha'i dbu rgyan gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po la mchod pa'i don du/ ma pham pa 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus su ring po mi thogs par/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa thos nas/ bdag cag gi rin po che'i dbu rgyan 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur cig ces lha'i bu thams cad rang rang pus mo btsugs te/smon lam de skad ces btab pa dang / de nas lha thams cad kyis smon lam btab ma thag tu/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan thams cad bye ba khrag khrig phrag lnga brgya'i gzhal med khang du gyur te/ rin po che'i gzhal med khang re re la yang skyed mos tshal bdun bdun/ skyed mos tshal re re yang / rin po che sna bdun bdun las grub pa/ rin po che re re las kyang bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i 'od kyi 'od zer re re las bye ba phrag 1)brgya'i pad ma pad ma re re las bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che sna bdun gyi shing gi phreng ba/ shing re re'i lo ma las bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che'i kha dog /rin po che'i kha dog re re las kyang / bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i 'dzam bu'i gser gyi 'od 'dzam bu'i gser gyi 'od re re'i nang nas kyang ske/ bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che'i lha'i bu mo/ lha'i bu mo re re yang shing 61—813

gi drung na 'dug nas/ lag na bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che grangs med pa'i do shal thogs/ ngo mtshar che ba'i glu dbyangs snyan pa len/ glu dbyangs snyan pa'i nang nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'i chos kyi 'khor lo spyod/ shing de dag las 'bras bu skyes pa'i kha dog be+e drur+ya7bzhin du 'dug /kha dog de dag thams cad be+e drur+ya'iphunang du 'dug pa/ 'od zer de dag thams cad g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba / sgra snyan pa sna tshogs 'byung ba/ sgra thams cad las/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'i chos 'chad pa/ re re'i pho brang mtho khyad ni dpag tshad drug cu rtsa gnyis/ rngams su dpag tshad bcu bzhi/ klu'i rgyal po bye ba phrag lnga brgyas ni pho brang bskor/ klu'i rgyal po re re yang bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che sna bdun gyi shing gi char phab pas pho brang gi steng brgyan/ rang bzhin rlung byung bas shing de dag bskyod pa dang / shing de las mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi sgra byung bar gyur to①/ /de nas pho brang de'i nang na/ rgyal po chen po le'u du pa ti zhes bya ba/ stan la 'dug pa las langs te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshalasanas/ smon lam 'di skad ces btab po/ /bdag gi bsod nams kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i chos kyi pho brang byed pa'i bsod nams dang ldan na/ bdag gi smin mtshams bar nas nor bu rin po che rang byung bar gyur cig /ces smon lam btab pa dang / de ma thag tu bye ba phrag brgya'i rin po che byung nas/ rin po che be+e drur+ya0la sogs pa'i kha dog thams cad rdzogs par grub pa/ shel gyi kha dog bzhin phyi nang gsal ba/ rin po che de dag nam mkha' stong pa la 'khor 61—814

zhing —/ ngo mtshar che ba'i rin po che'i pho brang rim pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sprul par gyur to/ /re re'i lan zhun re re las kyang / bye ba 'bum phrag gi rin po che pad ma 'dis spras pa la grub pa/ lan zhun gyi bar thams cad na/ rdzus te skyes pa'i lha'i bu bye ba phrag dgu dang / lha'i bu mo bye ba phrag lnga brgya la/ lha'i bu re re'i lag nas rin po che sna bdun bdun las grub pa'i pad ma dpag tu med pa bye ba phrag bcu/ pad ma re re'i steng du 'od bye ba phrag dpag tu med pa 'od de dag gi nang na/ lha'i rol mo'i cha spyad ma dkrol bar sgra rang byung ba/sgra de dag byung ba dang / bu mo thams cad langs nas/ rol mo'i cha spyad thogs te/ gar dang / glu dbyangs snyan pa len pa'i sgra las/ dge ba bcu dang ske/ smon lam bzhi la sogs pa'i sgra/ lha thams cad kyis thos pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas skyed mos tshal thams cad kyi nang na/ skyed mos tshal kha dog brgyad kyi bai drur+ya'inyerdzing bu rdzing bu re re'i nang na / bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che las grub pa/ rdzing bu re re'i nang na/yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ chu de dag kyang gyen du 'bab pa/sgo bzhi'i phyi rol na rdzus te skyes pa'i pad ma bzhi/ pad ma de dag las chu byung ba rin po che'i pad ma'i kha dog bzhin du 'bab pa/ pad ma re re'i steng du lha'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhi/ lus kyi kha dog ngo mtshar che ba/ byang chub sems dpa' bzhin du brgyan pa/ lus mtshan dang ldan pa/ lag na rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi snod bye ba phrag lnga brgya sprul/ snod re re'i nang na/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin thams cad kyis gang ba/ phrag pa g.yon la thogs pa/ do shal dpag tu med pa/ phrag pa g.yas la thogs pa/ rol mo'i cha byad dpag tu 61—815

med pa sprin bzhin du nam mkha' la 'dug pa/ chu las byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' pha rol tu phyin pa drug brjod pa/ dga' ldan gyi gnam du skyes pa'i lha'i bu gang la la zhig /rang bzhin gyis lha'i bu mo rnams kyis g.yog byas pa / rin po che sna bdun gyi seng ge'i khri 'phang du dpag tshad bzhi yod pa/'dzam bu'i gser dang / rin po che dpag tu med pas brgyan pa zur bzhi la 'dug pa/ pad ma bzhi las skyes pa/ pad ma re re la yang rin po che phrag brgya las grub pa/ rin po che re re la yang bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od zer/ 'od zer de dag las/ ngo mtshar che ba sprul pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog sprul pas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i yol ba bres7pa de'i phyogs na tshangs pa'i rgyal po bye ba phrag stong gis/ rang rang gi tshangs pa'i lha'i ngo mtshar che ba'i dril bu khyer nas/yol ba'i steng du spyangs〈mipa/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po chung ngus kyang / rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dra bas yol ba'i steng du bres pa/ de nas lha'i bu dang / lha'i bu mo brgya stong grangs7med pa'i 'khor gyis/ rin po che'i me tog pad ma thams cad khyer nas khri'i steng du bdal ba/ pad ma de dag thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi bu mo bye ba phrag lnga brgya byung ba de dag gi lag na rnga yab dkar po thogs pa/ yol ba'i nang na 'dug pa/ pho brang zur bzhi la rin po che'i ka ba bzhi yod pa/ rin po che'i ka ba re re la yang brgya phrag stong gi khang pa brtsegs pa / bu mo 'di'i nor bu ni bres④/ lan kun bar kun tu lha'i bu mo brgya stong yod / kha dog ngo mtshar che ba/ dpag tu med pa'i rol mo'i cha spyad lag na thogs pa/ rol mo'i sgra'i nang nas sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / mi rtag pa dang / bdag med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi sgra 'byung 61—816

ba / lha'i pho brang de dag nas rin po che'i kha dog dpag tu med pa bye ba phrag brgya yod pa/ bu mo re re kun kyang rin po che'i kha dog dang 'thunanyepar sprul to / /de nas phyogs bcu'i lha dpag tu med pa thams cad/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i pho brang du skye ba len par smon lam btab po/ /de nas dga' ldan gyi pho brang na/ rgyal po chen po lnga po la/ rgyal po chen po dang po ni/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ lus la rin po che sna bdun gyi char 'bebs pas pho brang gi nang du 'thor ba/ rin po che'i nor bu re re yang / rol mo'i cha spyad dpag tu med par sprul pa/ nam mkha' la kun tu 'phyang ba/ ma brdungs par sgra snyan pa dpag tu med pa rang 'byung ba/ sems can gyi yid rtog pa/ rgyal po gnyis pa me tog 'thor ba zhes bya ba/ lus la me tog sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa / pho brang thams cad khyab par me tog gi gdugs sprulanya/ gdugs re re yang brgya phrag stong gi rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan gyis lam drangs pa/ rgyal po gsum pa ni/ spos kyi dbyangs zhes bya ba/ lus kyi ba spu'i khung bu'i nang nas/ngo mtshar che ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi tsan dan gyi spos kyi char 'bebs pa/ spos de dag sprin bzhin du chags pa/ kha dog brgya phrag gis pho brang lan bdun du bskor ba/ rgyal po chen po bzhi pa/ dga' ba bde ba zhes bya ba/ lus la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ rin po che re re yang rang bzhin gyis rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan gyi steng du 'dug nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro bar 'chad pa dang /yan lag lnga'i tshul khrims kyi sgra dang / dge ba'i chos dpag tu med pa dang /pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang / byams pa byang chub kyi yan lag gi sgra la 61—817

'dzud pa/ rgyal po chen po lnga pa/ sgra dbyangs drag po zhes bya ba/ lus kyi ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas chu 'bebs pa/ chu re re'i steng du me tog pad ma bye ba phrag lnga brgya yod pa/ pad ma re re'i steng du shel gyi bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga/shel gyi bu mo re re'i lus thams cad kyi ba spu'i bu ga re re'i nang nas/ lha'i bdud las rgyal ba'i sgra snyan pa 'byung ba sprul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis u pā li la bka' stsal pa/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i gnas zhes bya bar/ dge ba bcu dang ske/ rgyal ba la drin bsab pa dang / ngo mtshar che ba bskyed pa'i bsod nams ni/ ngas bskal pa chung ngu gcig gi bar du 'dug nas/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' drin bsab pa dang / dge ba bcu'i 'bras bu bshad kyang rdzogs pa'i mtha' med de/ 'dir ngas khyed la sogs pa la mdo tsam zhig bshad cing bstan par bya'o/ /u pā li dge slong ngam/ 'khor thams cad kyang rung ste/ gang la la zhig skye shi la mi skyo bar/ lha'i gnas su skye bar 'dod na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ byams pa'i zhabs 'bring byed 'dod par lta ba ni/ yan lag lnga'i khrims brgyad rdzogs pa/lus sems kyi brtson 'grus rgyun mi 'chad pa/ dge ba bcu'i chos la spyod pa/bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'dod pa/ sems rtse gcig tu dga' ldan gyi gnas su skye bar 'dod pa de dag ni yang dag par lta ba zhes bya ste/ gzhan du lta ba ni/ log par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas u pā li stan las langs te/gos tshags bcos nas/ gdong dang spyi bos phyag 'tshal7te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ dga' ldan gyi gnam du de lta bu'i bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa der/ skyes bu chen po 'di dus ci tsam 61—818

du 'dzam bu'i gling nas/ lha'i gnas de lta bur skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dus 'di nas lo bcu gnyis lon nas/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma la/ yul ba ra ni kra pa li'i grong khyer na bram ze chen po pa pa li zhes bya ba'i khyim nas skye ba blangs pa'i sa nas/ skyil mo krung7bcas nas/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin du/ lus gser gyi kha dog dang / 'od zer dmar po nyi ma brgya stong bas lhag /steng7gi dga' ldan gyi gnam du/ lus kyi sku gdung yang dper na/ gser gyi gzugs bzhin dul/ mi g.yo mi 'gul bar/ lus kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas/rnam par thar pa gsum dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yi ge gsal bar ston te/ de nas lha mi thams cad rjes su 'brang nas/ rin po che sku gdung gi mchod rten la mchod nas/ de nas dga' ldan gyi gnam du/ rin po che sna bdun gyi pho brang na 'di gzhal med khang seng ge'i pad ma'i steng du skyil mo krung bcas nas/ lus 'dzam bu gser gyi kha dog bzhin du rdzus te skyes nas/ sku chur dpag tshad bcu drug /mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byadakhubazang po brgyad cus rdzogs par brgyan pa/ dbu'i thor tshugs dang ldan/ dbu skra bai drur+ya'i kha dog dang 'dra ba/ shi kra bi li kra dang / ma 'di dang / gyen shugs kyi rin po ches lha'i dbu rgyan brgyan pa/ rin po che lha'i dbu rgyan de dag la/ bye ba phrag brgya'i rin po che'i kha dog re re'i nang nas/ sprul pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa brgya stong phrag khri'i sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang pos zhabs 'bring byas pa/ de nas zhing khams gzhan gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ cho 'phrul bco brgyad ston cing / lha'i dbu rgyan gyi 61—819

nang na yid la smon pa'i rjes su 'thunatugar lha'i dbu rgyan gyi nang na gnas so/ /byams pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po byung ste/ 'od zer de dag las/brgya phrag gi rin po che'i kha dog dang ldan pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mtshan re re'i nang nas bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che'i kha dog dpe byad bzang po/dpe byad re re la yang / bye ba phrag lnga brgya'i rin po che'i mtshan dang / dpe byad kyi kha dog 'bar ba'i lha'i bu re re'i 'od zer brgya 0khri bzhi stong gi sprin thams cad pad ma las rang rang 'dug nas/ nyin mtshan rtag par phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'i chos kyi 'khor lo spyod pa/ bgrod pa gcig cing don grub par byed pa phrag lnga brgya'i lha'i bu de dag phyir mi ldog pa'i/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di dag tu/ dga' ldan gyi gnam du nyin mtshan rtag tu phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'i chos kyi 'khor lo la/ lha'i bu thams cad 'khod pa/'dzam bu'i gling gi tshe lo'i grangs bye ba 'bum phrag lnga bcu rtsa drug lon nas/byams pa dga' ldan gyi gnam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo bshad par 'gyur ro/ /u pā li/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa zhes bya ba/'dzam bu'i gling nas tshe 'phos nas/ dga' ldan gnam du skyes pa'i yon tan ni/de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ nga'i⑧'khor nye gnas las gang la la zhig /brtson 'grus su bsod nams bsags pa/ sdom pa ma zhig cing mchod rten la phyag darasnyedang / maṇ+ḍal byed pa dang / spos dri zhim pa dang /me tog gi mchod pa dang / rnam par thar pa gsum la spyod cing / zab cing drang ba'i chos la spyod pa dang / mdo sde klog cing / sems rtse gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par yid la zlos pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug thob par byed pa dang /61—820

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byed pa dang / byams pa'i mtshan brjod pa de lta bu la sogs pa'i mi de dag ni 'di skad cig tsam du khrims brgyad mnos nas/sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed cing / smon lam btab nas/ tshe'i dus byas pa'i 'og tu/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa lag pa brkyang ba tsam du dga' ldan du skyes nas pad ma'i steng du skyil mo krung bcas nas/ brgya phrag stong gi lha'i bus/ lha'i rol mo byed cing / me tog man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po 'thor zhing / legs so legs so/ /zhes bsngags pa brjod nas / rigs kyi bu khyod ni 'dzam bu'i gling du bsod nams rgya chen po bsags nas / 'chi 'pho ba'i 'og tu/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas zhes bya ba yin te/'dir lha'i rgyal po byams pa zhes bya ba la/ khyod skyabs su gsol/ phyag 'tshol cig dang / phyag 'tshal na/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu ①nas/ 'od zer dkar pos reg par byas nas/ bskal pa dgu bcu'i skye shi las grol zhing sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'thun ②pa'i yon tan gyis/ ngo mtshar gyi〈)chos bshad nas/ brtson pa mi 'dor ba phyirngo mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo dang / bla na med pa'i lam yid la sems pa de lta bu la sogs pa'i sems can sdig pa thams cad byang zhing / chos drug la spyod na/the tsomasamed par nges par dga' ldan gyi gnam du skyes nas/ 'phags pa byams pa'i zhal mthong / byams pa'i zhabs 'bring byasalgenas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du dang por chos thos nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa 'di nyid kyi sangs rgyas dang / bskal pa skar ma lta bu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang zhal mthong nas / sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyi drung du byang chub tu lung ston pa thob 61—821

par 'gyur ro/ /u pā li/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang ske/ lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa 'khor thams cad las/ gang la la zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i mtshan thos nas dga' ba dang / gus par phyag 'tshal ba'i mi de dag /che'i dus byas nas/ se gol gtogs pa tsam du gong ma ci lta ba bzhin du/ byams pa'i mtshan thos nas che'i dus byas pa'i 'og tu/ mun pa'i khams su mi ltung / mtha' 'khob kyi yul dang ske/ log par lta ba dang / mi dge ba thams cad spyod par mi skye/ skye ba thams cad du drang por lta ba dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la mi smod par skye'o/ /u pā li/ rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig /sdom pa bshig pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i las byas pas / byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po'i mtshan thos pas/ mtshan nas brjod cing / yan lag lnga gtugs te/ sems rtse gcig tu bshags na/sdig pa thams cad myur du byang nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi sems can thams cad/byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po'i mtshan brjod pa dang / sku gzugs bris nas/ spos dang / me tog dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / phyag 'tshal0)zhing / yid la zlos na/ mi de dag che'i dus byas pa'i tshe na/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas/ mi chen po'i mtshan smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas/ 'od dang / lha'i bu thams cad kyis / man dā ra ba'i char phab nas/ mi de dag bsus nas/ skad cig yud 61—822

tsam gyis lha'i gnas su skyes/ 'phags pa byams pa'i zhal mthong nas/ gdong dang spyi bos phyag 'tshalatunas/ de ma thag tu chos thos pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /u pā li/ khyod rtse gcig tu nyon la yid la gyis shig /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa zhes bya ba la/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba na/ gang la la zhig skyabs su 'gro ba'i mi de dag ni/ bla na med pa'i lam dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'thob nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi tshe/ mi de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer mthong nas/ lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /u pā li/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu 'khor bzhi po dang —/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa gang la la zhig dga' ldan gyi gnas su skyes pa'i dus kyi tshe/ 'di ltar blta bar bya ste/ dga' ldan yid la byed pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sdom pa blangs nas/ nyi ma gcig gam / nyi ma bdun gyi bar du/ dge ba bcu yid la byed pa dang / dge ba bcu'i lam la spyod pa'i bsod nams de dag /byams pa'i mdun du bsngo zhing smon lam btab pa de dag ni/ lta ba de dag gi lha'i bu mthong ba dang / pad ma mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig skad cig tsam byams pa'i ming nas brjod pa'i mi de dag ni/ bskal pa stong nyis brgya'i skye shi las grol zhing /sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /byams pa'i mtshan thos pas thal mo sbyar ba'i mi 61—823

de dag ni/ bskal pa lnga bcu'i skye shi las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig byams pa la gus par phyag 'tshalatubs/ bskal pa bye ba brgya'i skye shi las grol thar zhing sdig pa byang bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gnas la mi chags shing / ma 'ongs pa'i dus su klu'i sdong po byang chub kyi shing drung du/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam du sems bskyed pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'khor mang po dpag tu med pa stan⑧las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshalasnyenas/ byams pa'i zhabs la yang phyag 'tshalasnyinas/ bcom ldan 'das dang / byams pa la lan brgya stong du bskor nas/ lam ma thob pa dag rang rang gi smon lam btab pa/ bdag cag la sogs pas/ lha dang / mi dang / sde brgyad po 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mos pas smon lam btab pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lus spangs nas/ 'phags pa byams pa'i zhal mthong ba dang / thams cad dga' ldan gyi gnam du skye ba thob par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / khyed la sogs pa ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bsod nams byed pa dang / tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / thams cad byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i drung du skye ba blangs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das kyis u pā li la bka' stsal pa/ u pā li de lta bur lta ba ni/yang dag par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan du lta ba ni/ log par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan la 'dug pa las langs te/ pus mo btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das/ byams pa'i yon tan legs par bshad do/ /61—824

ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ bsod nams byed pa'i sems can 'bras bu thob pa bdag cag gis thob par 'tshal bas/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mtshan ci lags/ bdag cag gis ci ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ /khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma brjed par zung0nyel/ ma 'ongs pa'i don du lha'i gnas su skye ba'i lam 'byed pa dang / byang chub kyi mtshan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rgyun mi gcod pas/ mdo sde'i ming / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mya ngan las 'das pa zhes kyang bya/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dga' ldan gyi gnam du skye ba blangs nas/ byang chub kyi snying po la bskul ba zhes bya bar zung ②shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ zhing khams gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'bumasaphrag bcu bzhi'i le'u brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /lha'i bu 'bum phrag brgyad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ thams cad kyis byams pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du skye bar smon lam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ 'khor bzhi po dang / lha dang / klu la sogs pa/ sde brgyad po/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal nas/ thams cad mngon par dga' ste/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal stinas phyir dong ngo / /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dga' ldan gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo rdzogs so// //zhu ba'i lots+tsha ba ban de pab tong dang / ban de shes rab seng ges rgya'i dpe las bsgyur// //61—825

bsdur mchan/81 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig ②〈〈khu 〉〉na/811 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉kornyi/ ③〈〈khu 〉〉mo'u dgal/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉ba/ 0〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/812 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal lo/ 〈〈khu 〉〉'tshal nas/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉gsung / ③〈〈zhol 〉〉gyi/812 ①〈〈khu 〉〉 lnga/814 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya'i/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉te/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya/815 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya'i/816 ①〈〈khu 〉〉bris/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉dbyangs/ ③〈〈khu 〉〉bgrangs/ 0〈〈khu 〉〉bris/817 7〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉 pa/818 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/819 ①〈〈khu 〉〉grung / ②〈〈khu 〉〉steng/ ③〈〈khu 〉〉bya/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉tsugs/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya'i/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉brgyan/82 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉brgyad/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉de'i/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉bdar/821 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉sku/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/ ③〈〈zhol 〉〉 gyi/ 0〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉tshom/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉 byas/822 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/822 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/824 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉bstan/ ③du〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉par/825 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉gzung / ②〈〈zhol 〉〉zungs/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉bus/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/67wa 826
bsdur 'bras re'u migamado the/ (2༷5)61wa 827

spag /'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'thun par 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya lo kā nu brtanasnyenasam ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'thun par 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ thub pa'i rgyal po ri la bzhugs/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems chen⑧dang / /nyan thos rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de nas mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /btud ⑥de rgyal la ⑦'di skad gsol/ /slad ma'i skye bo rnams slad du/ /dpa' bo chen pos bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan 'byung / /zab cing rgya chen (8༄phun sum tshogs/ /mdo sde dam pa blo rab kyis0/ /smra ba'i mchog gis bshad du gsol/ /'jig rten mgon po'i thugs skyes sras/ /gcesalge'adzin mchog la bka' stsal pa/ /rtse gcig sems su yid byos la/ /nyon cig 61—828

da nitubashad par bya/ /blo dang ldan pas yon tan zhus/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ /chos smra sems can mchog rnams kyis/ /chos nyid de ni mnyan par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams dpag med las②/ /rang sangs rgyas ni7thams cad dang / /nyan thos dag gis rnam kun tu/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsags pa na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spros med la/ /byis pa spros pa spyod pa yi/ /sems can kun gyis rgyal ba rnams/ /rig par mi nus smos ci dgosal/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas chos nyid gang yin dang / /rang byung sku thugs ci 'dra dang / /shes rab ci 'dra rab tu mkhyen / /'jig rten du ni 'jig rten sgron/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams byung yang ske/ /'jig rten dang ni 'dres med la/ /'jig rten du yang snang ba ston/ /sku dang sku yi phrin las dang / /gsung gis gang dag brjod pa dang / /yid dang yid kyi rnam rtog rnams/ /rgyal ba'i thams cad 'jig rten 'das/ /'jig rten na ni thugs brtse bas/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od mdzad pa/ /'jig rten ji ltar rtogasalgepa bzhin/ /sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag 'phags / /de dag phrin (8)las 'jig rten 'das/ /rnam par smin pa bla na med / /gal te 'jig rten rnam 'dren rnams/ /'jig rten 'thun par mi 'jug na/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid gang yin dang / /sangs rgyas sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten kun la phan bzhed pa/ /skyob pa rdzu 'phrul ldan pa po/ /rang byung sdig pa mi mnga' ba/ /de dag g.yo ba bsam mi khyab/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku/ /'khrig pa las ni byung min la/ /yab dang yum yang 61—829

ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las byung / /'on kyang byis pa nyid ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni dpag med de/ /phyogs bcu dag tu snang mdzad kyang / /'domatugang 'od du ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ / mi yishedam pa nam du yang la/ /zhabs gnyis sa la mi reg ste/ /'on kyang lam srang de ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'dod pa de dag rnams〈smad de/ /'dod pa'i rdzabakyilas yang dag 'phags/ /'on kyang sras la sogs ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mar me mdzad nas bzung nas su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags bral/ /sgra gcan zinakyil sras zhesalgegasungs/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /lha dang 'jig rten bcas pa yi nga ni mchog ces bka' stsal pa/ /phyin nas chos ni tshol mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /thub chen 'dzam shing grib ma la/ /bzhugs te bsam gtan mdzad bstan dngashe/ /lo drug bar du dka' spyadasapa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /gnyis su med par zhing 'di na/ /byang chub snying por bzhugasalgenas ni/ /bdud 'dul rnam par ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /byang chub mtshungs med sangs rgyas te/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten ston yin yang / /thugs las chung ngu nyid ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /dpa' bo thugs rje che ldan pa/ /bstan pa'i phyir ni 'dir gshegs 'kho/ /gsol ba 'debs la gzhes mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rang byung rnams kyi mkhyen pa ni/ /phyir zhing 61—830

'jug pa mi mnga' yang / /de dag dran7pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la ni/ /byon dang bzhud pa mi mnga' yang / /'on kyang bzhud par rnam snang ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rgyal ba rnams ni mkha' 'dra ste/ /chos rnams kun la mi gnas kyang / /ldang ba ltar yang snang ba ni/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i 'dabasre'adra ste/ /de dag rdul gyis mi gos late/ /zhabs kyang 'khru ba mdzad pa ni/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de dag dri ma mi mnga' ste/ /sku ni gser gyi mdog 'dra yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khrus mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /zhal ni pad ma'i dri ldan zhing / /tshems ni dri med mu tig 'dra/ /'on kyang tshems shing gsol mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de dag sgrimasalgepa mi mnga' yang / /de dag zhal zas gsol mdzad cing / /sbyin pa po la 'bras bu r+ṣa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sku mkhregs rdo rje 'dra ba'i phyir / /zag pa dag ni mi mnga' yang / / bshad pa'ikyisar ni gshegs mdzad pa//'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de dag snyun ni mi mnga' yang / /dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sman kyang bsten par mdzad pa ni/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan te/ /sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / /de dag rga ba ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'jig rten khams ni dpag tu med/ /zhabs kyi mthe bos g.yo mdzad la/ /'on kyang nyamakhuchung ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /yid kyi sku dang rab ldan pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 61—831

chos sku yang / /rnag can sku ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /sems can spyod yul ji bzhin du/ /de dag spyod pa rnam par rtog /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /de dag rtag tu mnyam bzhagatul/ /'greng dang bzhugs dang bzhud pa dang ske/ /de bzhin mnal bar snang ba yang / /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub dka' la/ /grangakhudang tsha dang grib ma dang / /de bzhin nyi ma stenasamadzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /tshangs pa'i khyim na tshangs pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rtag par na bza' gsol / /'on kyang na bza' len mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /spyi gtsug bltar ⑥ni mi mthong phyir/ /spu gris gcad du yong med kyang / /dbu 'breg par ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rab bsgoms te/ /de dag rdzu 'phrul rnamasaston la / /bsam gtan mdzad pa snang ba yang / /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /'jig rten rnam par 'dren pa kun/ /ro bro mchog rnams brnyes gyur kyang —/ /ngan ngon dag ni bsten7mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /bsod nams mi zad thams cad kyis7/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag 'phags/ /'on kyang ma brnyes ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /dga' ba'i zas ni mngon bsgrubs te/ / bskal palo bye btsobazhugs mdzad kyang / /rtag tu zhal zas gsol mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /bsod nams pha rol phyin pas 'phags/ / lha yihūn bza' brnyes gyur kyang / /phyag dar khrod pa gsol mdzad pa/ /'di ni 61—832

'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'og min gzhal med khang pa rnams/ /rnam 'dren rnams kyis yongs spangs te/ /rtswa khyim rnams ni stenatumadzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'dren pa rnams ni zhal dbugs kyis/ /rgya mtsho chen po skamasalgemadzad kyang / /char pa'i skyabs kyang rab 'dzin pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /bdud rnams bye ba dpag med pa/ /thugs bskyed tsam gyis 'dul mdzad kyang / /bdud kyi bgegs rnams ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /nga dang nga zhes lta ba gang / /de ni rang byung rnams la med/ /'on kyang nga dang nga'i zhes gsungasal/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas chos kun la/ /mi mkhyen pa ni mi mnga' yang / /gzhan la yongs su 'dri mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'byung mdzad kyang / /rab tu dben par snang ba ste/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de dag sna tshogs sku med kyang / /sems can mos pa ji bzhin du/ /sku lus sprul pa mdzad pa ni/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /'jig rten kun gyi sgra skad kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo la/ /'on kyang mkhuchung stenasamadzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spros mi mnga'/ /chos rnams kun la gsal gyur kyang / /spros dang bcas par gsung mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /ming med pa yi chos kyi rnams/ /bsam du med pa'i ming dag gis/ /sems can rnams la yongs brjod pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos rnams sems can med pa dang / /shin tu dngos po med mkhyen la/ /sems 61—833

can mang po 'dul mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /gang gis las byas 'di nyid kyis/ /myong bar gyur btum yin yang / /gang gis byas pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la/ /skyes bu mchog rnams mngon sum yang / /'chi 'pho skye ba ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'jig rten 'di nas srid gzhan du/ /su yang 'khor bar yong min la/ /'khor ba yang ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /phung po dag dang khams rnams dang / /skye mched rang bzhin gcig bzhed la/ /khams gsum po dag ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /dus gsum dag tu sems can gyi/ /rang bzhin dmigs pa ma yin 'khya/ /sems can khams kyang ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/‘ /kun la mi mkhyen rnam bral te/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs/ /'on kyang sngon mtha'7mi sasung ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /yang dag ji bzhin gzhan min par/ /chos rnams rtogs par thugs chud la/ /'on kyang gzhag pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /dam pa'i don du chos rnams kun/ /zab par rab tu mkhyen gyur la/ /sna tshogs su ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ston mdzad cing / /brdzun0par yang ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /bdud ni bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /dge 'dun dbye bar mi nus kyang / /dge 'dun dbyin ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos gang yang ni makyi61—834

bslabs la/ /ma bslabs pa yang gang yang med/ /slob dang mi slob ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'dus byas rnams ni ngo bo nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyis grol bcingasatumed/ /'on kyang rnam par grol ba ston / /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mya ngan 'das la 'gro med kyang ske/ /dgra bcom de ni 'gro 'ong zhes/ /sems can rnams la de bstan pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /don dang don min mi gzigs la/ /'gog pa dang ni dam pa'i don/ /smra ba rnams kyisamachog gsung ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug⑧yin/ /dngos po med pa gsal ba'i dngos/ /rnyog ma med pa0rab ston kyang / /chos rnams chud za med ces pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos rnams thams cad brjod med paradu/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rab mkhyen kyang / /brjod pa dag ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa chags mi mnga'/ /dus rnams kun tu mnyam bzhag kyang / /dbang po rnams ni sbed mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i sku/ /sangs rgyas cung zad mi bsnyun yang / /dge slong byang chub yan lag smrosaX/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sdig pa thams cad yongs zad de/ /bsod nams kun gyis mngon 'phags kyang / /las kyi rgyud ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas dus gsum la/ /mthar thug 'gyur ba yod min yang / /mtshams gcod pa yang ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos sku ste/ /gcig ci 'dra bar de bzhin kun/ /'on kyang tha dad ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 61—835

'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos so so'i skye bo dang / /'khor ba dang7ni mya ngan 'das/ /tshig gi lam gyis rab tu phye/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mtha' yas te②/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung yin yangasnye/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam mi khyab/ /sems canasre'adul ba'i don gyi phyir/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /zag med yod pa ma yin yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyan thos la/ /zag pa med pa nyid gsung ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mkhyen pas de dag gnyis min yang / /dus gsum dag ni rnamasalgegazigs shing / /gnyis kyi 'du shes ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid gang yin dang / /sangs rgyas rig par su 'dod pa/ /de ni chos dbyings zhus7shig pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /skye ba med pa bzod bsten⑧pa/ /rtag tu yang dag rab tu mkhyen/ /mkhyen nas rab tu ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rtag tu chos kyi dbyings mtshungs te/ /'jug pa med cing 'byung7med kyang / /'gro bcaganas pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mi skye ba la gcig pa 'am/ /mang po yod pa ma yin yang / /sna tshogs rim pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de dag tha dad sku med kyang / /sangs rgyas zhing rnams dpag med duskye/ /sku lus dag ni sprul mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /stong gsum bye ba brgya bgrangs pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing du brjod bya ba/ /der ni skye ba ston 61—836

mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dus kun tu/ /chos ni gnas par rab mkhyen kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab skoratub/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni dpag med cing / /sku lus dpag tu med min yang / /dpag tu yod pararnyuston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos kyi dbyings la mchog med de/ /dus gsum dag tu stong nyid kyang / /mchog gisasko chos rnams ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /zhig pa med cing skye med la / /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam gyur kyang / /sreg ④pa'i bskal pa ston mdzad pa / /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos kyi dbyings ni grub med de/ /de la ngo bo nyid med kyang / /'on kyang nges par 'byung ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /gzigs pa ci yang mi mnga' yang / /lhag mthong gis ni gzigs gyur cing / /lta ba thams cad ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos rnams kun la byed pa po/ /shin tu yod pa ma yin yang / /byas dang ma byas ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mya ngan 'das dang nam mkhar ⑤ni/ /rgyal ba grangs su ma chude kyang ske/ /khams kyi grangs rnams ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /grangs med stobs rnams brnyes gyur la/ /mthu las nyams pa mi mnga' yang / / zhabs 'bring yib dag tshol mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /nam yang byis pa'i blo ldan dang / /sangs rgyas 'dren pakhumi mnga' yang / /byis pa de dag 'dul mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /yon tan ldan pa thams cad kyi/ /pha rol de bzhin gshegs 61—837

byon kyang / /de la nga7ni gzhan zhes pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin / /mi skye ba ni rtag tu skyes/ /de dag rgyu las byung min yang / /ma rig rkyen gyis 'byung zhes pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rgyal ba rnyedasnyedang bkur sti las/ /sgrib pa med pa nyid brnyes la/ /chog shes pa ni ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /gang na sems can 'dul yod par/ /snang ba der ni 'dren pa rnams/ /de dag spyod pa ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rig pa gsum gyisatshogs bsags⑥pa/ /rig pa skyed7par nges par ston/ /'di la mthong ba ci yang med / /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'jig rten sgron mkhuthams cad du/ /skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dul/ /gling bzhi dag kyang ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /'jig rten gsum po gang na yang / /chos gang phung po gnas pa med/ /'on kyang chos grub bka' stsal pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mtha' gsum gyi ni mthar skyes pa/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams ston mdzad cingashe/ /sems can rnams la rab ston pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi rgyud mkhyen nas/ /'chi 'pho skye ba rnam7spangs la/ /de dag thams cad ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /mi skye ba ni gang mthong ba/ /ma rig de ni ye shes bgegs/ /rig pa skyed par ston mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig yin yang / /sems can yongs su smin bya'i7phyir/ /'byung ba dag ni bsam mi khyab/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'thun 'jug yin/ /gang dag mdo sde 'di 'draca'adi/ /phyi ma'i dus na thos 'gyur 61—838
